sentences.結果是事情做成了，對方卻沒有經歷過自己撐住的那一段。: The result is that the job gets done, but they never go through the stretch of holding up on their own.
sentences.放慢，對你是最難的調整。: Slowing down is the hardest adjustment for you.
sentences.等對方自己撐住那一段，比替對方做完更有價值。: Waiting while they get through that stretch themselves is worth more than finishing it for them.
sentences.太陰要有一段沒有人要求你的時間，才把白天收起來的東西放下。: With Tai Yin here, you need a stretch of time when no one wants anything from you before you can set down what you've held in all day.
sentences.武曲坐命的基調是把想法立刻轉成動作，不繞路也不太願意等。: Wu Qu in the Life Palace has you turn ideas straight into action, with no detours and little patience for waiting.
sentences.武曲在平輩關係裡的問題不是冷淡，是尺度——它把做事的標準原封不動搬進交情裡，對方: Your difficulty with peers isn't coldness but setting the right measure — Wu Qu has you carry your working standards unchanged into friendship, and say so straight out when someone falls short.
sentences.武曲本就是財帛主，這是它最順的一格。: Wu Qu is the natural ruler of wealth, so money is where it serves you best.
sentences.《全書》寫「豐足化吉有巨萬家資」：錢是你最順手的一環。: The *Complete Book* speaks of "plenty, and a great family fortune when well placed": money is the part of life that comes most easily to you.
sentences.武曲處理資源的方式是主動經營：看得準、下得了手、不為小錢反覆。: Wu Qu has you manage money actively: you read things well, act decisively, and don't dither over small sums.
sentences.它對數字有感覺，也願意承擔相應的風險。: You have a feel for numbers and are willing to take the risks that come with them.
sentences.你對數字有感覺，這是少見的長處。: You have a feel for numbers, which is a rare strength.
sentences.武曲的耗損來自硬撐——它不擅長示弱，也不太承認自己需要停。: What wears you down is forcing yourself on — you're not good at showing weakness, and you rarely admit you need to stop.
sentences.武曲的疲勞多半累積到不能不停為止，而不是在中途被處理掉。: Your tiredness usually builds until you have no choice but to stop, rather than being dealt with along the way.
sentences.對它有用的不是休息的技巧，是願意提早承認。: What helps you isn't a way of resting but a willingness to admit it early.
sentences.它的消耗來得猛而不是來得久，所以提早承認比學會休息更有用。: Your drain comes on hard rather than long, so admitting it early helps more than learning to rest.
sentences.武曲在陌生而繁忙的環境最能發揮：有事要解決、有節奏要跟上，它立刻進入狀態。: Wu Qu has you do your best in unfamiliar, busy places: with problems to solve and a pace to keep up with, you get going straight away.
sentences.安靜、緩慢、需要慢慢鋪墊的場合則令它煩躁。: Quiet, slow settings that need patient groundwork make you restless.
sentences.武曲讓你換環境不猶豫，但對環境的要求集中在一點——要有事做。: Wu Qu lets you change your surroundings without hesitation, but you ask one thing of them: something to do.
sentences.它對環境只有一個要求：要有事做。: You ask only one thing of a place: something to do.
sentences.武曲在群體裡靠的是實績而不是交情：它說得出做得到，於是被信任、被依賴。: Wu Qu gives you your place in a group through results rather than friendships: you do what you say, so you're trusted and relied on.
sentences.武曲很少花力氣維繫關係本身，也不太處理別人的情緒。: You rarely put effort into the relationships themselves, and don't do much with other people's feelings.
sentences.結果是共事的人多，走得近的人少，而它自己通常不覺得這是問題。: The result is plenty of people to work with and few close ones, which you usually don't see as a problem.
sentences.《全書》寫「與昌曲左右同宮，武職崢嶸」：有得力的人在旁，你走得更遠。: The *Complete Book* says that "with its aides and scholars beside it, it excels in martial office": with capable people around you, you go further.
sentences.武曲的做事方式是直取目標：分解、執行、收尾，路徑越短越好。: Wu Qu has you go straight for the goal: break it down, carry it out, finish it, and the shorter the path the better.
sentences.這在目標明確、責任清楚的位置上極有力；在需要協調多方、講究過程與人情的位置上則容: This is very powerful where goals and responsibilities are clear, and leads to clashes where many parties must be balanced and process and feelings matter.
sentences.路徑越短越好，這在需要繞的地方就成了代價。: The shortest path is best — until you're somewhere that needs a detour, and then it becomes the cost.
sentences.武曲對居所的態度是務實的：它看的是功能與價值，不太看氣氛。: Wu Qu makes you practical about a home: you look at function and value rather than atmosphere.
sentences.夠用、划算、將來處理得掉，這幾樣比住得舒服更能說服它。: Big enough, good value, easy to sell on later — these persuade you more than comfort does.
sentences.武曲在安置上決斷快、猶豫少，也較少為了感覺付出溢價。: You decide quickly about where to live, hesitate little, and rarely pay extra for a feeling.
sentences.夠用、划算、將來處理得掉，比住得舒服更能說服它。: Big enough, good value and easy to sell on persuade you more than comfort does.
sentences.《全書》寫「勞心費力，入廟安然享福」：你辛苦，也懂得享受辛苦換來的東西。: The *Complete Book* says "toiling in mind and body, and when strong, enjoying the rewards in peace": you work hard, and you know how to enjoy what the hard work brings.
sentences.武曲的安定來自事情在推進——只要有進度，它就不覺得累。: You find calm in things moving forward — as long as there's progress, you don't feel tired.
sentences.真正令它不安的是停滯：等待、拖延、懸而未決的事，比工作量本身更消耗它。: What really unsettles you is stalling: waiting, delay and unresolved matters drain you more than the workload itself.
sentences.所以對你而言，把事情推到有結論，往往比放下它更能讓人睡得著。: So for you, pushing a matter to a conclusion usually does more for your sleep than setting it aside.
sentences.停滯比工作量更消耗它，所以推到有結論往往比放下更有效。: Stalling drains you more than workload, so pushing to a conclusion usually works better than letting go.
sentences.武曲不太懂得迂迴，認為對就堅持，認為不對就直說。: Wu Qu has you hold to what you think is right, and say so plainly when something is wrong.
sentences.武曲直來直往，使關係裡的立場清楚，也使衝突來得快。: Being straightforward keeps positions clear, and makes conflict arrive quickly.
sentences.它對規則的態度同樣直接——合理就遵守，不合理就繞過去，較少花時間在程序上與人周旋: You're just as direct with rules — you follow the sensible ones and go around the rest, spending little time working the system with people.
sentences.立場清楚，衝突也就來得快，兩者是同一件事。: A clear position and quick conflict are the same thing.
sentences.天機在命的基調是轉：遇到阻力先想別的路，而不是硬推。: Tian Ji in the Life Palace makes turning your keynote: when you hit resistance, you look for another way rather than pushing.
sentences.天機遇阻先轉，使它靈活、學得快、少與人正面相撞，也使它不容易在一件事上待夠久。: Turning first when blocked makes you flexible, quick to learn and rarely in head-on clashes, and also makes it hard for you to stay with one thing long enough.
sentences.《全書》另有一句「在廟旺有力，陷地無力」：你的表現，很看環境配不配合。: The *Complete Book* also says "strong where it is bright, powerless where it is weak": how you do depends a lot on whether your surroundings cooperate.
sentences.它繞得開阻力，也繞得開需要待久的事。: You can get round obstacles, and you can also slip round things that need you to stay put.
sentences.天機在平輩關係裡的角色：它是居中的那一個——傳話、調停、把兩邊接上。: Among your peers, Tian Ji puts you in the middle — passing messages, mediating, joining the two sides up.
sentences.天機居中牽線，使它在群體裡不可或缺，也使它長期站在別人的事情中間。: Being the go-between makes you indispensable in a group, and also leaves you standing in the middle of other people's business for years.
sentences.久了會出現一種疲倦：所有人的狀況它都知道，而它自己的事沒有人接。: In time a kind of tiredness sets in: you know how everyone else is doing, and no one picks up your own problems.
sentences.居中的位置給它分量，也讓它少了一個可以靠的人。: The middle position gives you weight, and also leaves you with no one to lean on.
sentences.天機在親密關係裡的方式：它想得多、調整得快，願意為對方改變做法。: In love, Tian Ji has you think a lot, adjust quickly, and change your ways for a partner.
sentences.天機的彈性讓關係少有僵局，也讓它顯得不夠穩定——因為想法會變，說法也跟著變。: That flexibility means few deadlocks, and also makes you seem unsteady — as your thinking changes, so does what you say.
sentences.對方感受到的常常不是不在乎，而是抓不住。: What a partner often feels isn't that it doesn't care, but that they can't keep hold of it.
sentences.對方感受到的不是不在乎，是抓不住，這個分別值得說清楚。: What a partner feels isn't indifference but not being able to keep hold — a difference worth spelling out.
sentences.天機對培養的方式：它擅長教方法而不是教內容——遇到問題怎麼拆、路不通時怎麼繞。: When you bring others up, Tian Ji makes you better at teaching method than content — how to break a problem down, how to find a way round when the road is blocked.
sentences.天機教方法，對後輩相當受用，但也容易變成不斷提供選項，反而使對方難以定下來。: Teaching method serves juniors well, but you can slip into an endless stream of options that makes it hard for them to settle.
sentences.天機落陷時，同樣的多想會表現為反覆修改安排，讓被帶的一方無所適從。: When Tian Ji is weak, the same overthinking shows up as changing arrangements again and again, leaving the person being guided at a loss.
sentences.選項太多，反而使被帶的一方難以定下來。: Too many options make it hard for the person being guided to settle.
sentences.《全書》寫「勞心費力生財」：錢要靠動腦筋去賺。: The *Complete Book* says "wealth through toil of mind and body": money has to be earned by thinking.
sentences.天機賺取資源的方式靠腦不靠本：看機會、找縫隙、把不對盤的東西接起來。: Tian Ji has you earn with brains rather than capital: spotting openings, finding gaps, connecting things that don't obviously fit.
sentences.這種方式起伏較大，因為每一筆都要重新想過，難以形成穩定的重複。: Income like this rises and falls, because every deal has to be thought through afresh and rarely settles into a steady rhythm.
sentences.它也較少把錢放在長期不動的地方——對天機而言，動起來的資源才算資源，放著不動就等: You also rarely leave money untouched for long — for you, money only counts when it's moving; money sitting still might as well not be there.
sentences.天機的耗損來自停不下來的思慮——事情處理完了，腦裡還在演其他版本。: What wears you down is a mind that won't stop — the matter is dealt with, but your head is still playing out other versions.
sentences.天機的思慮不隨事情結束而結束，所以它的疲勞常常出現在空閒的時候，而不是忙碌的時候: Your thinking doesn't end when the task does, so your tiredness often shows up in idle moments rather than busy ones.
sentences.對你有用的不是少做事，是有辦法讓念頭落地：寫下來、說出口、或者乾脆做一個決定。: What helps you isn't doing less but finding ways to bring thoughts down to earth: write them down, say them aloud, or simply make a decision.
sentences.天機在外面比在原地順：新環境提供新的變數，而變數正是它的長處；待在熟悉而固定的地: Tian Ji makes things go better for you out in the world than at home: new places bring new variables, and variables are your strength; in familiar, fixed surroundings, the same quick wit turns into fault-finding and unease.
sentences.天機讓你多半動得比別人頻密，也比別人更快適應新的規矩與人事。: Tian Ji has you moving more often than most, and adapting faster to new rules and people.
sentences.它換環境的門檻低，重新開始對它不算成本。: Changing surroundings comes easily to you, and starting again costs you nothing.
sentences.天機在群體裡靠的是消息與接點：它知道誰認識誰、哪條路走得通，於是成為關鍵的中間人: Tian Ji gives you your place in a group through information and connections: you know who knows whom and which routes work, so you become the key go-between.
sentences.這使它的人脈廣而輕——接觸的面很大，沉澱下來的關係未必多。: This makes your network wide but light — lots of contact, few relationships that settle into something deeper.
sentences.中間人的位置消耗的是時間與記性，而這兩樣都不會被記錄。: The go-between's role costs time and memory, and neither gets recorded.
sentences.天機的做事方式是拆解與變通：把難題切開、找替代路徑、在限制裡找空間。: Tian Ji has you take things apart and adapt: cutting a problem into pieces, finding another route, making room inside the limits.
sentences.這在需要應變與設計的位置上很有力；在需要長期重複、不容更動的位置上則容易失去耐性: This is powerful in roles that call for adaptability and design, and runs out of patience in roles of long, unchangeable repetition.
sentences.長期重複、不容更動的位置，最容易磨掉它的耐性。: Long, unchangeable repetition wears down your patience fastest.
sentences.《全書》寫「退祖新創置」，你的特點是不守舊。: The *Complete Book* says "leaves the family property and builds anew": you don't hold on to the old.
sentences.天機對居所的態度是可換的：它不太把某個地方認定為唯一的家，也較少為長期持有付出額: Tian Ji has you see a home as something you can change: you rarely think of one place as your only home, and rarely pay extra to hold on for the long term.
sentences.搬動對它的心理成本低，甚至帶點新鮮感。: Moving costs you little mentally, and even feels a little fresh.
sentences.相對地，歸屬感也就比較薄。: By the same token, your sense of belonging is thinner.
sentences.搬動的心理成本低，歸屬感也就比較薄，兩者是同一件事的兩面。: A low mental cost of moving and a thinner sense of belonging are two sides of the same thing.
sentences.《全書》寫「先勞後逸」：你先辛苦，之後才鬆得下來。: The *Complete Book* says "toil first, ease later": you work hard first and relax only afterwards.
sentences.天機的安定要等到事情想通為止——沒想通之前，休息也是在想。: You only settle once things are thought through — until then, even resting is thinking.
sentences.天機的精神狀態不隨工作量變化，而隨懸而未決的事情數量變化。: Your peace of mind rises and falls not with your workload but with the number of things left unresolved.
sentences.清空待辦不如清空疑問——有一個可以把念頭寫下來的地方，對你比放假更有用。: Clearing questions beats clearing your to-do list — having somewhere to write your thoughts down does more for you than a holiday.
sentences.事情懸著，它就一直開著。: While a matter hangs, your mind stays open.
sentences.事情懸著，它就一直開著，這是它最實在的消耗來源。: While a matter hangs, your mind stays open, and that's your most real source of drain.
sentences.天機不正面對抗，它繞。: Tian Ji has you go around a confrontation rather than into it.
sentences.不認同的時候不爭辯，而是找另一條路把事情辦成。: When it disagrees, it doesn't argue; it finds another way to get things done.
sentences.這使關係少有衝突，也使真正的分歧從來沒有被攤開處理。: This keeps relationships free of conflict, and also means real disagreements are never dealt with in the open.
sentences.它對制度的態度同樣是找空間，而不是改規則。: You approach systems the same way: you find room rather than changing the rules.
sentences.它找空間，而不是改規則，於是分歧從來沒有被攤開處理過。: You find room rather than changing the rules, so disagreements never get dealt with in the open.
sentences.天同在命的基調是和緩：不爭先、不記仇、把日子過得舒服的能力比多數人強。: Tian Tong in the Life Palace makes gentleness your keynote: no pushing to be first, no grudges, and a greater gift than most for making life comfortable.
sentences.所以你往往能力不差而起步偏晚，需要一點外來的推力才離開已經夠好的位置。: So you're often capable but slow to start, and need a push from outside to leave a place that's already good enough.
sentences.天同在平輩關係裡的位置：它是最容易相處的那一個。: Among your peers, Tian Tong makes you the easiest one to get along with.
sentences.不搶、不計較、願意配合，於是圈子裡少有因它而起的衝突。: You don't grab, don't keep score and are willing to fit in, so little conflict in the group ever starts with you.
sentences.天同也較少主動推動什麼——聚會由別人發起，難題由別人開口。: You also rarely drive anything yourself — others organise the get-togethers, and others raise the hard questions.
sentences.關係因此長久而平淡，遇到需要有人站出來的時候，它通常不是那個人。: So your relationships are long and even, and when someone needs to step up, it usually isn't you.
sentences.它的朋友通常留得久，因為從來沒有理由離開。: Your friends usually stay a long time, because there's never a reason to leave.
sentences.天同在親密關係裡的方式：它求安穩多於求熱烈，願意遷就，也不太把小事放在心上。: In love, Tian Tong has you want steadiness more than passion, give way willingly, and let small things go.
sentences.這使關係容易維持，也使問題容易被拖著——不舒服的事先放著，多半就真的一直放著。: This makes a relationship easy to keep going, and also lets problems drift — what bothers you gets put aside, and usually stays there.
sentences.天同的關係裡，裂痕通常不是爆發出來的，是累積到某一天突然說不下去。: In Tian Tong's relationships, cracks don't usually burst open; they build until one day it simply can't go on.
sentences.需要有人先開口的時候，它多半不是那個人。: When someone needs to speak first, it's usually not you.
sentences.天同對培養的姿態：它給空間而不給壓力。: When you bring others up, Tian Tong has you give space rather than pressure.
sentences.對後輩或自己在做的事，它容許慢、容許繞路、不太用標準去量。: With juniors or your own projects, you allow slowness and detours, and rarely measure against a standard.
sentences.天同給空間，讓對方放鬆，也可能讓對方缺少一個推力。: That space lets them relax, and may also leave them without a push.
sentences.天同的難處在於，當真的需要嚴格的時候，它往往開不了口，於是把該說的話留給了別人去: The difficulty is that when real firmness is needed, you often can't bring yourself to say it, and leave the words to someone else.
sentences.該嚴格的時候開不了口，是你最實際的難處。: Not being able to say the firm thing when it's needed is your most practical difficulty.
sentences.《全書》寫「白手生財晚發」：財富多半靠自己慢慢建立，來得比別人晚。: The *Complete Book* says "makes money from nothing, prospers late": your wealth is mostly built slowly by yourself, and comes later than other people's.
sentences.天同處理資源的方式偏向夠用就好：不積極追求，也不特別節省，錢多的時候花得舒服，緊: Tian Tong has you treat money on an enough-is-enough basis: you don't chase it or particularly save it, you spend comfortably when there's plenty, and you cope when things are tight.
sentences.它較少為財務設定目標，於是累積多半是自然形成而不是計劃出來的。: You rarely set financial goals, so your savings mostly build up by themselves rather than by plan.
sentences.它不追求，也就不焦慮；代價是真正影響它的，往往是有沒有人替它設過一個目標。: You don't chase, so you don't worry; the trade-off is that what really makes a difference is whether someone has ever set you a target.
sentences.天同的耗損不來自壓力大，來自壓力遲遲不處理。: What wears you down isn't heavy pressure but pressure left unresolved.
sentences.它習慣把不舒服的事往後推，於是小問題有足夠的時間長大。: You tend to push uncomfortable things back, which gives small problems plenty of time to grow.
sentences.你的消耗來得慢、發現得遲，疲勞多半在事情已經拖成大事之後才顯出來。: The drain comes slowly and is noticed late; your tiredness usually only shows once a small thing has dragged on into a big one.
sentences.對它有用的不是學會休息，是把事情提早攤開。: What helps isn't learning to rest but bringing things into the open early.
sentences.天同在陌生環境裡討人喜歡：態度軟、不帶攻擊性，別人願意幫它一把。: Tian Tong makes people warm to you quickly in unfamiliar places: you're soft in manner and never aggressive, so people want to give you a hand.
sentences.天同換環境的阻力小，融入得快。: You meet little resistance when you change surroundings, and you fit in quickly.
sentences.難處在於融入之後——新的舒適區一旦成形，它又不太願意再動。: The difficulty comes after fitting in — once a new comfort zone forms, you don't want to move again.
sentences.於是你常常一去就留下，而留下的理由多半是習慣不是判斷。: So once you go somewhere you often stay, more out of habit than judgement.
sentences.融入的容易與離開的困難，其實是同一種性質。: Fitting in easily and leaving with difficulty are really the same quality.
sentences.天同在群體裡是黏合劑：脾氣好、肯配合、不製造對立，於是人人都樂意與它共事。: Tian Tong makes you the glue in a group: good-natured, cooperative and never divisive, so everyone is happy to work with you.
sentences.但它很少表達立場，也不太爭取，久了在分配資源或決定方向的時候容易被略過。: But you rarely state a position or push for anything, so in time you're easily passed over when resources are shared out or direction is decided.
sentences.你的課題是開口，不是人緣。: Your task is speaking up, not popularity.
sentences.開口，對你比努力更有用。: Speaking up will do more for you than working harder.
sentences.天同的做事方式是平穩推進：不催、不搶、把過程弄得舒服。: Tian Tong has you move things forward steadily: no rushing, no grabbing, keeping the process pleasant.
sentences.這在需要長期協作、氣氛重要的位置上很有用；在需要拚速度或扛壓力的位置上則顯得慢。: This is valuable in long-term collaborative roles where the atmosphere matters, and looks slow where speed or pressure is required.
sentences.它把過程弄得舒服，而這一點在長期協作裡的價值，通常要很久才被看見。: You keep the process pleasant, and in long-term collaboration that value usually takes a long time to be noticed.
sentences.天同對居所的要求集中在一點：要舒服。: Tian Tong leaves you with one demand of a home: that it be comfortable.
sentences.採光、動線、有沒有可以窩著的角落，比面積與地段更能影響它的判斷。: Light, flow and whether there's a corner to curl up in sway you more than size or location.
sentences.它不急著安置，也不為了將來的價值忍受現在的不便——這一點在取捨順序上決定了很多。: You're in no hurry to settle, and won't put up with inconvenience now for value later — which decides a great deal about your priorities.
sentences.它要的是一個待得住的地方，不是一個有價值的地方。: What you want is somewhere you can stay, not somewhere valuable.
sentences.天同本就是福德主，這是它的本位。: Tian Tong is the natural ruler of wellbeing, so this is where it serves you best.
sentences.你的安定門檻低——不需要成就，不需要被肯定，有一段沒有人催的時間就夠。: It doesn't take much to settle you — no achievements, no recognition, just a stretch of time with no one chasing you.
sentences.難處在另一邊：門檻低也意味著離開舒服狀態的動機弱。: The difficulty lies on the other side: being easily settled also means little motivation to leave comfort behind.
sentences.所以它的精神狀態通常穩定，而長期的不滿往往不是痛苦，是一種說不出來的停滯感。: So your peace of mind is usually steady, and long-term dissatisfaction tends not to be pain but a feeling of being stuck that you can't put into words.
sentences.門檻低使它穩定，也使它難以離開已經夠好的位置，兩者是同一件事。: Being easily settled keeps you steady and makes it hard to leave a place that's already good enough; they're the same thing.
sentences.天同順著來，不正面違逆，也不太據理力爭。: Tian Tong has you go along with things rather than defy them openly or argue your case.
sentences.天同不違逆，使關係融洽，也使它在被安排的時候不容易說不。: Not defying keeps your relationships harmonious, and also makes it hard for you to say no when things are arranged for you.
sentences.它照做，很少質疑，直到某件事真的做不下去為止；而到那一刻，它的轉變往往比任何人都: You do as you're asked and rarely question anything, until something becomes truly impossible; and at that moment your change is often more complete than anyone's.
sentences.因為它不是不介意，只是忍了太久。: Because you did mind; you had just put up with it for too long.
sentences.《全書》寫「性剛，眼露神光」：你的強度，旁人一眼看得出。: The *Complete Book* says "firm in temperament, with a light in the eyes": others can see your intensity at a glance.
sentences.廉貞在命的基調是濃度：對在意的事投入很深，對不在意的事相當冷淡，中間地帶很窄。: Lian Zhen in the Life Palace makes intensity your keynote: deep commitment to what you care about, coolness towards the rest, and little in between.
sentences.條件不足時，這份強度會轉成跟自己過不去。: When conditions fall short, that intensity turns against itself.
sentences.它的強度是資源也是消耗，看它投在哪裡。: Your intensity is both a resource and a drain, depending on where you spend it.
sentences.廉貞在平輩關係裡的投入方式：它對朋友分得很清楚，認定的就全力以赴，沒認定的連客套: Among your peers, Lian Zhen has you be clear about who your friends are — everything for the ones you choose, barely a pleasantry for the rest.
sentences.這使它的交情深而少，而且一旦失望，收回來也相當徹底。: So your friendships are deep and few, and once you're disappointed you withdraw just as completely.
sentences.合作時它講規矩，對方不守規矩時它不會忍——摩擦多半由此而來，而流動性也因此偏低。: When working together you play by the rules and won't tolerate those who don't — that's where most friction comes from, and why your circle changes so little.
sentences.交情的數量少，但份量重。: Few friendships, but each carries weight.
sentences.廉貞在親密關係裡的濃度：它投入得深，要求也高——不只要對方在，還要對方在意得跟它: In love, Lian Zhen has you give deeply and expect a lot — you want your partner not just there, but caring as much as you do.
sentences.廉貞的投入使關係強烈，也使落差特別刺眼。: That commitment makes a relationship intense, and makes any gap glaring.
sentences.它對界線敏感，被越界時反應激烈；而它自己認定的界線未必事先說明。: You're sensitive about boundaries and react strongly when they're crossed, yet the lines you've drawn are not always explained in advance.
sentences.它認定的界線未必事先說明，卻期待對方自己知道，這是落差最常見的起點。: You don't always explain your lines in advance, yet you expect your partner to know them — the most common starting point for a gap.
sentences.廉貞對培養的方式：它投入極深，也把自己的原則整套交出去。: When you bring others up, Lian Zhen has you invest deeply and hand over your whole set of principles with it.
sentences.對後輩或自己的作品，它要求到位、要求認真，不接受敷衍。: With juniors or your own work, you expect things done properly and seriously, and won't accept half-measures.
sentences.這種方式能帶出東西，也容易讓對方感到壓迫——因為廉貞的在意本身就有重量，即使它從: This gets results, and can also make others feel pressed — with Lian Zhen, your caring has weight of its own, even when you've never asked for anything.
sentences.它的在意本身就有重量，即使從沒開口要求。: Your caring has weight of its own, even when you never ask for anything.
sentences.降低期待，比降低標準更難。: Lowering expectations is harder than lowering standards.
sentences.廉貞處理資源的方式帶著投入感：它願意為認定的事押上成本，也不太接受折衷的方案。: Lian Zhen has you handle money with real commitment: you'll stake real cost on what you believe in, and you don't take kindly to compromise.
sentences.廉貞敢押成本，使它的財務起伏比溫和型的星大，而起伏的原因多半是選擇而不是運氣。: Being willing to stake costs makes your finances swing more than gentler stars would, and the swings come mostly from choices rather than luck.
sentences.廉貞的耗損來自情緒的濃度——它對事情的反應比多數人強烈，而強烈的反應本身就要耗掉: What wears you down is the intensity of your feelings — you react more strongly than most, and strong reactions take energy in themselves.
sentences.廉貞的消耗與工作量無關，與在意程度有關，所以它可能在一件小事上比別人累十倍。: Your drain has nothing to do with workload and everything to do with how much you care, so a small thing can tire you ten times more than it would someone else.
sentences.降溫，比減量對你更有用。: Cooling down helps you more than doing less.
sentences.它累的原因是它在意，而不是它做得多。: You're tired because you care, not because you do a lot.
sentences.廉貞在外面比在家自在：陌生場合給它一個乾淨的開始，不必背著舊有的人際包袱。: Lian Zhen makes you more at ease out in the world than at home: unfamiliar settings give you a clean start, free of old baggage with people.
sentences.它在外的表現往往比在熟人面前放得開，也更容易被欣賞。: You're often more relaxed away than in front of people you know, and more easily appreciated.
sentences.難處是投入得快——新環境很快變成另一個重度投入的地方，於是換了地方，模式不變。: The difficulty is how fast it commits — a new place quickly becomes somewhere else to throw itself into, so the place changes and the pattern doesn't.
sentences.換了地方，模式不變——這是你最需要看清楚的地方。: The place changes, the pattern doesn't — that's what you most need to see clearly.
sentences.廉貞在群體裡靠的是立場與原則：認同它的人非常靠攏，不認同的則明顯疏遠。: Lian Zhen gives you your place in a group through your stance and principles: those who agree with you stay very close, and those who don't clearly drift away.
sentences.它不做和稀泥的角色，也不太經營中間地帶。: You won't play the peacemaker, and you don't cultivate middle ground.
sentences.廉貞的人際網路輪廓清楚而邊界分明。: Your network has a clear outline and sharp edges.
sentences.它不做和稀泥的角色，於是人際網路的輪廓清楚，邊界也硬。: Because you won't play the peacemaker, your network has a clear outline and hard edges.
sentences.《全書》寫「入廟武職權貴不耐久」：你起步快，難在持久。: The *Complete Book* says "when strong, high martial office, but not for long": you start fast, and the hard part is lasting.
sentences.廉貞的做事方式是高投入加高標準：它適合需要專注與規格的位置，不適合需要長期低溫運: Lian Zhen has you work with high commitment and high standards: you suit roles that need focus and precision, not ones that need a long, low-temperature run.
sentences.起步猛、持續難，安排節奏比增加投入更能幫到它。: You start hard and struggle to keep going, so pacing helps you more than giving more.
sentences.廉貞對居所的態度：它要的是合乎自己規格的空間，寧可推翻重來也不將就。: Lian Zhen has you want a home built to your own specification; you'd rather start again than make do.
sentences.於是你常常搬動、改造、不斷調整，而每一次都投入不少成本——因為安置對它而言不是找: So you often move, remodel and keep adjusting, putting real cost into each change — because for you, settling isn't finding somewhere to live but making a place your own.
sentences.改造的成本高，但對它而言那筆錢花得值。: Remodelling costs a lot, but to you the money is well spent.
sentences.廉貞的安定來自有一件值得投入的事——它在專注的時候最平靜，在無事可投入的時候最煩: You find calm in having something worth throwing yourself into — you're most at peace when focused and most restless with nothing to commit to.
sentences.對廉貞來說，清閒不是休息，是一種空轉。: With Lian Zhen here, idleness isn't rest for you; it's spinning your wheels.
sentences.真正令它耗損的，是投入了卻得不到相應的回應：這種不對等比工作量本身更難受。: What really wears you down is giving a lot and getting little back: that imbalance is harder to bear than the workload.
sentences.安排一件值得做的事，對廉貞比放假更有效；而回應是否對等，它其實一直在算。: Arranging something worth doing works better for you than a holiday — and you are, in fact, always keeping count of whether what comes back matches what you give.
sentences.廉貞不盲從，對規則要求講得通——講得通就守得比誰都嚴，講不通就不願意配合。: Lian Zhen keeps you from following blindly; rules have to make sense — when they do, you keep them more strictly than anyone, and when they don't, you won't cooperate.
sentences.廉貞與制度的關係要麼極好要麼極僵。: Your relationship with any system is either excellent or deadlocked.
sentences.它在文書與程序上其實相當認真，前提是它認同那件事有意義。: You're actually very conscientious with paperwork and procedure, provided you agree the task is meaningful.
sentences.它守規矩守得比誰都嚴，前提是那條規矩講得通。: You keep rules more strictly than anyone, provided they make sense.
sentences.貪狼在命的基調是想要：好奇心強、學得快、興趣鋪得開。: Tan Lang in the Life Palace makes wanting your keynote: curious, quick to learn, with interests that spread wide.
sentences.它的方向不由星本身決定，而由當下想要什麼決定，所以同一個人在不同階段可以差得很遠: Your direction is set not by the star itself but by what you want at the moment, so you can look very different at different stages of life.
sentences.課題不在動力，在收斂——想要的東西太多時，力氣會散在半途。: The task isn't drive but focus — when you want too many things, your energy scatters halfway.
sentences.慾望在這裡是中性的，指驅力而不是缺陷。: Desire here is neutral: it means drive, not a flaw.
sentences.貪狼在平輩關係裡的方式：它容易建立連結，也容易讓連結停在淺處。: Among your peers, Tan Lang has you make connections easily, and let them stay shallow just as easily.
sentences.認識得快、聊得來、場面熱鬧，但真正交底的不多。: Quick to meet, easy to talk to, always lively — but few people it truly confides in.
sentences.貪狼交朋友不是冷淡，是注意力一直在移動。: You aren't cold with friends; your attention just keeps moving.
sentences.於是需要有人長期在旁邊的時候，它未必找得到那個人——不是沒有朋友，是沒有留下來的: So when you need someone by your side for the long haul, you may not find them — not for lack of friends, but because no friendship stayed long enough.
sentences.貪狼在親密關係裡的濃度變化：初期投入極高、感受鮮明，之後容易被新的刺激分走注意力: In love, Tan Lang has you throw yourself in and feel vividly at first, then get easily distracted by something new.
sentences.這不代表不忠，而是它對新鮮的反應本來就比多數人強。: This doesn't mean disloyalty; you simply respond more strongly to novelty than most people.
sentences.關鍵不在對象換不換，在它有沒有把驅力安放在別的地方。: The key isn't whether the partner changes, but whether that drive has been given somewhere else to go.
sentences.貪狼對培養的姿態：它把好玩的東西帶給對方——新的領域、新的玩法、不設限的嘗試。: Tan Lang adds curiosity and play to the way you guide others — new fields, new ways of doing things, trying without limits.
sentences.貪狼這樣帶人，啟發性強，也容易缺乏持續：它自己的興趣轉了，帶著的那件事就停在半路: This is very inspiring, and can also lack staying power: once your own interest moves on, what you were leading stalls halfway.
sentences.它是打開門的人，未必是陪著走完的人，這一點值得先對對方講明。: You're the one who opens the door, not necessarily the one who walks the whole way, and that's worth telling them up front.
sentences.《全書》寫「廟旺橫發，陷地貧窮」：你的財運起落比別人大。: The *Complete Book* says "sudden wealth when strong, poverty when weak": your fortunes with money rise and fall more than other people's.
sentences.貪狼賺取資源的方式跟著機會走：看到就撲上去，看不到就閒著。: Tan Lang has you earn by following opportunity: you pounce when you see one and idle when you don't.
sentences.它容易把賺到的再投回下一個想要的東西，於是帳面的起伏比實際能力大。: You tend to put what you earn straight into the next thing you want, so your balance swings more than your real ability would suggest.
sentences.貪狼的耗損來自同時開太多條線——每一條都要分一點注意力，而注意力是不能分割使用的: What wears you down is running too many threads at once — each needs a share of your attention, and attention can't really be divided.
sentences.它的疲勞常常出現在什麼都沒做完的時候，而不是做得多的時候。: Your tiredness often comes when nothing has been finished, rather than when you've done a lot.
sentences.對你而言，收窄比放慢有效得多。: For you, narrowing down works far better than slowing down.
sentences.貪狼在外面比在家活躍：新的場合、新的人、新的可能，全部是它要的養分。: Tan Lang makes you more active out in the world than at home: new occasions, new people and new possibilities are all the nourishment you want.
sentences.它在陌生環境不緊張，反而放得更開。: You aren't nervous somewhere new; if anything, you relax more.
sentences.難處是移動本身也會變成一種慾望——換環境成了解決問題的預設方式，而問題往往跟著一: The difficulty is that moving itself can become a desire — a change of scene becomes your default answer to problems, and the problems often move with you.
sentences.貪狼在群體裡是熱鬧的來源：它認識的人多、串得起場、帶得動氣氛。: Tan Lang makes you where a group's liveliness comes from: you know plenty of people, can bring an occasion together and lift the mood.
sentences.貪狼的關係流動性高，來得快去得也快，長期留下的未必多。: Your relationships come and go quickly, and few of them last.
sentences.你的課題是把幾段關係留住，而不是認識更多的人。: Your task is holding on to a few relationships, not meeting more people.
sentences.《全書》寫「入廟遇火鈴武職掌大權」：遇上合適的時機，你的衝勁能帶出很大的局面。: The *Complete Book* says that "when strong and meeting Fire and Bell, it wields great martial power": at the right moment, your drive can open up something big.
sentences.貪狼的做事方式靠興趣驅動：想做的時候效率極高，不想做的時候拖得厲害，這個落差比能: Tan Lang has you work when interest drives you: extremely efficient when you want to, badly dragging your feet when you don't, and that gap predicts results better than ability does.
sentences.它適合變化多、可以自己選題的位置。: You suit varied roles where you can choose your own projects.
sentences.脾氣好讓它進得了任何圈子，卻不保它在圈子裡有位置。: A good nature gets you into any circle, but doesn't secure you a place there.
sentences.廉貞的濃度使它有原則、有魅力，也使它容易在同一件事上耗掉過多的自己。: That intensity gives you principles and real appeal, and also leads you to spend too much of yourself on a single thing.
sentences.貪狼對居所的態度偏向可換：它不把某個地方當作終點，也容易因為新的機會而搬動。: Tan Lang has you see a home as something you can swap: no place is a final stop, and you'll readily move for a new opportunity.
sentences.空間對它的意義是可能性——這裡能不能做點什麼，比住不住得舒服更要緊。: To you, a space means possibility — whether something can be done there matters more than whether it's comfortable to live in.
sentences.你的安定條件比較特別：它需要有一件正在期待的事。: What you need to feel settled is unusual: something to look forward to.
sentences.有想要的東西在前面，它就穩；什麼都不缺、什麼都不想要的時候，反而空。: With something you want up ahead, you're steady; when you lack nothing and want nothing, you feel empty.
sentences.貪狼的精神狀態與獲得無關，與期待有關。: Your state of mind depends not on what you have but on what you're looking forward to.
sentences.問它缺什麼，不如問它在等什麼——後者才答得出來。: Rather than asking what you lack, ask what you're waiting for — that's the question you can answer.
sentences.福德與財帛正對，一個講內在滿足，一個講外在資源。: The Wellbeing Palace sits opposite the Wealth Palace: one is about inner contentment, the other about outer resources.
sentences.貪狼不硬碰，但也不太受約束——它習慣找空隙，把想做的事做成，事後才說。: Tan Lang has you avoid head-on clashes without taking much restraining either — you find a gap, do what you want, and mention it afterwards.
sentences.貪狼不硬碰，使表面關係平順，實際順從度卻不高。: Not clashing keeps relationships smooth on the surface, though it doesn't actually comply much.
sentences.它遵守形式，未必遵守精神，而長輩通常最後一個知道。: You follow the letter rather than the spirit, and your elders are usually the last to know.
sentences.《全書》寫「作事進退，多疑且多學少精」：你凡事多想一步，興趣也鋪得廣。: The *Complete Book* says "hesitant in action, doubting much, learning much but mastering little": you always think one step further, and your interests spread wide.
sentences.巨門在命的基調是不接受表面說法：要問清楚、要想明白、對含糊的東西不安。: Ju Men in the Life Palace makes refusing to take things at face value your keynote: you have to ask, have to understand, and you're uneasy with anything vague.
sentences.這使它在需要辨析的地方很強，也使它在需要爽快的地方顯得囉嗦。: This makes you strong wherever analysis is needed, and long-winded wherever a quick answer is wanted.
sentences.「多學少精」的另一面是涉獵廣——深不深，要看它願不願意停在一件事上。: The other side of "learning much but mastering little" is breadth — how deep you go depends on whether you're willing to stay with one thing.
sentences.太陽的位置能不能照到它，往往比巨門自身的廟旺更關鍵。: Whether Tai Yang is placed to shine on Ju Men often matters more than Ju Men's own strength.
sentences.巨門在平輩關係裡的摩擦點：它把話說得準，而準話往往不好聽。: Among your peers, Ju Men has you say things precisely, and precise words are often hard to hear.
sentences.朋友之間的誤會多半不是它不在乎，是它指出了別人不想聽的部分。: Misunderstandings with friends usually aren't because you don't care, but because you pointed out what others didn't want to hear.
sentences.這使交情經得起爭論，卻不容易維持表面的和氣。: So your friendships can survive an argument, but rarely keep up a polite surface.
sentences.它是把問題攤開的那一個，而時機未必最好。: You're the one who lays the problem out, and the timing isn't always the best.
sentences.巨門在親密關係裡的模式：它要把事情講清楚，不喜歡含糊帶過。: In love, Ju Men has you need things said clearly, with nothing glossed over.
sentences.巨門要講清楚，使關係少有積壓的誤會，也使日常摩擦頻率偏高——因為不是每件事都需要: This means few buried misunderstandings, and also more everyday friction — because not everything needs spelling out.
sentences.它的在意常常以質疑的形式出現，而對方接收到的往往只有質疑那一半。: Your care often comes out as questioning, and a partner may hear the questioning rather than the care.
sentences.巨門對培養的方式：它教的是怎麼想，而不是怎麼做——問問題、拆前提、不接受「大家都: When you bring others up, Ju Men has you teach how to think, not what to do — ask questions, take assumptions apart, don't accept "everyone does it".
sentences.巨門教怎麼想，對後輩相當有價值，也容易讓對方覺得被挑剔。: Teaching how to think is very valuable to juniors, and can also make them feel picked on.
sentences.它表達關心的方式帶著檢查的形狀，所以先肯定再追問，是你值得練的一件事。: Your care takes the shape of inspection, so acknowledging first and probing second is worth practising.
sentences.巨門賺取資源的方式靠口與辨：講解、談判、把複雜的東西說明白。: Ju Men has you earn through words and analysis: explaining, negotiating, making complicated things clear.
sentences.它不靠本錢，靠的是別人搞不懂而它搞得懂，所以在沉默的環境裡發揮不出來。: You rely not on capital but on understanding what others can't, so you can't shine where no one speaks.
sentences.它的收入與表達機會綁得很緊。: Your income is closely tied to your chances to speak.
sentences.巨門的耗損來自反覆檢查——事情說完了還在想有沒有講錯，關係結束了還在想哪句話出了: What wears you down is going back over things — still wondering whether you said something wrong after the conversation is over, still wondering which remark did the damage after a relationship has ended.
sentences.巨門的消耗發生在事後，而且沒有明確的終點。: The drain comes afterwards, with no clear end point.
sentences.對它有用的是把話講到一個可以收的位置，而不是講到完全沒有疑問。: What helps is saying enough to close the matter, not enough to remove all doubt.
sentences.巨門在陌生環境需要更長時間建立信任，因為它的表達方式在不熟的人聽來容易帶刺。: Ju Men means you take longer to build trust in unfamiliar places, because the way you speak can sound prickly to people who don't know you.
sentences.一旦對方認識它，評價往往反過來。: Once people know you, their view often turns right round.
sentences.巨門在外的難處在前段，不在整體——這個分別在評估要不要換環境時相當重要。: Your difficulty away from home lies at the start, not throughout — a distinction that matters when you're weighing up whether to move.
sentences.巨門在群體裡是提出問題的那一個：它指得出漏洞，也因此被視為難搞。: Ju Men makes you the one in a group who raises the questions: you can find the holes, and you're seen as difficult for it.
sentences.它的價值通常在事後才被承認——當它指出的問題真的發生的時候。: Your value is usually only recognised afterwards — when the problem you pointed out actually happens.
sentences.你的課題是講的時機，不是講的內容。: Your task is the timing of what you say, not the content.
sentences.巨門的做事方式是先質疑再執行：它不接受不清楚的指令，也不願意做自己講不通的事——: Ju Men has you question first and act second: you won't accept unclear instructions or do anything that doesn't make sense to you — a principle, and a limitation.
sentences.它在需要審查、談判、教學的位置上極有用；在需要快速服從的位置上則格格不入。: You're extremely useful in roles that involve review, negotiation or teaching, and out of place where quick compliance is expected.
sentences.巨門對居所的態度：它在意的是條件講不講得清——合約、界線、權責。: With a home, Ju Men has you care whether the terms are clear — the contract, the boundaries, who is responsible for what.
sentences.它願意為一個地方花力氣研究，也容易因為細節不清而反覆，兩者是同一種認真。: You'll put effort into researching a place, and you'll go back and forth over unclear details; both come from the same thoroughness.
sentences.你的安定要等到疑問被解決——沒弄清楚的事會一直開著，而巨門很少有完全弄清楚的時候: You only settle once your questions are answered — anything unresolved stays open, and Ju Men rarely gets everything resolved.
sentences.所以它的精神消耗來自未解的問題數量，而不是事情的難度。: So your mental drain comes from the number of open questions, not how hard things are.
sentences.把問題寫下來、分類、承認某些暫時無解，比放鬆更有效：它要的不是不想，是想得完。: Writing the questions down, sorting them, and accepting that some have no answer yet works better than relaxing: what you want isn't to stop thinking but to finish thinking.
sentences.巨門會問為什麼，而且問得比多數人早。: Ju Men has you ask why, and earlier than most.
sentences.這使分歧攤在檯面上，少有暗流，也少有客套。: So disagreements are out on the table, with few undercurrents and little politeness.
sentences.它對制度的態度同樣如此——講得通就守，講不通就會一直追問下去。: It's the same with systems — you follow the rules that make sense and keep pressing on the ones that don't.
sentences.重點是你怎樣面對說不通的規矩。: What matters is how you deal with rules that don't make sense.
sentences.天相在命的基調是妥當：把事情辦得合規、讓各方都過得去、不留話柄。: Tian Xiang in the Life Palace makes doing things properly your keynote: by the rules, acceptable to everyone, leaving nothing to criticise.
sentences.它的長處是可靠，短處是缺少自己的主張——沒有依據的時候它不容易作主。: Your strength is reliability; the weakness is a lack of your own position — with no precedent to go on, you find it hard to decide.
sentences.天相坐命比其他星更受夾宮影響，因為印本身是中性的，關鍵在誰在用它。: Tian Xiang in the Life Palace is shaped by its neighbouring palaces more than other stars, because a seal is neutral in itself; what matters is who is using it.
sentences.天相在平輩關係裡的角色：它是協調的那一個，把不同的意見接上，讓場面不至於難看。: Among your peers, Tian Xiang makes you the coordinator, joining up different views and keeping things from turning awkward.
sentences.天相居中協調，使它在群體裡舒服，也使它少有鮮明的立場。: Coordinating from the middle makes you comfortable in a group, and leaves you with few clear positions.
sentences.朋友之間出現對立時，它通常兩邊都不得罪，而兩邊也都不太清楚它真正站哪一面。: When friends take sides, you usually offend neither, and neither is quite sure where you really stand.
sentences.天相在親密關係裡的方式：它重視相處的規矩——說好的事做到、該有的照顧不缺、場面上: In love, Tian Xiang has you value the ground rules — doing what was agreed, never missing the care that's due, never embarrassing your partner in front of others.
sentences.天相重規矩，使關係穩妥，也使真正的情緒較少被提起。: This keeps a relationship secure, and means real feelings are rarely raised.
sentences.它習慣用把事情辦好來代替講心事，久了對方可能覺得妥貼而不親近。: You tend to get things done instead of sharing what's on your mind, and over time a partner may feel well looked after but not close.
sentences.天相對培養的方式：它給的是規矩與示範——怎樣做才合宜、什麼場合要注意什麼。: When you bring others up, Tian Xiang has you give structure and example — how to do things properly, what to watch for on which occasion.
sentences.這種方式讓對方少走彎路，也可能讓對方習慣照章行事而少了自己判斷的機會。: This saves them detours, and can also get them so used to following the rules that they have fewer chances to judge for themselves.
sentences.天相的難處在於，它自己也不太擅長在沒有前例的情況下決定。: The difficulty is that Tian Xiang itself isn't good at deciding when there's no precedent.
sentences.天相處理資源的方式重秩序：帳目清楚、按時履約、不做超出規格的事。: Tian Xiang has you handle money in an orderly way: clear accounts, obligations met on time, nothing beyond the specification.
sentences.它不追求高回報，也較少出現失控的支出。: You don't chase high returns, and you rarely let spending get out of hand.
sentences.這使財務穩定，也使它較難把握需要果斷的機會。: This keeps your finances steady, and makes it harder for you to seize opportunities that call for decisiveness.
sentences.你的錢、你做的事、你在外面的樣子，是同一件事的三面。: Your money, your work and how you come across in the world are three sides of the same thing.
sentences.天相的耗損來自居中——它站在各方之間，替所有人把場面圓起來，而這份力氣沒有人計算: What wears you down is standing in the middle — between all sides, smoothing things over for everyone, with no one counting the effort.
sentences.它很少推掉請求，也很少表達為難。: You rarely turn down a request, and rarely say you're struggling.
sentences.你的疲勞屬於持續低度的那種，通常要旁人提醒它才察覺。: Your tiredness is the constant, low-level kind, usually only noticed when someone else points it out.
sentences.天相在陌生環境靠的是得體：進退有分寸、不冒犯、讓人願意給它機會。: Tian Xiang has you rely on good judgement in unfamiliar places: knowing when to step forward and when to hold back, giving no offence, so people want to give you a chance.
sentences.它適應新場合不難，難的是在新場合建立自己的主張——沒有既有的規矩可依時，它需要更: Adapting to a new setting isn't hard for you; establishing your own position there is — with no existing rules to follow, you take longer to find your place.
sentences.它需要規矩，而新地方通常還沒有。: You need rules, and a new place usually doesn't have them yet.
sentences.天相在群體裡是讓事情運作下去的那一個：協調、居中、把流程接上。: Tian Xiang makes you the one who keeps a group running: coordinating, mediating, joining up the process.
sentences.它被需要的程度很高，被記住的程度未必——因為它做的事多半是預防問題，而預防了的問: You're needed a great deal and not always remembered — because most of what you do prevents problems, and no one sees problems that were prevented.
sentences.它的貢獻要在出事的時候才看得出來。: Your contribution only shows when something goes wrong.
sentences.天相的做事方式是依規格執行：它把制度用得好，也守得住。: Tian Xiang has you work to the specification: you make good use of the system and keep it intact.
sentences.這在結構清楚、有前例可循的位置上極合用；在需要從零定義規則的位置上則使不上力。: This is ideal in clearly structured roles with precedents to follow, and struggles to get a grip where the rules have to be defined from scratch.
sentences.天相對居所的態度重體面與合規：手續齊、鄰里相處得來、不出紕漏，比空間本身的喜好更: Tian Xiang has you want a home done properly and by the rules: complete paperwork, good relations with the neighbours and nothing going wrong matter more to you than your own taste in space.
sentences.它願意為妥當付出額外的成本，也不容易接受有瑕疵的安排。: You'll pay extra for things to be right, and you struggle to accept an arrangement with flaws.
sentences.天相的安定來自秩序——事情各就各位、關係沒有懸著的糾紛、該有的都齊備。: You find calm in order — everything in its place, no disputes hanging over your relationships, everything that should be there present.
sentences.它不需要刺激，但需要沒有亂。: You don't need excitement, but you do need the absence of muddle.
sentences.所以真正令它不安的不是忙，是不確定：規矩改了、角色模糊了、不知道誰該負責，這些比: So what really unsettles you isn't being busy but uncertainty: changed rules, blurred roles, not knowing who's responsible — these drain you more than workload.
sentences.福德與財帛正對，一個講內在的滿足，一個講外在的資源；對你而言，秩序本身就是一種資: The Wellbeing Palace sits opposite the Wealth Palace, one about inner contentment and the other about outer resources; for you, order is itself a resource.
sentences.天相尊重程序，也擅長在程序裡把事情辦成。: Tian Xiang has you respect procedure and get things done within it.
sentences.它很少正面違逆，也很少偷偷繞路——它的方式是照規矩來，然後在規矩允許的範圍內爭取: You rarely defy anyone openly, and rarely sneak around — your way is to follow the rules, then push for what they allow.
sentences.文書與正式場合上，它做得比多數人周全。: With paperwork and formal occasions, you're more thorough than most.
sentences.這使它可靠，也使它承擔的分量長期偏多——因為別人知道找它有用。: This makes you reliable, and also leaves you carrying more than your share over the long run — because people know you're worth asking.
sentences.它不容易開口求助，這一點與它的樂於給予是同一件事。: You find it hard to ask for help, and that comes from the same place as your readiness to give.
sentences.天梁在平輩關係裡的位置：它是被依靠的那一個。: Among your peers, Tian Liang makes you the one others lean on.
sentences.朋友有難第一個想到它，而它很少推。: When friends are in trouble, you're the first one they think of, and you rarely refuse.
sentences.天梁被依靠，使它在群體裡有分量，也使關係長期不對等——它知道所有人的難處，而它自: Being leaned on gives you weight in a group, and also leaves relationships unequal for a long time — you know everyone's troubles, and rarely tell anyone your own.
sentences.你的課題是接受別人也可以照顧你。: Your task is accepting that others can look after you too.
sentences.天梁在親密關係裡的方式：它照顧、承擔、把難處接過來，很自然地站在給予的一方。: In love, Tian Liang has you care, carry and take on difficulties, naturally standing on the giving side.
sentences.這使關係穩固，也容易形成長輩式的相處——它替對方著想，卻少有把自己的需要放上檯面: This makes a relationship solid, and can also make it feel parental — you think for your partner, but rarely put your own needs on the table.
sentences.對方感受到的常常是被照顧而不是被需要。: What your partner often feels is cared for rather than needed.
sentences.天梁對培養的姿態：它給的是保護與原則——替對方擋掉風險，同時要求對方守住某些底線: When you bring others up, Tian Liang has you give protection and principle — shielding them from risk while expecting them to hold certain lines.
sentences.天梁又擋風險又守底線，讓人安心，也可能讓對方少了一次自己承擔後果的經驗。: Shielding and holding the line reassures them, and may also cost them a chance to bear the consequences themselves.
sentences.天梁的難處是分得清什麼該擋、什麼該讓對方自己撞一次。: Your difficulty is telling what to shield them from and what to let them run into once.
sentences.天梁處理資源的方式帶著照顧性：它願意在別人身上花錢，對自己反而樸素。: Tian Liang has you handle money with others in mind: happy to spend on others, frugal with yourself.
sentences.它不太進取，也不太計較，資源多半來自穩定的來源而不是機會。: You're not especially ambitious or calculating, and your money mostly comes from steady sources rather than opportunities.
sentences.它的財務節奏偏慢而穩，少有大起大落。: Your finances move slowly and steadily, with few big rises or falls.
sentences.天梁的耗損來自替別人扛——它接得太自然，以至於自己也不覺得那是負擔。: What wears you down is carrying things for others — you take them on so naturally that you don't even feel the weight.
sentences.天梁的消耗沒有邊界，因為別人的事永遠有下一件。: The drain has no limit, because there's always another person's problem.
sentences.對你有用的不是休息，是學會說這件事不歸我。: What helps you isn't rest but learning to say: this isn't mine to carry.
sentences.天梁在陌生環境往往遇到願意提攜它的人，原因不難理解：它可靠、講原則、不會給人添麻: Tian Liang often brings you people willing to help you along in unfamiliar places, and it's easy to see why: you're reliable, principled and never make trouble for anyone.
sentences.它在外的適應不靠圓滑，靠的是讓人放心。: You adapt away from home not by being smooth but by being trustworthy.
sentences.難處是它到了新地方也很快變成那個被依靠的人，於是負擔跟著搬過去。: The difficulty is that wherever you go, you soon become the one everyone leans on, so the burden moves with you.
sentences.天梁在群體裡是主持公道的那一個：它願意出面、願意說難聽的話、也願意替人善後。: Tian Liang makes you the one who keeps a group fair: you'll step forward, say the hard thing and clean up after others.
sentences.天梁出面主持公道，使它受敬重，卻不一定受親近——因為原則明確的人，別人不太敢在你: Standing up for fairness earns you respect but not necessarily closeness — people don't quite dare relax in front of someone with such clear principles.
sentences.它承接的分量長期偏多，而這份力氣不會出現在任何人的帳上。: Over the long run you carry more than your share, and that effort never appears in anyone's accounts.
sentences.天梁的做事方式是守住規矩再談成果：它適合需要判斷是非、需要有人負責的位置，也適合: Tian Liang has you keep to the rules first and talk about results after: you suit roles that call for judging right and wrong and for someone to take responsibility, and also teaching and oversight.
sentences.相對地，在需要靈活變通或快速取巧的環境裡，它會顯得固執。: By contrast, where flexibility or quick shortcuts are needed, you come across as stubborn.
sentences.固執與有原則是同一種性質，處境不同評價就不同。: Stubbornness and principle are the same quality, judged differently depending on the situation.
sentences.天梁對居所的態度帶著責任感：它想的是這個地方能不能安頓一家人，而不只是自己住得好: Tian Liang has you approach home with a sense of responsibility: you think about whether a place can settle a whole household, not just whether it suits you.
sentences.它願意為長輩或家人的需要調整安排，也較少純粹為自己的喜好決定。: You'll rearrange things for the needs of elders or family, and you rarely decide purely on what you'd like.
sentences.天梁的安定條件：它需要覺得自己做的事是對的。: With Tian Liang here, you need to feel that what you're doing is right before you can settle.
sentences.不是被讚，是自己那一關過得去。: Not praise, but being able to live with itself.
sentences.所以它在吃虧的時候未必難受，在違背原則的時候卻很難安。: So losing out doesn't necessarily upset you, but going against your principles leaves you uneasy.
sentences.真正消耗它的是明知不對卻要配合的處境。: What really drains you is having to go along with something you know is wrong.
sentences.天梁講道理，而且相當堅持——它不會為了息事寧人而放棄自己認為對的事。: Tian Liang has you argue from principle and hold firm — you won't give up what you think is right just to keep the peace.
sentences.這使關係坦白，摩擦也集中在原則問題上，而不是態度問題上。: This keeps relationships honest, with friction centred on principles rather than attitudes.
sentences.它對制度的態度同樣：守規矩，但不接受不合理的規矩。: It's the same with systems: you keep the rules, but won't accept unreasonable ones.
sentences.在正式場合和文書上，你通常相當認真。: On formal occasions and with paperwork, you're usually very conscientious.
sentences.《全書》寫「目大性急，喜怒無常，作事進退沈吟」：你性子急，做決定前卻會反覆掂量。: The *Complete Book* says "large eyes, a quick temper, moods that change without warning, hesitant in action": you're quick-tempered, yet you weigh things over and over before deciding.
sentences.七殺在命的基調是自己扛：不解釋、不等人、遇到阻力先硬過去。: Qi Sha in the Life Palace makes carrying things yourself your keynote: no explaining, no waiting, pushing straight through resistance.
sentences.這使它推得動別人推不動的事，也使它習慣把距離拉開。: This lets you move what others can't, and also makes you used to keeping your distance.
sentences.這是一種距離感，不是命運上的孤獨。: It's a sense of distance, not loneliness written into your life.
sentences.它需要的是被引導，而不是被壓制。: What you need is guidance, not suppression.
sentences.七殺在平輩關係裡的距離：它不擅長閒聊，也不太主動維繫，關係要靠共事累積。: Among your peers, Qi Sha keeps you at a distance: small talk and keeping in touch don't come naturally, so your relationships build up through working together.
sentences.這使它朋友不多而分量重——留下來的多半是一起扛過事情的人。: So you have few friends, but they count — the ones who stay are mostly people you've carried something heavy with.
sentences.它很少開口求援，於是旁人也很少知道它有需要。: You rarely ask for help, so others rarely know when you need it.
sentences.共事累積的交情，散得比一般慢。: Friendships built through working together fade more slowly than most.
sentences.七殺在親密關係裡的方式：它把承擔當作表達，情緒上的交流則相當節制。: In love, Qi Sha has you show care by taking on responsibility, while keeping emotional talk to a minimum.
sentences.它不解釋自己，也預設對方應該懂。: You don't explain yourself, and you assume your partner should understand.
sentences.七殺的關係裡，落差常常是：一方以為自己已經給了很多，另一方覺得完全不知道對方在想: With Qi Sha, the gap in your relationships is often this: you believe you've given a great deal, while the other person has no idea what you're thinking.
sentences.它的節制不是冷淡，是表達的形狀不同。: Your restraint isn't coldness; your feelings just take a different shape.
sentences.七殺對培養的方式：它要求對方自己站起來，不太提供緩衝。: When you bring others up, Qi Sha has you expect them to find their own feet, with little cushioning.
sentences.這種方式練得出韌性，也可能讓對方在最需要支持的時候感覺被留下。: This builds resilience, and may also leave them feeling abandoned just when they most need support.
sentences.七殺的難處是它自己就是這樣長大的，所以看不出為什麼別人需要多一點扶。: The difficulty is that this is how you grew up yourself, so you can't see why others need more of a hand.
sentences.《全書》寫「白手生財成家」：你的錢多半靠自己一手打出來。: The *Complete Book* says "makes money and a home from nothing": your money is mostly earned with your own hands.
sentences.七殺賺取資源靠自己開局：不靠背景、不靠人脈，也不太願意合夥。: Qi Sha has you earn by starting things yourself: no family backing, no connections, and little appetite for partnership.
sentences.這使它的財務獨立性高，波動也高——所有風險都在自己身上。: This makes your finances highly independent and highly volatile — every risk sits on your own shoulders.
sentences.七殺的耗損來自不肯停——它把不舒服當作要克服的東西，而不是要處理的訊號。: What wears you down is refusing to stop — you treat discomfort as something to overcome rather than a signal to deal with.
sentences.七殺不肯停，使它能撐很久，也使它撐到最後才知道已經過頭。: Refusing to stop lets you last a long time, and also means you only realise you've gone too far at the very end.
sentences.對你而言，提早承認比任何休息的技巧都有用。: For you, admitting it early is worth more than any way of resting.
sentences.七殺在外面比在原地有力：陌生環境沒有包袱，也沒有人替它決定該怎麼做。: Qi Sha makes you stronger out in the world than at home: unfamiliar places carry no baggage, and no one is there to decide for you.
sentences.它在外開局快，適應靠的是硬碰硬而不是討好。: You get going quickly away from home, adapting by meeting things head-on rather than by pleasing people.
sentences.難處是這種方式消耗大，而它通常不會中途調整。: The difficulty is that this costs a lot, and you usually won't change course halfway.
sentences.七殺在群體裡的位置：它靠結果說話，不靠關係。: In a group, Qi Sha has you let results do the talking, not connections.
sentences.人們敬它、用它，未必親近它，而它自己也不太經營這一塊。: People respect you and rely on you, but don't necessarily get close, and you don't work on that side of things either.
sentences.於是它在組織裡的分量與它的人緣未必成正比，而這一點它自己並不在意。: So your weight in an organisation doesn't necessarily match your popularity, and you don't mind.
sentences.它在共事上贏得的信任，未必換得到私下的靠近，兩者本來就不是同一回事。: The trust you earn at work doesn't necessarily turn into closeness; they were never the same thing.
sentences.七殺的做事方式是開局與攻堅：它適合需要有人扛下來的位置，也適合從無到有。: Qi Sha makes you best at starting things and breaking through hard problems: you suit roles where someone has to take the weight, and building from nothing.
sentences.相對地，需要長期維持、講究人情往來的位置會磨掉它。: By contrast, roles built on long-term upkeep and keeping people sweet will wear you down.
sentences.《全書》卷二說七殺「遇帝為權」，提醒的是它需要方向。: Book Two of the *Complete Book* says Qi Sha "gains authority when it meets the Emperor", a reminder that your drive needs direction.
sentences.七殺對居所的態度：它不太把心思放在這裡。: With Qi Sha here, you don't give your home much thought.
sentences.夠用就好，佈置與氣氛都不是重點，而且它隨時可以搬。: Enough is enough, decor and atmosphere don't matter, and you could move at any time.
sentences.歸屬感對它而言不來自空間，來自正在做的事。: For you, belonging comes not from a place but from whatever you're working on.
sentences.《全書》寫「七殺同欠安康」：閒下來，對你未必是休息。: The *Complete Book* says Qi Sha here is "short of ease": free time isn't necessarily rest for you.
sentences.七殺的安定條件：它需要有一件硬仗在打。: With Qi Sha here, you settle best with a hard fight on your hands.
sentences.閒下來對它不是休息，是一種沒有著力點的浮動。: Free time isn't rest for you; it's drifting with nothing to push against.
sentences.所以它的精神狀態與挑戰的難度正相關，而不是負相關。: So your peace of mind rises with the difficulty of the challenge rather than falling.
sentences.真正令它不安的是被閒置，不是被壓力壓住。: What really unsettles you is being left idle, not being under pressure.
sentences.福德與財帛正對，一個講內在的滿足，一個講外在的資源，兩者互為背面。: The Wellbeing Palace sits opposite the Wealth Palace, one about inner contentment and the other about outer resources, each the reverse of the other.
sentences.七殺不服軟，也不擅長迂迴——認為不對就不配合，而且不會花時間解釋。: Qi Sha makes you unwilling to soften your position once you believe something is wrong — you won't cooperate, and you won't spend time explaining.
sentences.七殺不服軟，使和長輩的關係緊張而清楚。: Not backing down makes relationships with elders tense, though clear.
sentences.它對制度的態度同樣直接：合用就用，不合用就自己另開一條路。: You're just as direct with systems: you use what works, and open your own path when nothing does.
sentences.在正式程序和文書上，你往往最不耐煩。: Formal procedures and paperwork are where you're least patient.
sentences.《全書》寫「性剛寡合，好爭強」：你不輕易合群，也不輕易認輸。: The *Complete Book* says "firm, rarely fitting in, keen to win": you don't easily blend in, and you don't easily concede.
sentences.破軍在命的基調是換：舊的不合用就拆掉重來，哪怕代價不小。: Po Jun in the Life Palace makes change your keynote: when the old way stops working, you tear it down and start again, however high the cost.
sentences.它不安於現狀，也不太留戀已經有的東西。: You aren't content with how things are, and you aren't attached to what you already have.
sentences.耗在古文裡指消耗而非虧損——它願意付出成本去換一個新局面，這是長處也是風險。: In the classical texts Po Jun's nature of "expenditure" means spending rather than loss — you'll pay a price for a fresh start, which is both a strength and a risk.
sentences.破軍在平輩關係裡的節奏：它交朋友快，散得也快，因為它的生活本身一直在換階段。: Among your peers, Po Jun has you make friends quickly and lose them just as quickly, because your life keeps moving to new stages.
sentences.每換一次，身邊的人就換一批。: With each change, the people around it change too.
sentences.破軍散得快不是薄情，是它的重心移動得比多數人頻密。: Losing touch quickly isn't coldness; your centre of gravity simply shifts more often than most people's.
sentences.留得住的關係，通常是那些跟得上它換法的人。: The relationships that last are usually with people who can keep up with your changes.
sentences.破軍在親密關係裡的模式：它投入時全力以赴，遇到僵局則傾向於整個拆掉重談，而不是慢: In love, Po Jun has you give everything when you commit, and at a deadlock you tend to tear it all down and start the conversation again rather than mend things slowly.
sentences.破軍拆掉重談，使關係少有拖延的暗傷，也使波動比一般大。: This leaves few lingering hidden wounds, and also makes a relationship swing more than most.
sentences.對方感受到的常常是強度，而不是穩定。: What a partner often feels is intensity rather than steadiness.
sentences.破軍對培養的方式：它鼓勵對方走自己的路，甚至樂見對方推翻它的做法。: When you bring others up, Po Jun has you encourage them to go their own way, and you're even pleased when they overturn your methods.
sentences.破軍這樣帶人，給的自由度很高，也可能讓對方缺少一個穩定的參照。: This gives them a great deal of freedom, and may also leave them without a steady reference point.
sentences.破軍的難處在於，它自己不斷在換，而被帶的一方需要的往往是不變的那一部分。: The difficulty is that you keep changing, while those you bring up often need the part that stays the same.
sentences.破軍處理資源的方式是投進去換局面：它敢下重注，也敢認賠出場。: Po Jun has you put money in to change the situation: you'll make a big bet, and you'll also cut your losses and walk away.
sentences.破軍敢下重注，使它的財務起伏遠大於守成型的星，而起伏的原因是選擇。: Making big bets makes your finances swing far more than steadier stars would, and the swings come from your choices.
sentences.破軍的耗損來自不斷重來——每一次推翻都要重新投入一次，而它推翻的頻率比多數人高。: What wears you down is starting over again and again — each overhaul means investing afresh, and you overhaul more often than most.
sentences.這種消耗是週期性的：一段時間極耗，之後短暫平靜，然後再起。: The drain comes in cycles: an exhausting stretch, a short calm, then it starts again.
sentences.對它有用的是拉長週期，而不是減少強度。: What helps is spacing out the cycles, not lowering the intensity.
sentences.破軍在外面能開得出局面：新環境沒有既有的規矩綁著它，正合它的性。: Po Jun lets you open things up out in the world: new places have no existing rules to tie you down, which suits your nature.
sentences.它換地方的心理成本低，甚至把搬動當作重啟。: Moving costs you little mentally, and you even treat a move as a reset.
sentences.難處是新局面開出來之後，維持的部分它未必接得住。: The difficulty is that once something new has opened up, keeping it going isn't always something you can hold.
sentences.《全書》寫「入廟得力，陷宮招怨背主」：你在群體裡，不是得力，就是招怨。: The *Complete Book* says "capable when strong; when weak, resented and disloyal": in a group, you're either a great asset or a source of resentment.
sentences.破軍在群體裡是帶頭改變的那一個：它提得出新做法，也承擔得起反對。: Po Jun makes you the one who leads change in a group: you can propose new ways of doing things and bear the opposition.
sentences.這使它有一批跟隨的人，同時有一批被它衝撞過的人。: So you have your followers, and also people you've run up against.
sentences.它的人際輪廓因此鮮明。: Your social outline is sharp as a result.
sentences.《全書》寫「廟旺武職軒勝」：在需要衝鋒的位置，你最能出頭。: The *Complete Book* says "strong, it excels in martial office": you stand out most where someone has to charge ahead.
sentences.破軍的做事方式是打破現狀：它適合需要重整、需要有人推翻舊做法的位置，不適合維持既: Po Jun has you break the status quo: you suit roles that call for reorganisation and for someone to overturn old ways, not roles that keep the existing order.
sentences.它開得了頭，收尾則往往要交給別人。: You can start things, but finishing them often falls to someone else.
sentences.它開得了頭，收尾往往要交給別人，安排分工時值得先想清楚。: You can start things, but finishing often falls to others, which is worth thinking through when the work is shared out.
sentences.破軍對居所的態度是不斷調整：搬、改、換，很少長期停在同一個安排。: Po Jun has you keep adjusting your home: moving, remodelling, swapping, rarely staying with one arrangement for long.
sentences.空間對它而言是可以動的東西，不是要守住的東西。: To you, a space is something to change, not something to hold on to.
sentences.這使它的居住狀態變化多，也使長期的歸屬感較薄。: So your living situation changes a lot, and your long-term sense of belonging is thinner.
sentences.破軍的安定來自有東西在變——停滯對它是一種壓迫，比忙碌難受得多。: You find calm in something changing — standing still feels oppressive, far harder than being busy.
sentences.所以它常常在事情剛穩下來的時候開始不安，然後動手改動。: So you often grow restless just as things settle down, and start changing them.
sentences.你的課題不是學會休息，是分辨哪一次不安是真的需要改，哪一次只是它習慣了改。: Your task isn't learning to rest but telling when restlessness really calls for change and when it's just your habit of changing.
sentences.你要練的是分辨，不是壓抑。: What you need to practise is telling the difference, not holding yourself back.
sentences.破軍不接受因為一向如此這個理由，它要的是說得通。: Po Jun makes "it's always been this way" unconvincing to you; it has to make sense.
sentences.它對制度的態度是能改就改，改不了就走。: Your attitude to systems is to change what you can and leave what you can't.
sentences.你對既定程序的耐性一向不高。: You've never had much patience for set procedures.
sentences.它比多數人早就自己另開一條路。: You open your own path earlier than most.
sentences.這使它與傳統的關係緊張，也使它比多數人早離開既定的路。: This sets you against tradition, and makes you leave the set path earlier than most.
sentences.命宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Life Palace.
sentences.你要做成一件事，通常得先處理一批不在計畫內的東西。: To get something done, you usually have to deal with a batch of things that weren't in the plan first.

sentences.兄弟宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Siblings Palace.

sentences.夫妻宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Partnership Palace.

sentences.子女宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Children Palace.

sentences.財帛宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Wealth Palace.
sentences.資源進出的條件較多，來路和去路往往不在同一條線上。: Your money rarely moves in a straight line: what comes in and what goes out tend to follow different paths.
sentences.疾厄宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Health Palace.
sentences.你身上同時扛著的事情條件較多，回氣的空檔不容易連在一起。: You usually carry several things at once, and the gaps for catching your breath rarely join up.
sentences.遷移宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Travel Palace.
sentences.在陌生的環境裡要應付的條件較多，離開熟悉的地方之後，重新架起節奏往往要花時間。: There's more to handle in unfamiliar surroundings, and after leaving familiar ground it usually takes time to find your rhythm again.
sentences.僕役宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Friends Palace.
sentences.人群裡的來往條件較多，親疏的界線不容易一次劃清。: In groups, you rarely find your footing all at once; the line between close and distant is hard to draw once and for all.
sentences.官祿宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Career Palace.
sentences.做事這件事在你這裡條件較多：要成一件事，往往得先把不相干的東西擺平。: Your work rarely stands on its own: to get one thing done, you often have to settle unrelated matters first.
sentences.田宅宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Property Palace.
sentences.與住的地方、與家的關係條件較多，要安頓下來通常不是一次到位。: You rarely settle into a home in one go; where you live and how you relate to family both take some working out.
sentences.福德宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Wellbeing Palace.

sentences.父母宮的三方四正見多顆煞曜。: Several harsh stars fall in the four directions of the Parents Palace.

sentences.命宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Life Palace.

sentences.兄弟宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Siblings Palace.

sentences.夫妻宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Partnership Palace.
sentences.親密關係裡的條件相對配合，話說得出口、事情擺得上檯面。: Conditions in a close relationship are relatively favourable: things can be said and put on the table.
sentences.子女宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Children Palace.
sentences.你在培育一件事或一個人的時候，手上可用的東西比較多，不必事事親力親為。: When you're nurturing a project or a person, you have more to work with, and you don't have to do everything yourself.
sentences.財帛宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Wealth Palace.
sentences.資源的來路相對通，要張羅一件事的時候，可調動的東西比較多。: Money flows in relatively freely, and when you need to organise something, there's more you can draw on.
sentences.疾厄宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Health Palace.
sentences.你手上通常留得住一點餘力，不至於所有事情同時壓到底。: You can usually keep a little strength in reserve, so everything doesn't press down at once.
sentences.遷移宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Travel Palace.
sentences.在外面的條件相對配合，到一個新地方，通常不必太久就接得上線。: Conditions away from home are relatively favourable; in a new place, it usually doesn't take long to make connections.
sentences.僕役宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Friends Palace.
sentences.人群裡的來往相對通，要接上一條線、找到一個人，路徑比較短。: Dealings within a group flow relatively freely; making a connection or finding someone takes fewer steps.
sentences.官祿宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Career Palace.
sentences.做事的條件相對配合：要推一件事，願意接的人通常找得到。: Conditions at work are relatively favourable: when you want to push something forward, you can usually find people willing to take it on.
sentences.田宅宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Property Palace.
sentences.要安頓下來，阻力比較小：住處和家裡的事，多半順手。: Settling in meets less resistance: matters of home and household mostly go smoothly.
sentences.福德宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Wellbeing Palace.
sentences.內在有比較多可以安放自己的地方，靜下來不必等所有事情都處理完。: You have more places inside to rest in, and quietening down doesn't have to wait until everything is dealt with.
sentences.父母宮的三方四正見多顆吉曜。: Several helpful stars fall in the four directions of the Parents Palace.
sentences.與長輩、與權威之間相對談得通，要交代一件事的路徑比較直接。: Things are relatively easy to talk through with elders and authority, and the route for explaining something is more direct.
sentences.你花力氣的方向，通常就是別人形容你的那個方向：先天的基調和後天著力的地方在同一處: Where you put your effort is usually the same way others would describe you: your inborn keynote and where you apply yourself sit in the same place.
sentences.你把力氣放在關係上：一段關係的狀態，容易帶動你整個人的狀態。: You put your effort into relationships: the state of a relationship easily sets the state of your whole self.
sentences.你把力氣放在資源上：處理實際的東西，是你安放自己的方式。: You put your effort into resources: dealing with practical things is how you find your footing.
sentences.你把力氣放在外面：在陌生的地方，比在熟悉的地方更用得上勁。: You put your effort outwards: you can apply yourself better in unfamiliar places than in familiar ones.
sentences.你把力氣放在做事上：手上有沒有一件正在推的事，很大程度決定你的狀態。: You put your effort into work: whether you have something under way largely decides how you are.
sentences.你把力氣放在內在：安不安頓，比做成了甚麼更影響你的狀態。: You put your effort inwards: whether you feel settled affects you more than what you've achieved.
sentences.命宮沒有主星，要借對宮的遷移宮來看。: The Life Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Travel Palace opposite.
sentences.這不是弱，是說你的基調比較多由所處的環境帶出來：換一個場合，別人看到的你可以差得: This isn't weakness; it means your keynote is drawn out more by your surroundings — in a different setting, people can see a very different you.
sentences.兄弟宮沒有主星，要借對宮的僕役宮來看。: The Siblings Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Friends Palace opposite.

sentences.這是結構，不是疏離。: This is how your chart is built, not a sign of distance.
