sentences.親密關係這一塊沒有自己的定調，容易跟著你做事的狀態走。: Close relationships have no keynote of their own and tend to follow how things are going at work.
sentences.子女宮沒有主星，要借對宮的田宅宮來看。: The Children Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Property Palace opposite.
sentences.你對下一代、對創造的態度，比較多跟著你安頓自己的方式走。: Your attitude to the next generation and to creating things tends to follow the way you settle yourself.
sentences.財帛宮沒有主星，要借對宮的福德宮來看。: The Wealth Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Wellbeing Palace opposite.
sentences.你與資源的關係沒有自己的定調，比較多由你想要什麼樣的生活帶出來。: Your relationship with money has no keynote of its own; it's drawn out more by the kind of life you want.
sentences.疾厄宮沒有主星，要借對宮的父母宮來看。: The Health Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Parents Palace opposite.
sentences.你身上的壓力形狀不固定，比較多由外部的要求決定。: The shape of the pressure on you isn't fixed; it's decided more by demands from outside.
sentences.遷移宮沒有主星，要借對宮的命宮來看。: The Travel Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Life Palace opposite.
sentences.在外面的樣子沒有另外一套，基本上就是你本來的樣子拿到陌生的地方用。: You don't have a separate self for the wider world; it's essentially who you are, taken somewhere unfamiliar.
sentences.這是結構，不是好壞。: This is how your chart is built, not a verdict of good or bad.
sentences.僕役宮沒有主星，要借對宮的兄弟宮來看。: The Friends Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Siblings Palace opposite.
sentences.你在人群裡的位置，比較多沿用你和平輩相處的那一套。: Your place in a group largely follows the way you relate to your peers.
sentences.官祿宮沒有主星，要借對宮的夫妻宮來看。: The Career Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Partnership Palace opposite.
sentences.你做事的定調不在事情本身，而在你和身邊那個人的狀態裡。: The keynote of your work lies not in the work itself but in how things stand between you and the person beside you.
sentences.田宅宮沒有主星，要借對宮的子女宮來看。: The Property Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Children Palace opposite.
sentences.你與家、與空間的關係，比較多由你想培育什麼帶出來。: Your relationship with home and space is drawn out more by what you want to nurture.
sentences.這是結構，不等同於買不買樓。: This is how your chart is built; it says nothing about whether you'll buy property.
sentences.福德宮沒有主星，要借對宮的財帛宮來看。: The Wellbeing Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Wealth Palace opposite.
sentences.內在安放自己的方式沒有另外一套，比較多繫在實際的東西上。: You don't have a separate way of finding inner rest; it's tied more to practical things.
sentences.父母宮沒有主星，要借對宮的疾厄宮來看。: The Parents Palace has no major star, so it is read through the Health Palace opposite.
sentences.與長輩、與權威的相處結構不固定，比較多跟著你當時的負荷走。: How you deal with elders and authority isn't fixed; it follows how much you're carrying at the time.
sentences.這一組星形成君臣慶會：主導的一方和輔佐的一方同時到位。: These stars form the pattern of Ruler and Ministers in Celebration: the one who leads and the ones who support are both in place.
sentences.《全書》記這個組合，講的是有人可用，不是必然得位；能不能用得上，仍然在於你肯不肯: The *Complete Book* records this pairing as having people to call on, not as being sure of position; whether you make use of them still depends on whether you'll let others step in.
sentences.這一組星形成輔弼夾帝：主導的位置左右都有支撐，結構是完整的。: These stars form the pattern of Aides Flanking the Emperor: the leading position is supported on both sides, and the structure is complete.
sentences.意思是站得穩，不是走得快；一個完整的結構同樣可以停在原地。: This means standing firm, not moving fast; a complete structure can just as easily stay where it is.
sentences.這一組星形成魁鉞同行：機會和引薦容易出現，你做的事比較容易被看見。: These stars form the pattern of the Noble Helpers Travelling Together: opportunities and introductions come easily, and what you do is more easily seen.
sentences.意思是可見度，不是評價；被看見和被認可是兩件事。: This means visibility, not judgement; being seen and being recognised are two different things.
sentences.這一組星形成祿馬交馳：資源跟著走動流轉，動起來比守著更容易得力。: These stars form the pattern of Abundance and the Horse Racing Together: resources move with you, and moving gets you further than holding still.
sentences.這一組星形成日麗中天：照得出去，位置顯眼，你做的事不容易無聲無息。: These stars form the pattern of the Sun at Midday: your light carries, your position is prominent, and what you do rarely goes unnoticed.
sentences.意思是可見度高，代價是同樣看得見的，還有沒做好的部分。: This means high visibility; the trade-off is that the parts you didn't do well are just as visible.
sentences.這一組星形成水澄桂萼：收納得地，積累的過程比較順。: These stars form the pattern of Clear Water and Cassia Blossom: you store things well, and building up comes smoothly.
sentences.意思是累積這件事對你不費力，但累積和用得上，中間還隔著一步。: This means building up comes easily to you, but there's still a step between having and using.
sentences.這一組星形成善蔭朝綱：轉圜的餘地和照顧他人的傾向並存。: These stars form the pattern of Kindly Shelter at Court: room to manoeuvre sits alongside a tendency to look after others.
sentences.意思是你手上通常留得住一條路，但那條路多數也留給了別人。: This means you can usually keep a way out in hand, though you often leave it for someone else.
sentences.這一組星形成財居財位：處理資源這件事在本位上，做起來順手。: These stars form the pattern of Wealth in the Wealth Seat: handling money is in its natural place, and comes easily.
sentences.意思是手感，不是數目；順手的人一樣可以把事情做得太滿。: This means a feel for it, not an amount; someone with the knack can still overdo it.
sentences.這一組星形成貴入貴鄉：被提攜的機會來得早。: These stars form the pattern of Nobility in its Home: chances to be helped up come early.
sentences.意思是時機，不是結果；早來的機會同樣需要你當時接得住。: This means timing, not outcome; an early chance still needs you to be ready to take it.
sentences.這一組星形成皇殿朝班：呈現和可見度兼備，成果說得出口。: These stars form the pattern of Ministers at the Imperial Hall: presentation and visibility together, with results you can point to.
sentences.意思是表達的條件，不是成果本身的份量。: This means the conditions for showing your work, not the weight of the work itself.
sentences.這一組星形成蟾宮折桂：細緻和表達兩樣兼備。: These stars form the pattern of Plucking Cassia in the Moon Palace: refinement and expression together.
sentences.意思是能力的組合，不是名次。: This means a combination of abilities, not a ranking.
sentences.這一組星形成堆金積玉：資源留得住，守得穩。: These stars form the pattern of Piled Gold and Jade: resources stay with you, and are kept safe.
sentences.意思是留存的傾向，不涉及金額；守得穩的人，放手的時候通常也比較慢。: This means a tendency to hold on, with no amount implied; people who hold steady are usually slower to let go as well.
sentences.這一組星形成財蔭坐遷移：在外得助，庇護多數來自外部。: These stars form the pattern of Wealth and Shelter in the Travel Palace: help comes away from home, and most protection comes from outside.
sentences.意思是助力的來源在外面，不預測你會不會離開熟悉的地方。: This means your support comes from outside; it makes no prediction about whether you'll leave familiar ground.
sentences.這一組星形成玉袖天香：精神生活有寄託，品味是它的外顯。: These stars form the pattern of Jade Sleeves and Heavenly Fragrance: your inner life has something to rest on, and taste is its outward sign.
sentences.這一組星形成火貪。: These stars form the Fire and Wolf pattern.
sentences.《全書》火星歌記「若得貪狼會，旺地貴無倫」，說的是機會來得猛、來得急。: The *Complete Book*'s verse on Huo Xing says that "meeting Tan Lang in a strong place brings matchless honour", describing opportunities that come hard and fast.
sentences.急的另一面是短：來得快的東西，走得也快。: The other side of fast is short: what comes quickly also goes quickly.
sentences.這一組星形成鈴貪。: These stars form the Bell and Wolf pattern.
sentences.《全書》鈴星歌記「若與貪狼會，指日立邊庭」，同樣說驟發。: The *Complete Book*'s verse on Ling Xing says that "meeting Tan Lang, it soon stands at the frontier", likewise describing a sudden rise.
sentences.這描述的是節奏不是份量，而驟發之後怎樣接住，盤上答不到。: This describes the pace, not the size, and how to hold on after a sudden rise is something the chart can't answer.
sentences.命宮與遷移宮正對，又與財帛宮、官祿宮連成一組：你是誰、你怎樣賺、你做什麼、你在外: The Life Palace sits opposite the Travel Palace and forms a group with the Wealth and Career Palaces: who you are, how you earn, what you do and how you appear in the world need to be read together.
sentences.單看一宮會得出沒有條件的結論。: Reading one palace alone gives a conclusion with no conditions.
sentences.兄弟宮與僕役宮正對，又與疾厄宮、田宅宮連成一組：平輩、圈子、負荷、家，這幾樣其實: The Siblings Palace sits opposite the Friends Palace and forms a group with the Health and Property Palaces: peers, circle, load and home all belong to the same radius of life.
sentences.夫妻宮與官祿宮正對，又與遷移宮、福德宮連成一組：關係、做事、在外的狀態、內在的安: The Partnership Palace sits opposite the Career Palace and forms a group with the Travel and Wellbeing Palaces: relationships, work, how you are out in the world and inner rest pull on one another.
sentences.只讀這一宮，看不出那股拉扯從哪裡來。: Reading this palace alone, you can't see where that pull comes from.
sentences.子女宮與田宅宮正對，又與僕役宮、父母宮連成一組：下一代、家、圈子、上一輩，串起來: The Children Palace sits opposite the Property Palace and forms a group with the Friends and Parents Palaces: the next generation, home, your circle and the generation before, strung together, are your place between the generations.
sentences.單讀一宮會看漏那條線。: Reading one palace alone misses that thread.
sentences.財帛宮與福德宮正對，又與命宮、官祿宮連成一組：你怎樣賺、你是誰、你做什麼、你想要: The Wealth Palace sits opposite the Wellbeing Palace and forms a group with the Life and Career Palaces: how you earn, who you are, what you do and the life you want are sides of the same thing.
sentences.分開讀會讀成理財問題。: Read separately, it looks like a question of managing money.
sentences.疾厄宮與父母宮正對，又與兄弟宮、田宅宮連成一組：負荷從來不只是自己一個人的事，它: The Health Palace sits opposite the Parents Palace and forms a group with the Siblings and Property Palaces: your load is never yours alone; it's tied to your peers, your elders and where you live.
sentences.遷移宮與命宮正對，又與夫妻宮、福德宮連成一組：在外的樣子、本來的樣子、身邊的人、: The Travel Palace sits opposite the Life Palace and forms a group with the Partnership and Wellbeing Palaces: how you are out in the world, who you are, the person beside you and your inner rest are facets of the same person.
sentences.正對這一組最要一起讀。: This opposite pair, above all, has to be read together.
sentences.僕役宮與兄弟宮正對，又與子女宮、父母宮連成一組：朋友、手足、晚輩、長輩，其實是同: The Friends Palace sits opposite the Siblings Palace and forms a group with the Children and Parents Palaces: friends, siblings, the younger and the older are really one way of relating, applied to different people.
sentences.單讀一宮會以為它們無關。: Reading one palace alone makes them seem unrelated.
sentences.官祿宮與夫妻宮正對，又與命宮、財帛宮連成一組：你做什麼、你是誰、你怎樣賺、身邊那: The Career Palace sits opposite the Partnership Palace and forms a group with the Life and Wealth Palaces: what you do, who you are, how you earn and how the person beside you is doing all move together.
sentences.單看一宮談事業會漏掉條件。: Talking about career from one palace alone misses the conditions.
sentences.田宅宮與子女宮正對，又與兄弟宮、疾厄宮連成一組：住的地方、要培育的人和事、平輩、: The Property Palace sits opposite the Children Palace and forms a group with the Siblings and Health Palaces: where you live, the people and things you nurture, your peers and your load make up the base of a single life.
sentences.分開讀會失去分量。: Read separately, it loses its weight.
sentences.福德宮與財帛宮正對，又與夫妻宮、遷移宮連成一組：內在的安頓、手上的資源、身邊的人: The Wellbeing Palace sits opposite the Wealth Palace and forms a group with the Partnership and Travel Palaces: inner rest, the resources in hand, the person beside you and how you are out in the world all pull on one another.
sentences.父母宮與疾厄宮正對，又與子女宮、僕役宮連成一組：上一輩、下一代、身邊的人、自己的: The Parents Palace sits opposite the Health Palace and forms a group with the Children and Friends Palaces: the generation before, the generation after, the people around you and your own load are positions on the same line between generations.
sentences.主導的姿態站得住：說了算，也扛得起，旁人願意讓位給它。: Your leadership holds: your word counts, you can carry the weight, and others are willing to make way for you.
sentences.方向不必打折，但仍要看身邊有沒有輔佐。: Your direction needn't be watered down, though much still depends on whether you have support around you.
sentences.主導仍在，但要靠場合配合；位置不對時它會收起來不說。: The urge to lead is still there, but it needs the right setting; in the wrong position, you keep quiet.
sentences.標準還在，推動的力氣不足，多半停在提出意見的階段。: The standards remain, but the strength to push them is lacking, so things mostly stop at the stage of offering an opinion.
sentences.想主導而使不上力，容易變成對細節反覆要求。: Wanting to lead without the strength to do it easily turns into repeated demands about details.
sentences.要留意它把力氣花在了哪些小事上。: Watch which small things your energy goes into.
sentences.帝座失位，標準不減，可以支配的東西卻很少。: The imperial star is out of place: your standards are undiminished, but you have little to command.
sentences.落差感，往往比能力不足更磨人。: That sense of falling short often wears it down more than any lack of ability.
sentences.機變用得上，轉圜快、路數多，難題到它手上通常有第二條路。: Your quick wit has room to work: you turn things around fast, you have plenty of approaches, and a hard problem in your hands usually finds a second way through.
sentences.轉得動，但要時間；倉促之下它的方案未必比直來直往好。: You can turn things around, but you need time; in a rush, your plans aren't necessarily better than the direct route.
sentences.想得多而落實少，選項列得出，決定下不了。: You think a lot and act little: you can list the options but struggle to make the decision.
sentences.它的價值多在想法，而不在結果。: Your value lies more in ideas than in results.
sentences.機變轉成搖擺，同一件事反覆改口，旁人抓不住。: Quick wit turns into wavering: you change your mind again and again about the same thing until no one can keep hold of it.
sentences.它的反覆不是不在乎，是選項太多。: Your changes of mind aren't indifference; there are just too many options.
sentences.《全書》明寫「陷地無力」：想得再多都缺一個可以施展的空間。: The *Complete Book* says plainly "powerless where weak": however much it thinks, it lacks room to put any of it to use.
sentences.日麗中天，照得出去，也被看得見，付出有人接得住。: The Sun at midday: your light reaches out and is seen, and what you give is received.
sentences.它的付出這時候收得到回應。: Here, what you give gets a response.
sentences.仍然向外，但範圍縮小，照顧得到身邊而未必照顧得到場面。: Still turned outwards, but within a smaller range: you can look after those close by, not necessarily the whole room.
sentences.光度平常，願意給，給出去的分量卻不特別顯眼。: Ordinary brightness: you're willing to give, though what you give doesn't stand out.
sentences.它給得出，只是不張揚。: You can give; you just don't make a show of it.
sentences.將落未落，想照而力不繼，容易在無人回應的地方空轉。: About to set but not yet set: you want to shine but lack the strength to keep going, and easily spin your wheels where no one responds.
sentences.要留意它在哪些地方白費了力氣。: Watch where your effort goes to waste.
sentences.失輝，付出轉向內裡，熱度還在而照不出去。: With the Sun dimmed here, your giving turns inwards: the warmth is still there but can't shine out.
sentences.做了很多卻沒有人知道，是最實在的處境。: Doing a great deal that no one knows about is the real situation here.
sentences.決斷落實得到，想得到就做得成，過程短，代價也算得清。: Your decisions get carried out: what you can think of, you can do, quickly, and the cost is clear.
sentences.目標清楚的時候它最值得倚靠。: You're most worth relying on when the goal is clear.
sentences.執行力仍在，但要有明確目標；方向模糊時它反而停住。: The drive to deliver is still there, but it needs a clear goal; when direction is vague, you stall.
sentences.剛的部分收斂了，衝勁也跟著收：做得完，做不快。: The hard edge softens, and your drive softens with it: you get things done, but not fast.
sentences.這時的武曲比平時容易商量。: Here Wu Qu is easier to negotiate with than usual.
sentences.剛用錯地方，在小事上堅持，在該爭的地方反而繞開。: Your firmness goes to the wrong places: you insist on small things and step around what you should fight for.
sentences.金氣受制，決斷變成硬撐，事情做成了而代價高於原本值得付的。: With Wu Qu's metal held back, your decisiveness becomes grim endurance, and things get done at a higher cost than they were worth.
sentences.安穩仍在，但需要條件配合；順的時候特別順，緊的時候拖得住。: Steadiness remains but needs conditions to cooperate: when things go well they go especially well, and when they're tight you can hold on.
sentences.不好不壞，既沒有推力，也沒有阻力。: Neither good nor bad: no push, and no resistance.
sentences.要留意它停留的時間會比自己以為的長很多。: Watch that you'll stay put far longer than you think.
sentences.安逸變成惰性，知道該動而遲遲不動，理由永遠找得到。: Ease turns into inertia: you know you should move and keep not moving, and there's always a reason.
sentences.難處不在能力，在起步。: The difficulty isn't ability; it's getting started.
sentences.福薄，想安頓而安頓不下來，舒服的條件反而最缺。: Thin blessings: you want to settle but can't, and the conditions for comfort are the very ones in shortest supply.
sentences.投入有去處，原則守得住，濃度轉成專注而不是糾纏。: Your commitment has somewhere to go and your principles hold, so intensity becomes focus rather than entanglement.
sentences.專注是它最實在的長處。: Focus is your most solid strength.
sentences.仍然認真，但要對象值得；不值得的時候它撤得很快。: Still serious, but only for something worthwhile; when it isn't, you pull out fast.
sentences.熱度中等，投入得起，也放得下，少見極端。: Moderate heat: you can commit and you can let go, and you rarely go to extremes.
sentences.這時的廉貞最容易被當成隨和。: Here Lian Zhen is most easily mistaken for easy-going.
sentences.投入而無回應，濃度轉向內裡，容易反覆想同一件事。: Commitment without response: the intensity turns inwards, and it easily goes over the same thing again and again.
sentences.原則仍在，只是沒有放它的地方。: The principles remain; there's just nowhere to put them.
sentences.力氣仍在而找不到出口，於是往內燒，變成跟自己過不去。: The strength is still there but finds no outlet, so it burns inwards and turns against itself.
sentences.庫房豐足，接得住、守得穩，是可以託付的那一個。: A full storehouse: you can take the weight and hold it safely, and you're the one people can entrust things to.
sentences.別人放心，它自己也心裡有數。: Others feel safe, and you know where you stand too.
sentences.守成仍然可靠，但餘裕不多：做事會比平時保守，也比平時更在意有沒有退路可走。: You're still reliable at holding the line, but with little to spare: you act more cautiously than usual and care more about having a way out.
sentences.穩而不豐，底盤在，可調度的部分有限。: Steady but not plentiful: the foundation is there, but there's little to move around.
sentences.這時的天府守得住一攤事，撐不開新的。: Here Tian Fu can keep one operation secure but can't open up anything new.
sentences.想守而守不牢，安全邊際被壓縮，警覺轉成緊張。: You want to hold firm but can't: the safety margin is squeezed, and vigilance turns into tension.
sentences.表面平靜，底下一直繃著。: Calm on the surface, always taut underneath.
sentences.空庫，周全的習慣還在，可以周全的資源卻不足，容易只剩形式。: An empty storehouse: your habit of thoroughness remains, but the resources for it are lacking, so it can become mere form.
sentences.月華得地，積得住、照料得周到，內裡與外面都安頓得下。: The Moon well placed: you build up and look after things carefully, settled both inside and out.
sentences.這是太陰最順的一檔。: This is Tai Yin at its easiest.
sentences.仍然細緻，範圍縮小；照顧得了自己人，顧不了太遠。: Still attentive, within a smaller range: you can look after your own people, not those further away.
sentences.收得住也散得掉：積累的速度慢，但不至於流失。: You can gather and you can scatter: your savings build slowly, but don't drain away.
sentences.節奏比強弱更能形容它。: Here, your rhythm describes you better than your strength.
sentences.想積而積不起，細膩轉成容易被小事牽動，對語氣特別在意。: You want to build up but can't: sensitivity turns into being easily moved by small things, especially tone of voice.
sentences.積累的心沒變，變的是節奏。: The wish to build up hasn't changed; the rhythm has.
sentences.日生人太陰落陷：收得太緊，該說的話留在心裡。: For someone born by day, a weak Tai Yin draws in too tightly, keeping inside what ought to be said.
sentences.這份安靜不等於沒有意見。: That quiet doesn't mean having no opinion.
sentences.慾望有去處，學得快、玩得開，想要的東西多半拿得到。: Desire has somewhere to go: you learn fast, enjoy yourself freely, and mostly get what you want.
sentences.這時的貪狼最舒展。: Here Tan Lang is at its most expansive.
sentences.驅力仍在，但要條件配合；沒有舞台時它會顯得浮躁。: The drive is still there but needs the right conditions; without a stage, you seem restless.
sentences.興趣廣而不深，什麼都碰一點，多數停在入門。: Broad interests without depth: you dip into everything, and mostly stop at the beginner's level.
sentences.課題不在好奇，在收尾。: The task isn't curiosity; it's finishing.
sentences.想要而得不到，慾望轉成比較與不甘。: Wanting without getting: desire turns into comparison and resentment.
sentences.不甘的成分比想要更多一些。: There's a little more resentment in it than wanting.
sentences.桃花失地，驅力仍強而出口窄，最容易走向消耗自己的那幾種。: Romance out of place: the drive is still strong but the outlets are narrow, so it easily turns to the kinds that wear it down.
sentences.暗處被照亮，辨得清、講得明，口舌成為專業而不是是非。: The dark is lit up: you see clearly and speak plainly, and words become a professional skill rather than a source of gossip.
sentences.這時的巨門摩擦最少。: Here Ju Men meets the least friction.
sentences.仍然能辨，但要有人聽；沒有對象時它會把話憋著。: You can still see clearly, but you need someone to listen; without an audience, you hold your words in.
sentences.問得出問題，未必問得到答案。: You can ask the questions, but you don't always get answers.
sentences.這時的巨門敏銳仍在，追下去的力度不足。: Here Ju Men's sharpness remains, but it lacks the strength to follow through.
sentences.質疑失了分寸，該問的沒問，不該問的追到底。: Your questioning loses its sense of measure: what should be asked goes unasked, and what shouldn't be is pursued to the end.
sentences.問錯了地方，力氣就白花。: Asked in the wrong place, the effort is wasted.
sentences.化暗而無日照，話說出口容易被誤解，和人的摩擦最密。: Darkness with no sunlight: what you say is easily misunderstood, and friction with people is at its densest.
sentences.印信在手，規矩用得好，也守得住，場面由它撐得起。: With the seal in hand, you use the rules well and keep them, and can hold the whole occasion together.
sentences.這時最能替旁人把關。: Here it's best placed to guard the gate for others.
sentences.協調仍然順，但要有既定的章法可依。: Coordinating still goes smoothly, but you need established methods to follow.
sentences.沒有章法的場合，它會先花力氣把規矩立起來。: Where there's no method, you spend your energy setting up rules first.
sentences.穩妥而平淡，不出錯，也不出頭。: Safe and plain: no mistakes, and no standing out.
sentences.妥當是它的底色，亮點要靠同宮或者三方的星來給。: Doing things properly is your base colour; any highlights have to come from the stars in the same palace or in its wider circle.
sentences.想妥當而拿不定：沒有前例的時候，它會一直等別人先說。: You want to do things properly but can't decide: with no precedent, you keep waiting for someone else to speak first.
sentences.印而無位，體面的要求還在，可以動用的權責卻不足。: A seal with no office: the demand for doing things properly remains, but there's too little authority to act on it.
sentences.蔭得住人，公道講得出口，庇護也給得出去，旁人願意聽它的。: You can shelter people, speak up for fairness and offer protection, and others are willing to listen to you.
sentences.代價是事情容易找上門。: The cost is that trouble easily finds its way to the door.
sentences.仍然肯擔，只是範圍收窄了：顧得了近處，顧不了全局。: Still willing to carry things, but within a narrower range: you can look after what's close, not the whole picture.
sentences.原則還在，出面的次數減少。: The principles remain; it steps forward less often.
sentences.這時的天梁比平時容易被略過，也比平時省力。: Here Tian Liang is more easily passed over than usual, and spends less effort too.
sentences.想擔而擔不動，說了不算，反而落得多管閒事。: You want to carry things but can't, your word doesn't count, and you end up looking like a busybody.
sentences.最需要先劃清界線。: What it most needs is to draw clear lines first.
sentences.蔭星失地，承擔照舊，回報與理解都少，最容易累積委屈，而委屈多數不會說出口。: The sheltering star out of place: you carry as much as ever with little return or understanding, so grievances easily build, and most of them go unspoken.
sentences.斗中上將，扛得起硬仗，開得了局面，壓力反而讓它清醒。: The chart's great general: you can take on a hard fight and open things up, and pressure only sharpens you.
sentences.這是七殺最有力的一檔。: This is Qi Sha at its most powerful.
sentences.決斷仍在，但要方向明確；卷二那句「遇帝為權」講的正是這件事。: Your decisiveness remains but needs a clear direction; that's exactly what Book Two means by "gains authority when it meets the Emperor".
sentences.獨立仍在，鋒芒收斂：做事變得謹慎，衝的部分收起來，成果也因此平穩許多。: Your independence remains with its edge softened: you work more carefully, hold back the charge, and your results are much steadier for it.
sentences.硬而無處著力，力氣用在撐住而不是推進。: Hard with nothing to push against: your strength goes into holding on rather than moving forward.
sentences.疲勞來得比成果快得多。: Tiredness arrives far faster than results.
sentences.孤辰失地，距離感加深，扛得住事而扛不住長期的孤立。: Solitude out of place: the sense of distance deepens, and you can carry the work but not a long isolation.
sentences.子午入廟，破得舊，也立得起新的，代價換得回東西。: Strong in the Zi and Wu positions: you can break the old and build the new, and the cost buys something real.
sentences.這時的更替是有方向的。: Here the changes have a direction.
sentences.更替仍然有效，但幅度要控制：一次拆太多它接不住，收尾那一段就會出問題。: Change still works, but the scale needs controlling: tear down too much at once and you can't catch it all, and the finishing stretch goes wrong.
sentences.改得動，改完與改前差別不大。: You can make changes, but the result isn't much different from before.
sentences.這時的破軍動得多而動得淺，成本卻照付。: Here Po Jun moves a lot but shallowly, and still pays the full cost.
sentences.反覆而無成，拆掉了，新的還沒有建起來。: Going round in circles: the old is torn down and the new isn't built yet.
sentences.新的還沒建起來，這是當下狀態。: The new isn't built yet; that's where things stand.
sentences.拆得快而立得慢，中間有空檔。: Quick to tear down and slow to build, with a gap in between.
sentences.耗星失地，投入的成本收不回。: The star of expenditure out of place: what it puts in doesn't come back.
sentences.最需要的是先守一段，而不是再拆一次。: What it most needs is to hold steady for a while, not to tear things down again.
sentences.紫微化權，主導的姿態有了實際的支點，說出來的話開始算數。: Zi Wei turns to Authority: your leadership gets a real foothold, and your word starts to count.
sentences.要留意權帶來的是責任而不是地位。: Keep in mind that authority brings responsibility, not status.
sentences.紫微化科，體面被看見，名分理順。: Zi Wei turns to Recognition: your proper conduct is seen, and your standing is put in order.
sentences.它讓紫微的標準說得出口，但不增加它可以動用的東西。: This lets you voice your standards, but doesn't add to what you have to work with.
sentences.天機化祿，想法找得到出路，繞的那條路真的通。: Tian Ji turns to Abundance: your ideas find an outlet, and the way round really does lead somewhere.
sentences.它增加的是可能性，不是穩定性。: What it adds is possibility, not stability.
sentences.天機化權，轉圜開始有分量，它的方案有人採納。: Tian Ji turns to Authority: your ability to turn things around carries weight, and people adopt your plans.
sentences.代價是它要為自己的變通負責。: The cost is that you have to answer for your own improvising.
sentences.天機化科，思路被整理成說得出口的樣子。: Tian Ji turns to Recognition: your thinking is shaped into something you can put into words.
sentences.這是它最容易被低估卻最實用的一化。: This is the transformation most easily underestimated, and the most useful.
sentences.天機化忌，想得停不下來，同一件事反覆推演。: Tian Ji turns to Obstruction: you can't stop thinking, working through the same thing again and again.
sentences.要留意這不是猶豫，是收不了尾。: Keep in mind this isn't hesitation; it's being unable to close things off.
sentences.太陽化祿，付出接得回回應，照出去的地方真的亮起來。: Tai Yang turns to Abundance: what you give gets a response, and where you shine really lights up.
sentences.它讓太陽的給予不再是空轉。: This stops your giving from spinning its wheels.
sentences.太陽化權，承擔的位置變得明確，它被放到檯面上。: Tai Yang turns to Authority: your role in carrying things becomes clear, and you're put out in front.
sentences.留意它本來就不擅長推辭。: Remember that you were never good at saying no.
sentences.太陽化忌，照出去而收不回來，付出與回應之間出現缺口。: Tai Yang turns to Obstruction: you shine out but nothing comes back, and a gap opens between giving and response.
sentences.這一化最耗的是它的熱度。: What this transformation drains most is your warmth.
sentences.武曲化祿，資源與執行接上了，做得成也拿得到，努力換得回實在的回報。: Wu Qu turns to Abundance: resources and execution connect, you get things done and get the reward, and effort brings a real return.
sentences.武曲化權，決斷有了授權，敢下手也下得了手。: Wu Qu turns to Authority: your decisiveness is sanctioned, and you dare to act and can.
sentences.要留意剛加上權容易過猛。: Keep in mind that firmness plus authority can easily go too far.
sentences.方向對就推得遠，方向錯就撞得重。: In the right direction you push far; in the wrong one you hit hard.
sentences.武曲化科，務實被整理成章法，硬的部分有了說法。: Wu Qu turns to Recognition: your practicality is shaped into method, and your hard edge gets an explanation.

sentences.你的身宮坐天相：你把事情辦得妥當，容易因此得到體面和名聲。: With Tian Xiang in your Body Palace, you handle things properly, and that tends to earn you respect and a good name.
sentences.你的身宮坐天梁：你身上有一份庇蔭，遇到難處，往往有人伸手。: With Tian Liang in your Body Palace, you carry a kind of protection: when things get hard, someone often reaches out.
sentences.你的身宮坐七殺：你後天多數要經歷一番辛苦，才走得出自己的路。: With Qi Sha in your Body Palace, you usually have to go through real hardship before you find your own path.
sentences.你的身宮坐破軍而落陷：你多半要離開原來的家和環境，自己另起爐灶。: With a weak Po Jun in your Body Palace, you'll most likely leave the home and surroundings you started in and build something of your own.
sentences.你的身宮有化祿：你用力的地方比較順，付出容易有回報。: Abundance in your Body Palace means the places you put effort into go relatively smoothly, and what you give tends to come back.
sentences.你的身宮有化權：你用力的地方說得上話，容易掌握主導。: Authority in your Body Palace means your word counts where you put in effort, and you tend to take the lead.
sentences.你的身宮有化科：你用力的地方容易得到名聲和肯定。: Recognition in your Body Palace means the places you put effort into tend to bring you a good name and acknowledgement.
sentences.你的身宮有化忌：你用力的地方牽掛多，容易操心，事情未必一路順。: Obstruction in your Body Palace means the places you put effort into carry a lot of worry, and things don't always go smoothly.
sentences.你命宮坐天機，身宮見太陰：你常常日夜奔忙，晚上也還在計劃、思量。: With Tian Ji in your Life Palace and Tai Yin in your Body Palace, you're often busy day and night, still planning and thinking things over in the evening.
sentences.你命宮坐太陽，身宮坐太陰：你較可能離開出生地，到外面發展。: With Tai Yang in your Life Palace and Tai Yin in your Body Palace, you're more likely to leave your birthplace and make your way elsewhere.
sentences.你的武曲貪狼落在身宮而不在命宮：這組星的力量不如坐命時完整，後天要多花一點力氣。: Your Wu Qu and Tan Lang sit in your Body Palace rather than your Life Palace, so their strength isn't as complete as it would be there, and you'll need to put in a little more effort as life goes on.
sentences.身宮所在，就是你這些年最用力的地方；力氣用在這裡，最容易見到回報。: Where your Body Palace sits is where you've put the most effort in these years; effort spent here is the most likely to pay off.
sentences.你主觀強、愛惡分明，拿得定主意，也習慣自己做主。: You have strong views and clear likes and dislikes; you make up your mind and are used to deciding for yourself.
sentences.你的長處是有主見，能把人和事組織起來。: Your strength is a mind of your own and the ability to organise people and things.
sentences.要留意的是：你太相信自己的判斷時，容易聽不進別人的意見。: Keep in mind that when you trust your own judgement too much, you can stop hearing other people.
sentences.紫微是帝星，所以你主見強。: Zi Wei is the imperial star, which is why your views are so firm.
sentences.它的氣質有兩面：一面重品味和個人愛好，一面重領導、組織和享受；身邊的星決定哪一面: It has two sides: one about taste and personal interests, the other about leading, organising and enjoying life; the stars around it decide which weighs more in you.
sentences.你偏向物質：重實際、重成果，懂得把人和資源組織起來。: You lean towards the material: practical, focused on results, good at organising people and resources.
sentences.你偏向精神：重品味和個人追求，做自己認同的事才有成就感。: You lean towards the inner life: you value taste and personal pursuits, and only feel accomplished doing what you believe in.
sentences.你兩面都要：既要做出實際成果，也要留一塊自己的空間。: You need both: real results, and a space of your own.
sentences.你的人生不走直線：升上去，會回落一次，再重新爬起。: Your life doesn't run in a straight line: you rise, fall back once, and climb again.
sentences.你的長處是不怕重來，跌倒了爬得起。: Your strength is that you aren't afraid to start over; when you fall, you get back up.
sentences.要留意的是：你每次變動之前，先想清楚換的是做法，還是方向。: Keep in mind that, before each change, it helps to be clear whether you're changing your method or your direction.
sentences.破軍是變動之星。: Po Jun is the star of change.
sentences.同樣是破軍，有人頻頻轉換跑道，有人在一個地方做到底，分別在於它順從的一面和叛逆的: Among people with Po Jun, some keep switching tracks and others stay in one place to the end; the difference lies in whether its compliant side or its rebellious side weighs more.
sentences.你偏向順從：你的變動多半是順勢而為，換的是做法，很少是根本。: You lean towards going with the flow: your changes mostly follow circumstances, altering your methods rather than your foundations.
sentences.你偏向叛逆：你不怕推倒重來，每一次變動都是真正的轉向。: You lean towards rebellion: you aren't afraid to tear things down and start again, and each change is a real turn.
sentences.你肯守，也肯變，關鍵在於時機到了，你敢不敢動。: You're willing to hold on and willing to change; what matters is whether you dare to move when the time comes.
sentences.你重情，也講原則，兩者常在你心裡拉扯。: You care deeply and you hold to principles, and the two often pull against each other inside you.
sentences.你的長處是念舊、守信，認定的人和事很少放棄。: Your strength is loyalty and keeping your word; you rarely give up on people or things you've committed to.
sentences.要留意的是：你讓感情和理智各管一邊，決定會做得更好。: Keep in mind that your decisions improve when feeling and reason each keep to their own side.
sentences.廉貞本身就帶著感情與理智的拉扯：它重情，又講操守；同宮的天府重理智、安於現狀，卻: Lian Zhen carries a pull between feeling and reason in itself: it values emotion and also integrity. Tian Fu in the same palace is rational and content with things as they are, but it can't resolve Lian Zhen's contradiction.
sentences.你偏向理智：做決定講條件、看得清利害，只是別人有時覺得你冷。: You lean towards reason: you decide on the merits and see the stakes clearly, though others sometimes find you cool.
sentences.你偏向感情：你念舊，忠於認定的人與事，一旦認定，很少回頭。: You lean towards feeling: you're loyal to the people and things you've chosen, and once you've chosen, you rarely turn back.
sentences.你感情與理智相當：你重情，但不會被情牽著走。: Feeling and reason are evenly matched in you: you care deeply, but feelings don't lead you around.
sentences.你內斂、不張揚，才華多半收在裡面。: You're reserved and low-key, and your talents mostly stay inside.
sentences.你的長處是沉得住氣，不浮誇，做事踏實。: Your strength is composure: you don't show off, and you work steadily.
sentences.要留意的是：你收得太緊，別人就看不到你的想法。: Keep in mind that if you hold back too tightly, others can't see what you think.
sentences.太陰的本色是內斂，古人說英華內斂。: Tai Yin's true nature is restraint — the old texts speak of brilliance held within.
sentences.收斂要有度：太收，會變成工於心計；太放，又只剩虛名。: Restraint needs balance: too much becomes calculation, too little leaves only an empty reputation.
sentences.最好是收斂略重，又有適度的發揮。: Best is a little more restraint than display, with some room to show what you can do.
sentences.你偏向收斂：你沉得住氣、不張揚，要留意別把想法都藏起來。: You lean towards restraint: composed and low-key — just don't hide all your ideas away.
sentences.你偏向發揮：你表現力強、容易被看見，要留意名聲跑在實績前面。: You lean towards display: expressive and easily noticed — watch that your reputation doesn't run ahead of your results.
sentences.你收放有度：內斂而不封閉，這是最好的樣子。: You hold back and open up in good measure: reserved but not closed, which is the best way for this to be.
sentences.你想要的東西很具體，欲望是推動你的力量。: What you want is concrete, and desire is what drives you.
sentences.你的長處是目標清楚，想要就會去爭取。: Your strength is clear goals: when you want something, you go after it.
sentences.要留意的是：你的欲望不宜過高，也不宜過低，剛剛好最好。: Keep in mind that your desires work best neither too high nor too low, but just right.
sentences.貪狼的本色是欲望：想要，而且想得很具體。: Tan Lang's true nature is desire: wanting, and wanting something specific.
sentences.欲望強的，還要分偏向物欲還是情欲；對宮的紫微得不得輔助，會加強或減低它。: Where desire is strong, it matters whether it leans towards possessions or towards romance; whether Zi Wei in the opposite palace has support strengthens or tempers it.
sentences.你的欲望偏強：目標清楚、行動積極，要留意別讓想要的東西追著你跑。: Your desires run strong: clear goals, active pursuit — watch that what you want doesn't end up chasing you.
sentences.你的欲望偏淡：你不爭，不易被欲望牽走，要留意遇到阻力時太快退後。: Your desires run light: you don't compete and aren't easily led by wanting — watch that you don't back off too quickly when you meet resistance.
sentences.你的欲望適中：你知道自己要甚麼，也知道甚麼時候夠了。: Your desires are moderate: you know what you want, and you know when it's enough.
sentences.你的感受比表面深，情緒有時會悶在心裡。: Your feelings run deeper than they look, and emotions sometimes stay shut inside.
sentences.你的長處是經得起風浪，波折之後往往能白手做出局面。: Your strength is weathering storms; after setbacks, you can often build something from nothing.
sentences.要留意的是：你心裡有事時，說出來比悶著好。: Keep in mind that when something is on your mind, saying it is better than holding it in.
sentences.巨門是暗曜，天同是情緒之星，兩者同宮，感情與情緒帶著一層陰影。: Ju Men is a shadowed star and Tian Tong a star of emotion; together in one palace, they cast a shadow over your feelings.
sentences.三合太陽的光能照開這層陰影，照得開多少，決定你是明朗還是陰暗。: The light of Tai Yang in a trine palace can lift that shadow, and how much it lifts decides whether you're bright or shadowed.
sentences.在丑宮，太陽的光熱足，這層陰影較易照開。: In the Chou position, Tai Yang has plenty of light and warmth, so the shadow lifts more easily.
sentences.在未宮，太陽的光較弱，這層陰影較難照開。: In the Wei position, Tai Yang's light is weaker, so the shadow is harder to lift.
sentences.你偏向明朗：情緒來得快也去得快，經過波折，往往能白手做出一番局面。: You lean towards brightness: emotions come and go quickly, and after setbacks you can often build something from nothing.
sentences.你偏向陰暗：你的感受比表面深，要留意別讓心事在裡面發酵。: You lean towards the shadow: your feelings run deeper than they look — don't let worries ferment inside.
sentences.你明暗參半：你有開朗的一面，也有不說出口的一面。: You're part light, part shadow: you have an open side and a side you keep to yourself.
sentences.你沉著、有韌力，壓力越大越撐得住。: You're steady and resilient; the greater the pressure, the better you hold up.
sentences.你的長處是扛得起事，挫折多半能靠自己扭轉。: Your strength is carrying weight; you can usually turn setbacks around on your own.
sentences.要留意的是：你硬撐不等於堅持，懂得退一步才走得遠。: Keep in mind that gritting your teeth isn't the same as persevering; knowing when to step back takes you further.
sentences.武曲性剛，天相性柔，兩者同宮，最要緊的是剛柔相濟。: Wu Qu is hard and Tian Xiang soft; together in one palace, what matters most is that hard and soft balance each other.
sentences.剛柔調和，沉著而有韌力；太剛，容易硬碰而折；太柔，又容易受制於人。: In balance, you're steady and resilient; too hard and you break against things, too soft and others control you.
sentences.你偏剛：決斷、肯承擔，要留意退一步的時機。: You lean towards hardness: decisive and willing to take responsibility — watch for the moments to step back.
sentences.你剛柔相濟：沉得住、也扛得起，遇到挫折多半能靠自己扭轉。: Hard and soft balance in you: you stay steady and carry weight, and you can usually turn setbacks around on your own.
sentences.你剛柔大致平衡：多數時候能收能放，只是壓力一大，你會先選擇硬扛。: Hard and soft are roughly balanced in you: most of the time you can give and take, but under heavy pressure your first move is to grit your teeth.
sentences.你獨立、有自己的一套，人生中離開的時刻會比別人多。: You're independent and have your own way of doing things, and your life tends to hold more departures than most.
sentences.你的長處是能獨當一面，到哪裡都站得住。: Your strength is standing on your own; wherever you go, you hold your ground.
sentences.要留意的是：每次離開，你盡量好好道別，別讓關係斷得太突然。: Keep in mind that, each time you leave, it helps to say goodbye properly rather than let relationships end too abruptly.
sentences.太陽天梁同宮帶一點孤的性質，中州派有太陽天梁主別離的說法。: Tai Yang with Tian Liang carries a touch of solitude; the Zhongzhou School associates this pairing with partings.
sentences.同樣是別離，有祥和與孤獨之分：祥和的是主動選擇的離開，孤獨的是被環境逼著走。: Partings differ: peaceful ones are departures you choose, lonely ones are departures circumstances force on you.
sentences.在卯宮，太陽初升，較為祥和。: In the Mao position, the sun is rising, and things are more peaceful.
sentences.在酉宮，太陽西斜，孤的色彩較重。: In the You position, the sun is setting, and solitude weighs more.
sentences.你偏向祥和：你的變動多半是主動選擇，離開一個地方或一段關係，都能好好道別。: You lean towards peaceful partings: your changes are mostly your own choice, and you can say goodbye properly to a place or a relationship.
sentences.你偏向孤獨：你獨立、有自己的一套，最能發揮的是帶點獨門的專業。: You lean towards solitude: independent, with your own way of doing things, you do best in a specialised field that's somewhat your own.
sentences.你享受獨處，也珍惜身邊的人，只是不會為了合群改變自己。: You enjoy your own company and value the people around you, but you won't change yourself just to fit in.
sentences.你有理想，肯為一個目標吃苦。: You have ideals, and you'll endure hardship for a goal.
sentences.你的長處是志向高，辛苦也不輕易改變初衷。: Your strength is high aims; hardship doesn't easily change what you set out to do.
sentences.要留意的是：你分清哪些是真正想要的，哪些只是想換個環境。: Keep in mind that it helps to tell what you truly want from what is only a wish for a change of scene.
sentences.七殺是將星，理想高。: Qi Sha is the general's star, with high ideals.
sentences.理想太高，現實配合不上，是一種遺憾；流於空想，卻會把不必要的改變當成追求。: Ideals too high for reality to match are a kind of regret; drifting into daydreams turns unnecessary change into a pursuit.
sentences.對宮廉貞天府的性質，最影響你往哪一邊走。: The nature of Lian Zhen and Tian Fu in the opposite palace has the most influence on which way you go.
sentences.依中州派的經驗，辰宮的七殺多理想。: In the Zhongzhou School's experience, Qi Sha in the Chen position tends towards real ideals.
sentences.依中州派的經驗，戌宮的七殺較多空想。: In the Zhongzhou School's experience, Qi Sha in the Xu position tends more towards daydreams.
sentences.你偏向理想：你肯為一個目標吃苦，辛苦也不改初衷。: You lean towards real ideals: you'll endure hardship for a goal without abandoning it.
sentences.你偏向空想：你的念頭多，改變也多，先想清楚哪些是真正想要的。: You lean towards daydreams: you have many ideas and make many changes — first get clear on what you truly want.
sentences.你理想與空想參半：你有真正的目標，也有不少停在想法的計劃。: Your ideals are half real, half daydream: you have genuine goals, and also plenty of plans that stay ideas.
sentences.你腦筋轉得快，遇事擅長想辦法。: You think fast and are good at finding solutions.
sentences.你的長處是點子多，遇到問題總能找到路。: Your strength is ideas: when a problem comes up, you usually find a way.
sentences.要留意的是：你想得多時，記得把最好的一個做到底。: Keep in mind that, when you have many ideas, it pays to see the best one through to the end.
sentences.天機的本色是動腦，分兩種：機變靈活、隨機應對；機謀有計劃、有設計，反而更踏實。: Tian Ji's true nature is thinking, in two forms: quick wit, flexible and responsive; and strategy, planned and designed, which is in fact more solid.
sentences.三合的天同巨門、太陽天梁明朗還是陰暗，決定你偏哪一種。: Whether Tian Tong with Ju Men and Tai Yang with Tian Liang in your trine palaces are bright or shadowed decides which form you lean towards.
sentences.你偏向機變：你反應快、路數多，最能在變化裡找到機會。: You lean towards quick wit: fast reactions and many approaches, at your best finding chances in change.
sentences.你偏向機謀：你擅長計劃與設計，想得深、布得遠，用在正道上就是真本事。: You lean towards strategy: good at planning and design, thinking deep and far ahead — used well, that's real skill.
sentences.你機變與機謀兼備：你能即場應變，也能長線布局。: You have both quick wit and strategy: you can respond on the spot and plan for the long run.
sentences.你有很強的開創性：先破舊，才能立新。: You have a strong pioneering streak: you break the old before you build the new.
sentences.你的長處是敢改變，能把舊局面換成新局面。: Your strength is daring to change, turning an old situation into a new one.
sentences.要留意的是：你每次改變都會牽動身邊的人，先照顧好他們。: Keep in mind that each change you make affects the people around you, so look after them first.
sentences.紫微是帝星，破軍主破舊立新，兩者同宮，開創性很強。: Zi Wei is the imperial star and Po Jun breaks the old to build the new; together, they make a strong pioneering pair.
sentences.動盪的，每次改變都牽動一大片人際；安定的，能不知不覺把局面換新。: In a turbulent form, each change shakes a whole network of people; in a settled form, you can renew things without anyone noticing.
sentences.你偏向動盪：你的改變來得大，每一次都會重排身邊的人和事。: You lean towards turbulence: your changes are big, and each one rearranges the people and things around you.
sentences.你偏向安定：你能在不聲不響之間把局面換新，別人往往事後才發現。: You lean towards the settled form: you can renew things quietly, and others often only notice afterwards.
sentences.你動靜參半：該破的時候會破，但多半選在時機成熟之後。: You're part turbulent, part settled: you break things when you have to, but usually once the time is right.
sentences.你持重、保守，擅長守住手上的東西。: You're steady and conservative, good at holding on to what you have.
sentences.你的長處是穩，別人放心把事情交給你。: Your strength is steadiness; people feel safe handing things to you.
sentences.要留意的是：你守得太緊時，也會錯過該擴張的時機。: Keep in mind that holding on too tightly can mean missing the moment to expand.
sentences.天府是守成之星。: Tian Fu is the star of preserving what has been built.
sentences.只有卯酉兩宮的天府不與紫微會照，保守安定的本色最完整；三方的吉星多寡，決定你的守: Only in the Mao and You positions does Tian Fu stand apart from Zi Wei, so its steady, conservative nature is at its fullest; how many favourable stars surround it decides whether you hold a large operation with seasoned calm or guard things with careful calculation.
sentences.你格局開闊：你守得住大局面，老成持重，旁人放心把事情交給你。: Your scope is wide: you can hold a large operation with seasoned steadiness, and others feel safe handing things to you.
sentences.你偏向謹慎：你精打細算、步步為營，做得細，也守得穩。: You lean towards caution: careful with every sum and every step, thorough in what you do and steady in what you keep.
sentences.你守得住手上的局面，擴張之前總要先確定退路。: You can hold what you have, and before expanding you always make sure of a way back.
sentences.你往哪裡動特別要緊：方向對了，能一步走出困局。: Where you move matters especially: in the right direction, you can step out of a tight spot in one go.
sentences.你的長處是看準了就動，破局的力量很大。: Your strength is moving once you've seen clearly, with great power to break a deadlock.
sentences.要留意的是：你方向未定之前，越用力越容易被纏住。: Keep in mind that, before your direction is set, the harder you push, the more tangled you get.
sentences.太陰在辰戌，對著太陽，古人稱為日月拱照。: Tai Yin in the Chen or Xu position faces Tai Yang; the old texts call this the sun and moon shining on each other.
sentences.這兩宮是天羅地網，有目標的一舉破網而出，盲動的越掙扎越被纏住。: These two positions are the net of heaven and earth: with a clear goal you break out in one move, while aimless struggle only tangles you further.
sentences.中州派相傳，這裡的太陰喜金、忌火。: Zhongzhou School tradition holds that Tai Yin here favours Metal and is hindered by Fire.
sentences.你偏向有目標：你知道自己要往哪裡去，一旦看準，會一步走出困局。: You lean towards having a clear goal: you know where you're going, and once you see it clearly you can step out of a tight spot in one go.
sentences.你偏向盲動：你動得多、試得多，要先定方向再出力。: You lean towards aimless movement: you move a lot and try a lot — set a direction before you put in the effort.
sentences.你兩者參半：有些事你看得很準，有些事你是邊走邊找方向。: You're half and half: some things you see very clearly, others you work out as you go.
sentences.你有感情的一面，也有物欲的一面，兩者都強。: You have an emotional side and a materialistic side, and both are strong.
sentences.你的長處是懂得享受生活，也肯為想要的東西出力。: Your strength is knowing how to enjoy life and being willing to work for what you want.
sentences.要留意的是：你追求刺激的時候，記得給自己留後路。: Keep in mind that, when you chase excitement, it pays to leave yourself a way back.
sentences.廉貞主感情，貪狼主物欲，兩者同宮。: Lian Zhen governs feeling and Tan Lang material desire, and here they share a palace.
sentences.兩者都重，就帶很強的追求刺激的色彩；兩者平衡，感情與物欲互相牽制，反而最穩。: When both are heavy, there's a strong pull towards excitement; when they balance, feeling and desire keep each other in check, which is in fact the steadiest.
sentences.你偏向感情：你重情、重氣氛，最能打動你的是人，不是東西。: You lean towards feeling: you value emotion and atmosphere, and what moves you most is people, not things.
sentences.你偏向物欲：你重實際、重享受，目標具體，也肯為它出力。: You lean towards material desire: practical and pleasure-loving, with concrete goals you're willing to work for.
sentences.你感情與物欲相當：兩者互相牽制，你享受生活，但不會被任何一邊拖著走。: Feeling and desire are evenly matched in you: they keep each other in check, so you enjoy life without being dragged by either.
sentences.你的才華收在裡面，不搶鋒頭，看人看事也多留一分心。: Your talents stay inside; you don't seek the spotlight, and you watch people and situations with extra care.
sentences.你的長處是沉得住，慢慢做成大事。: Your strength is patience; you build something big slowly.
sentences.要留意的是：你的防備心太重時，會把人推開。: Keep in mind that, when you're too guarded, you push people away.
sentences.巨門是暗曜，本性是遮蔽。: Ju Men is a shadowed star, whose nature is to conceal.
sentences.在子午兩宮，它可以把遮蔽轉成收斂自己的才華，古人稱為石中隱玉；也可以轉成對別人的: In the Zi and Wu positions, that concealment can become keeping your own talent under wraps — the old texts call it jade hidden in stone — or it can become suspicion of others.
sentences.兩者都在內心，只差一線。: Both live inside, and only a fine line separates them.
sentences.你偏向英華內斂：你的才華收在裡面，不搶鋒頭，慢慢做成大事。: You lean towards brilliance held within: your talent stays inside, you don't seek the spotlight, and you build something big slowly.
sentences.你偏向疑慮：你看人看事都多留一分心，要留意別讓防備把人推開。: You lean towards suspicion: you watch people and situations with extra care — don't let your guard push people away.
sentences.你懂得收斂，也懂得防人，分寸在於何時放下戒心。: You know how to hold back and how to protect yourself; the skill is in knowing when to lower your guard.
sentences.你善於輔佐、重人和，帶一點幕僚的氣質。: You're good at supporting others and value harmony, with something of the adviser about you.
sentences.你的長處是懂得配合，做事讓人放心。: Your strength is working well with others; people feel safe with how you handle things.
sentences.要留意的是：你別太依附某個人或某個圈子，保住自己的立場。: Keep in mind not to lean too heavily on one person or circle; keep your own position.
sentences.天相是輔佐之星，對宮紫微破軍。: Tian Xiang is the star of support, facing Zi Wei and Po Jun in the opposite palace.
sentences.氣質優雅的，保有自己的獨立性；隨俗的，容易依附環境。: The graceful form keeps its independence; the conforming form tends to lean on its surroundings.
sentences.優雅的命運未必較好，但地位與名聲勝一籌。: The graceful form doesn't necessarily have better fortune, but it wins out on standing and reputation.
sentences.你氣質偏優雅：你有自己的品味與立場，不會為了合群放棄原則。: You lean towards grace: you have your own taste and position, and you won't drop your principles just to fit in.
sentences.你偏向隨俗：你善於適應環境、跟得上變化，要留意別太依附某個人或某個圈子。: You lean towards conforming: good at adapting and keeping up with change — watch that you don't lean too heavily on one person or circle.
sentences.你兩者兼有：你懂得配合，也保有自己的一條底線。: You have both: you know how to fit in, and you keep a line of your own.
sentences.你有自己的節奏，不急不躁，適合在穩定的環境裡發揮。: You have your own pace, unhurried and even, and you do best in a stable environment.
sentences.你的長處是穩當、可靠，做事有條理。: Your strength is being steady and reliable, with an orderly way of working.
sentences.要留意的是：你選擇工作和環境時，先想清楚自己要悠閒還是要進取。: Keep in mind that, when choosing work and surroundings, it helps to be clear whether you want ease or ambition.
sentences.天同天梁同宮，會天機、太陰，成為純粹的機月同梁格局。: Tian Tong with Tian Liang, joined by Tian Ji and Tai Yin, forms a pure Ji Yue Tong Liang pattern.
sentences.天同帶浪漫，天梁講原則，你偏向哪一邊，對你的去留出處影響很大。: Tian Tong brings romance and Tian Liang principle, and which way you lean has a big effect on where you go and when you stay.
sentences.你偏向浪漫：你重感受、重生活情趣，在悠閒的節奏裡最能發揮。: You lean towards romance: you value feeling and the small pleasures of life, and do best at an easy pace.
sentences.你偏向原則：你講紀律、守規矩，在有章法的環境裡最能施展。: You lean towards principle: disciplined and rule-abiding, at your best where there's a clear method.
sentences.你果斷，決定得快，下手也很準。: You're decisive: you make up your mind quickly and act accurately.
sentences.你的長處是遇事不拖，關鍵時刻拿得定主意。: Your strength is not dithering; at critical moments, you can decide.
sentences.要留意的是：你決定之前多看一步，免得事後花力氣補救。: Keep in mind that looking one step further before you decide saves effort repairing things later.
sentences.武曲是財星，七殺是將星，兩者同宮，外表都像英明果斷。: Wu Qu is a wealth star and Qi Sha a general's star; together, they always look clear-sighted and decisive.
sentences.差別在於決定之後要不要常常補救：決斷的人留有餘地；短慮的人較薄情，人生也較孤立。: The difference is whether decisions often need repairing afterwards: the truly decisive leave room to manoeuvre, while the short-sighted are colder and lead more isolated lives.
sentences.你偏向決斷：你判斷快、下手準，而且懂得替自己和別人留餘地。: You lean towards true decisiveness: quick judgement, accurate action, and room left for yourself and others.
sentences.你偏向短慮：你決定得快，要多看一步再動，免得事後花力氣補救。: You lean towards short-sightedness: you decide fast — look one step further before you act, to save effort repairing things later.
sentences.你兩者參半：大事你看得清，小事則常憑一時的判斷。: You're half and half: you see big matters clearly, but often go on a moment's judgement for small ones.
sentences.你常常照顧別人，是身邊人依靠的那一個。: You often look after others, and you're the one people around you lean on.
sentences.你的長處是熱心、肯付出，照得亮身邊的人。: Your strength is warmth and generosity; you light up the people around you.
sentences.要留意的是：你分清哪些擔子本來不是你的。: Keep in mind which burdens were never yours to carry.
sentences.太陽要照顧三合的巨門和天梁，還要照射對宮的太陰，所以要看它有沒有被拖累。: Tai Yang has to look after Ju Men and Tian Liang in its trine palaces and shine on Tai Yin opposite, so what matters is whether it gets dragged down.
sentences.不受拖累，際遇自然順遂；受拖累，就容易一直在為別人付出。: If it isn't dragged down, things naturally go well; if it is, you can end up giving to others without end.
sentences.辰宮的太陽入廟，光熱足，較不易被拖累。: Tai Yang in the Chen position is strong, with plenty of light and warmth, and less easily dragged down.
sentences.戌宮的太陽落陷，光熱不足，較易被拖累。: Tai Yang in the Xu position is weak, short of light and warmth, and more easily dragged down.
sentences.你偏向從容：你的光照得出去，又不被拖垮，付出之後收得到回應。: You lean towards ease: your light reaches out without wearing you down, and what you give comes back.
sentences.你負擔偏重：你常常在替別人撐場，先看清哪些擔子本來不是你的。: Your load runs heavy: you're often holding things up for others — first see which burdens were never yours.
sentences.你負擔適中：你照顧得了別人，也還有餘力照顧自己。: Your load is moderate: you can look after others and still have strength left for yourself.
sentences.你腦筋靈活，擅長計劃，也懂得隨機應變。: You're quick-minded, good at planning, and able to adapt on the spot.
sentences.你的長處是反應快，越變化越能找到機會。: Your strength is fast reactions; the more things change, the more chances you find.
sentences.要留意的是：你算得太多時，別讓算計蓋過了本事。: Keep in mind that, when you calculate too much, calculation can overshadow real ability.
sentences.天機的本色是機變與計劃。: Tian Ji's true nature is quick wit and planning.
sentences.陽剛的天機做事為公，陰柔的天機懂得為自己打算；影響最大的是福德宮的天同天梁。: The bold form of Tian Ji works for the common good, the softer form knows how to look out for itself; what influences this most is Tian Tong with Tian Liang in the Wellbeing Palace.
sentences.你偏向陽剛：你的計劃為大局而做，越變化，越能遇到好的機會。: You lean towards the bold form: you plan for the bigger picture, and the more things change, the better your chances.
sentences.你偏向陰柔：你擅長權變、懂得保護自己，要留意別讓算計蓋過了本事。: You lean towards the softer form: good at manoeuvring and protecting yourself — don't let calculation overshadow real ability.
sentences.你剛柔並濟：你能為大局籌劃，也懂得照顧自己的位置。: You combine both: you can plan for the bigger picture and look after your own position too.
sentences.你既想開創，也想守穩，兩種想法常在你心裡拉扯。: You want to break new ground and to hold steady, and the two pull against each other inside you.
sentences.你的長處是進可攻、退可守，局面好時很有魄力。: Your strength is being able to advance or defend; when things go well, you act with real boldness.
sentences.要留意的是：你猶豫太久，主動權就會溜走。: Keep in mind that if you hesitate too long, the initiative slips away.
sentences.紫微擅長開創，天府擅長守成，兩顆星同宮。: Zi Wei is good at breaking new ground and Tian Fu at preserving what's built, and here they share a palace.
sentences.平衡時可攻可守；偏向一邊時，進時被拖住，退時又不肯退。: In balance you can advance or defend; tilted to one side, you're held back when advancing and unwilling to retreat when you should.
sentences.你偏向主動：該進時進得了，該守時也守得住。: You lean towards taking the initiative: you can advance when it's time, and hold when it's time.
sentences.你偏向被動：常要先應付眼前的局面，穩住陣腳之後，主動權才回到你手上。: You lean towards reacting: you often have to deal with the situation in front of you first, and only once you're steady does the initiative come back to you.
sentences.你主動和被動參半：順利時你敢進，局面亂時你會先等一等。: You're half initiative, half reaction: when things go well you push forward, and when they're messy you wait first.
sentences.你溫和，但溫和裡有沒有定力，決定你走得多穩。: You're gentle, and whether that gentleness has backbone decides how steadily you go.
sentences.你的長處是待人溫和，容易讓人親近。: Your strength is a gentle manner that makes you easy to approach.
sentences.要留意的是：你的許多困擾，其實由自己的一念而起。: Keep in mind that many of your troubles start from a single thought of your own.
sentences.太陰本來溫和。: Tai Yin is gentle by nature.
sentences.意志堅強的，溫和裡有定力；意志薄弱的，容易被感情或物欲牽著走。: With a strong will, that gentleness has backbone; with a weak will, it's easily led by feelings or desires.
sentences.太陰化權化科增加意志力，化祿較易心軟。: Tai Yin turning to Authority or Recognition strengthens the will; turning to Abundance makes for a softer heart.
sentences.你意志偏堅強：你溫和，但有定力，決定了的事不容易被人勸回頭。: Your will runs strong: gentle but firm, and once you've decided, you're hard to talk round.
sentences.你意志偏軟：你容易心軟、容易被打動，重要的決定留到情緒過去之後再做。: Your will runs soft: you're easily moved — leave important decisions until the feeling has passed.
sentences.你意志適中：大事上你站得穩，小事上則容易讓步。: Your will is moderate: you stand firm on big things and give way easily on small ones.
sentences.你一生會有突如其來的機會，能不能守住，看你肯不肯等。: Sudden opportunities tend to come your way, and whether you keep them depends on whether you're willing to wait.
sentences.你的長處是機會來時接得住，爆發力強。: Your strength is catching opportunities when they come, with real explosive force.
sentences.要留意的是：你在機會未到之前，先打好基礎。: Keep in mind that it pays to lay your groundwork before the opportunity arrives.
sentences.貪狼在辰戌，對著武曲，單純而帶物質色彩。: Tan Lang in the Chen or Xu position, facing Wu Qu, is straightforward with a material colouring.
sentences.這裡的貪狼最喜與火星鈴星同宮，一生必有突發的機遇；但機遇未到之前能不能忍，決定了: Tan Lang here does best alongside Huo Xing or Ling Xing, which bring sudden opportunities; but whether you can hold back before the chance comes decides whether you can keep it afterwards.
sentences.你偏向堅忍：你沉得住氣，機會未到先打好底，一旦來了就接得住。: You lean towards endurance: you stay calm, lay your groundwork before the chance comes, and catch it when it does.
sentences.你偏向躁進：你想得快、動得快，要留意在機會真正到來之前，先守住基礎。: You lean towards rushing: you think fast and move fast — hold on to your groundwork until the opportunity truly arrives.
sentences.你大多數時候肯等，但被逼急了，會先動再說。: Most of the time you're willing to wait, but under pressure you'll act first and think later.
sentences.你的外表和內心常常不一樣，別人很難一眼看透你。: Your outside and inside often differ, and people find you hard to read at a glance.
sentences.你的長處是心思細、藏得住，說話做事有分寸。: Your strength is a careful mind that keeps its own counsel, with good judgement in what you say and do.
sentences.要留意的是：你心裡的想法，適當時候讓身邊的人知道。: Keep in mind that it helps to let the people around you know what you're thinking, at the right moment.
sentences.巨門是暗曜，坐命的人外表與內心常常不一樣。: Ju Men is a shadowed star, and people with it in the Life Palace often look different on the outside from how they are inside.
sentences.深沉的偏向理智，仍帶感情色彩；衝動的偏向感情，仍帶理智色彩。: The deep form leans towards reason with a tint of feeling; the impulsive form leans towards feeling with a tint of reason.
sentences.對宮的太陽給你口才，但不改變這份本性。: Tai Yang in the opposite palace gives you a way with words, but doesn't change this nature.
sentences.你偏向深沉：你想得深、藏得住，別人往往看不出你真正的打算。: You lean towards depth: you think deeply and keep your own counsel, and others often can't see what you really intend.
sentences.你偏向衝動：你外表冷靜，內心其實很熱，一時的情緒容易替你做決定。: You lean towards impulse: calm on the outside but hot inside, and a passing feeling can easily make your decisions for you.
sentences.你多數時候想清楚才說，但遇到在意的事會直接開口。: Most of the time you think before you speak, but on things you care about you speak straight out.
sentences.你感情很深，一生常要在內心感受與外在環境之間找平衡。: Your feelings run deep, and you often have to balance what you feel inside against the world outside.
sentences.你的長處是外圓內方，是非再多也應付得體。: Your strength is being smooth outside and firm inside; however much gossip there is, you handle it well.
sentences.要留意的是：環境一變，你的內心會先受影響，記得找人傾訴。: Keep in mind that when your surroundings change, your inner world feels it first, so find someone to talk to.
sentences.廉貞天相這組星本身感情很深，會合的卻都是講物質的星，所以內心感受與外在環境常要互: Lian Zhen with Tian Xiang runs deep in feeling, but the stars around it are all material ones, so your inner feelings and outer circumstances often have to accommodate each other.
sentences.子宮的廉相，一般較少是非。: Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the Zi position generally bring less gossip and dispute.
sentences.午宮的廉相，是非一般較多。: Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the Wu position generally bring more gossip and dispute.
sentences.你偏向剛毅：你外表平和、內裡有骨，是非再多也應付得體。: You lean towards firmness: calm outside with backbone inside, handling gossip and dispute well however much there is.
sentences.你偏向柔軟：你的感受細，環境一變內心先受影響，遇到難處要記得找人傾訴。: You lean towards softness: you feel things finely, your inner world is the first to feel any change, and in hard times it helps to talk to someone.
sentences.你剛柔參半：順境時你游刃有餘，逆境時要多給自己一點時間。: You're half firm, half soft: at ease when things go well, and in need of a little more time when they don't.
sentences.你有原則，看人看事也看得很準。: You have principles, and you read people and situations accurately.
sentences.你的長處是說話有分量，別人信得過你的判斷。: Your strength is that your words carry weight and people trust your judgement.
sentences.要留意的是：你看出別人的缺點時，也用同一把尺量自己。: Keep in mind that, when you see faults in others, it's fair to measure yourself by the same standard.
sentences.天梁是原則之星，對宮天機。: Tian Liang is the star of principle, facing Tian Ji in the opposite palace.
sentences.正直的，原則用來律人，也用來律己；精明的，善於看出別人的缺點，對自己卻用另一把尺: The upright form holds others and itself to the same principles; the shrewd form is quick to spot others' faults but uses a different measure for itself.
sentences.丑宮的天梁有入廟的太陽太陰來會，較為正直。: Tian Liang in the Chou position is joined by strong Tai Yang and Tai Yin, and is more upright.
sentences.未宮的天梁，正直之性不如丑宮。: Tian Liang in the Wei position is less upright than in the Chou position.
sentences.你偏向正直：你有原則，律人也律己，說話有分量。: You lean towards uprightness: principled with others and with yourself, and your words carry weight.
sentences.你偏向精明：你看人看事都很準，要留意用同一把尺量自己。: You lean towards shrewdness: you read people and situations accurately — remember to measure yourself by the same standard.
sentences.你講原則，也懂變通，分寸在於何時該堅持。: You hold to principle and know how to adapt; the skill is knowing when to stand firm.
sentences.你不隨便合群，標準高，有自己的一套。: You don't fit in lightly; your standards are high and your ways your own.
sentences.你的長處是有威信，別人自然敬重你。: Your strength is authority; people naturally respect you.
sentences.要留意的是：你的距離感太重時，會把該留的人推遠。: Keep in mind that, when you keep too much distance, you can push away people worth keeping.
sentences.七殺是將星，對宮紫微天府。: Qi Sha is the general's star, facing Zi Wei and Tian Fu in the opposite palace.
sentences.威權的人令人敬畏、心服；孤高的人卻是自己把距離拉開。: The authoritative form commands awe and genuine respect; the aloof form puts the distance there itself.
sentences.七殺要見祿，孤高之氣才解得開。: Qi Sha needs Abundance nearby for its aloofness to ease.
sentences.你偏向威權：你不必刻意合群，別人自然敬重你、願意跟隨。: You lean towards authority: you don't need to try to fit in; people naturally respect you and want to follow.
sentences.你偏向孤高：你標準高、擇人嚴，要留意別讓距離感把該留的人推遠。: You lean towards aloofness: high standards, choosy about people — don't let distance push away those worth keeping.
sentences.你有號召力，但只對少數人放下戒備。: You can rally people, but you only lower your guard with a few.
sentences.你最需要的是一件真正投入的事，精神充實，日子才過得好。: What you need most is something to throw yourself into; with a full inner life, your days go well.
sentences.你的長處是懂得享受生活，心地好，容易相處。: Your strength is knowing how to enjoy life, with a good heart that makes you easy to be around.
sentences.要留意的是：生活再充足，你也要給自己找一件真正投入的事。: Keep in mind that however comfortable life is, you need something to throw yourself into.
sentences.天同是福星，對宮太陰。: Tian Tong is the star of blessings, facing Tai Yin in the opposite palace.
sentences.這組星最大的關口是精神充實還是空虛：充實的能白手成家；空虛的，即使物質豐足，也常: The great question for this pairing is whether the inner life is full or empty: when full, you can build a life from nothing; when empty, even with plenty, something always feels missing.
sentences.你精神偏充實：你知道自己為甚麼而忙，日子過得踏實，也過得有滋味。: Your inner life runs full: you know what you're busy for, and your days feel solid and worth living.
sentences.你要留意精神面：生活可以很充足，但要給自己找一件真正投入的事。: Watch your inner life: life can be comfortable, but you need something to throw yourself into.
sentences.你精神與物質大致平衡：有投入的事，也有偶爾放空的時候。: Your inner and outer lives are roughly balanced: you have things to throw yourself into, and moments to switch off.
sentences.你的際遇，很大程度取決於你肯不肯拼。: How things go for you depends largely on whether you're willing to fight for it.
sentences.你的長處是有一技之長，靠手藝站得住。: Your strength is a skill of your own that keeps you on your feet.
sentences.要留意的是：機會來時，別讓習慣替你拒絕。: Keep in mind that when an opportunity comes, you shouldn't let habit turn it down for you.
sentences.武曲是剛強的財星，落在辰戌天羅地網，剛強之性受到壓抑，所以奮鬥之心影響命運特別大: Wu Qu is a forceful wealth star, and in the Chen or Xu position — the net of heaven and earth — that force is held down, so the will to strive matters especially: those who stay in their rut make a living from one skill, while those who push forward can change their circumstances.
sentences.你偏向進取：你不甘於現狀，肯為改變際遇出力，也肯離開舒適的地方。: You lean towards ambition: not content with how things are, willing to work to change your circumstances and to leave comfortable places.
sentences.你偏向因循：你守得住一門手藝，要留意機會來時，別讓習慣替你拒絕。: You lean towards staying in your rut: you can keep a craft going — but when an opportunity comes, don't let habit turn it down for you.
sentences.你肯拼，但只在看清楚值得的時候。: You'll fight for things, but only once you're sure they're worth it.
sentences.你是往前推還是先退一步，決定你的際遇。: Whether you push forward or step back first decides how things go for you.
sentences.你的長處是熱心、肯扛事，逆境中也有抵抗力。: Your strength is warmth and willingness to carry things, with resilience in hard times.
sentences.要留意的是：你別在機會面前退得太遠。: Keep in mind not to step too far back when an opportunity is in front of you.
sentences.太陽是光熱之星，對宮巨門。: Tai Yang is the star of light and warmth, facing Ju Men in the opposite palace.
sentences.除了所在的宮位，更要看會合的星把它推向哪一邊：積極的太陽利進取，抵抗逆境的力量也: Beyond its position, what matters is which way the stars around it push it: an active Tai Yang favours ambition and resists hardship strongly.
sentences.巳宮的太陽較積極，也不易惹是非。: Tai Yang in the Si position is more active and less likely to draw gossip.
sentences.亥宮的太陽較消極，也較易招惹是非。: Tai Yang in the Hai position is more passive and more likely to draw gossip.
sentences.你偏向積極：你主動、肯扛，逆境來時你是往前推的那一個。: You lean towards action: proactive and willing to carry things, you're the one who pushes forward when things get hard.
sentences.你偏向消極：你傾向先退一步觀望，要留意別在機會面前退得太遠。: You lean towards caution: you tend to step back and watch first — don't step too far back when an opportunity is in front of you.
sentences.你看得準的事全力以赴，看不準的寧可先等。: When you see something clearly you give it everything; when you don't, you'd rather wait.
sentences.你平時不輕易變，但形勢非變不可時，你行動俐落。: You don't change lightly, but when change can't be avoided, you act cleanly.
sentences.你的長處是關鍵時刻敢破舊，下手不拖泥帶水。: Your strength is daring to break with the old at critical moments, without dragging your feet.
sentences.要留意的是：你變之前先想清楚，變完之後要建立甚麼。: Keep in mind that, before you change things, it pays to know what you want to build afterwards.
sentences.破軍是破舊立新之星，對宮廉貞天相。: Po Jun is the star that breaks the old to build the new, facing Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the opposite palace.
sentences.果敢的破軍不主動求變，但要變時變得有目標；莽撞的破軍破壞力大、建設力弱，常常為變: The bold form of Po Jun doesn't seek change, but changes with purpose when it must; the reckless form destroys a lot, builds little, and often changes for change's sake.
sentences.你偏向果敢：你不輕易動，但一旦要變，下手俐落，而且知道要變成甚麼。: You lean towards boldness: you don't move lightly, but when you must change, you act cleanly and know what you're changing into.
sentences.你偏向莽撞：你改變的衝動強，先想清楚變完之後要建立甚麼，再動手。: You lean towards recklessness: your urge to change is strong — know what you want to build afterwards before you act.
sentences.你大事變得有目標，小事則容易一時興起。: On big things you change with purpose; on small ones, you often act on a whim.
sentences.你向上走的力氣，很多時候要靠環境和身邊的人扶一把。: Your rise often depends on your surroundings and the people around you giving you a hand.
sentences.你的長處是肯學，換一個環境往往更能發揮。: Your strength is willingness to learn; a new environment often brings out more in you.
sentences.要留意的是：遇到機會，你要記得主動接住。: Keep in mind that when an opportunity comes, you need to reach out and take it.
sentences.你浪漫與原則調和：你有情趣，也有分寸，進退都拿捏得住。: Romance and principle are in harmony in you: you have warmth and a sense of measure, and you judge well when to step forward and when to hold back.
sentences.天機在丑未是弱宮，要靠其他星扶持才能發揮；古人說天梁加吉坐遷移，往往要離開出生地: Tian Ji is weak in the Chou and Wei positions and needs other stars' support to do well; the old texts say that with Tian Liang and favourable stars in the Travel Palace, you often have to leave your birthplace to develop.
sentences.關鍵在於天機要得祿。: The key is for Tian Ji to receive Abundance.
sentences.你偏向上進：你肯學、肯往上爬，換一個環境往往更能發揮。: You lean towards rising: willing to learn and to climb, and a new environment often brings out more in you.
sentences.你容易停滯：你有想法，但起步需要人推一把，遇到機會要記得主動接住。: You tend to stall: you have ideas but need a push to start — when an opportunity comes, reach out and take it.
sentences.你遇到對的人和環境會上進，環境不配合時容易停在原地。: With the right people and surroundings you rise; when circumstances don't cooperate, you tend to stay where you are.
sentences.你主動、八面玲瓏，人生觀積極，想要的東西也多。: You're proactive and socially deft, with a positive outlook and plenty you want.
sentences.你的長處是人緣好，懂得為自己爭取資源。: Your strength is getting on well with people and knowing how to secure resources for yourself.
sentences.要留意的是：你想要的太多時，先排好輕重。: Keep in mind that, when you want too many things, it helps to sort out what matters most.
sentences.紫微貪狼同宮屬欲望型：紫貪本身有欲望，會合的武曲破軍又重物質。: Zi Wei with Tan Lang is a pairing of desire: it has wants of its own, and Wu Qu and Po Jun around it add a material weight.
sentences.比起紫微獨坐，更主動，也更懂得應酬。: Compared with Zi Wei alone, it's more proactive and better at socialising.
sentences.你偏向物欲：你目標實際、行動主動，懂得為自己爭取資源。: You lean towards material desire: practical goals, proactive action, and the knack of securing resources for yourself.
sentences.你偏向感情：你重情、重人，人際和感情往往是你最花心力的地方。: You lean towards feeling: you value emotion and people, and relationships are often where you spend most of your energy.
sentences.你物質與感情並重：你想要成就，也想要身邊有人一起分享。: You value the material and the emotional equally: you want achievement, and people around you to share it with.
sentences.你的路上阻力比別人多，但壓力有時反而會推你向前。: You meet more resistance than most, but pressure sometimes pushes you forward.
sentences.你的長處是耐壓，越被逼越做得出成績。: Your strength is handling pressure; the harder you're pushed, the more you achieve.
sentences.要留意的是：你遇到是非時，穩守比冒進合適。: Keep in mind that when gossip and disputes come up, holding steady suits you better than pushing ahead.
sentences.巨門落在辰戌天羅地網，除了少數奇格，一般多阻。: Ju Men in the Chen or Xu position — the net of heaven and earth — usually meets obstacles, apart from a few rare patterns.
sentences.它喜歡溫和的刺激：受激發的奮起，受阻的則多是非。: It responds well to mild stimulation: spurred on, you rise; blocked, you draw more disputes.
sentences.你偏向受激發：壓力對你是推力，越被逼，越能做出成績。: You lean towards being spurred on: pressure drives you, and the harder you're pushed, the more you achieve.
sentences.你阻力偏多：你常要先處理是非和阻滯，才輪到正事，穩守比冒進更合適。: You meet more obstacles: you often have to deal with disputes and delays before the real work, so holding steady suits you better than pushing ahead.
sentences.你有些阻力能化成動力，有些則要避開。: Some resistance you can turn into drive; some is better avoided.
sentences.你個性堅忍，又有開創力，是很穩的組合。: You're resilient and enterprising, a very steady combination.
sentences.你的長處是靠得住，做事坐得穩。: Your strength is dependability; you work from a steady base.
sentences.要留意的是：你不太獨立的時候，跟對人很要緊。: Keep in mind that, at times when you're less independent, following the right person matters a great deal.
sentences.天相在巳亥，對著武曲破軍，是十二宮裡最穩的天相：既有堅忍的個性，又富開創力。: Tian Xiang in the Si or Hai position, facing Wu Qu and Po Jun, is the steadiest of all its positions: resilient in character and enterprising too.
sentences.只是天相本身不太獨立，能自己開創，還是借助別人成事，路子不同。: But Tian Xiang isn't very independent by nature, so building things yourself and succeeding through others are two different paths.
sentences.你偏向開創：你能自己起頭、自己布局，靠得住，也坐得穩。: You lean towards enterprise: you can start things and plan them yourself, dependable and steady.
sentences.你偏向因人成事：你最能發揮的是跟對人、配合得好，借勢往往比單幹更有成績。: You lean towards succeeding through others: you do best following the right person and working well together, and riding momentum often achieves more than going it alone.
sentences.你能獨當一面，也懂得借助別人的力量。: You can stand on your own, and you know how to draw on others' strength.
sentences.你有見地，也有原則，適合做管理或專業。: You have insight and principles, and suit management or specialist work.
sentences.你的長處是看得遠，說話有人聽。: Your strength is seeing far ahead, and people listen when you speak.
sentences.要留意的是：你的原則太硬時，人際會變得疏離。: Keep in mind that when your principles get too rigid, relationships grow distant.
sentences.天梁是原則之星，對宮太陽。: Tian Liang is the star of principle, facing Tai Yang in the opposite palace.
sentences.融和的人際好、際遇好，宜從政從商、做管理；孤獨的宜走專業與學術。: The harmonious form gets on well with people and fares well, suiting public life, business or management; the solitary form suits specialist and academic paths.
sentences.子宮的天梁對著入廟的太陽，較為融和。: Tian Liang in the Zi position faces a strong Tai Yang and is more harmonious.
sentences.午宮的天梁對著落陷的太陽，帶一點孤獨。: Tian Liang in the Wu position faces a weak Tai Yang and carries a touch of solitude.
sentences.你偏向融和：你人緣好、懂組織，最能在管理和協調的位置發揮。: You lean towards harmony: good with people and organisation, at your best in management and coordination.
sentences.你偏向孤獨：你獨立、有見地，最能在專業或學術裡做出分量。: You lean towards solitude: independent and insightful, at your best making your mark in specialist or academic work.
sentences.你有獨立的一面，也能帶領一群人做事。: You have an independent side, and you can also lead a group.
sentences.你的人生多奔波，但吃得了苦，辛苦最後會變成本錢。: Your life involves a lot of rushing about, but you can bear hardship, and in the end that effort becomes your capital.
sentences.你的長處是熬得住，肯為目標付出。: Your strength is endurance and willingness to give for a goal.
sentences.要留意的是：你每一次站穩了再走下一步，比硬衝更有利。: Keep in mind that finding your footing each time before the next step works better than charging ahead.
sentences.廉貞七殺同宮，對著天府，組合複雜。: Lian Zhen with Qi Sha, facing Tian Fu, is a complex combination.
sentences.奮發的歷盡艱辛而成大業；多波折的人生多奔波。: The striving form goes through great hardship to achieve something large; the troubled form spends life rushing about.
sentences.關鍵在於有沒有祿。: The key is whether Abundance is present.
sentences.丑宮的廉殺一般只取小康。: Lian Zhen and Qi Sha in the Chou position usually bring modest comfort.
sentences.未宮的廉殺見吉星而無煞，古人稱為雄宿乾元格。: Lian Zhen and Qi Sha in the Wei position, with favourable stars and no malefics, form what the old texts call the Heroic Star pattern.
sentences.你偏向奮發：你吃得了苦，也熬得住，辛苦最後都會變成你的本錢。: You lean towards striving: you can bear hardship and hold out, and in the end the effort becomes your capital.
sentences.你波折偏多：你的路要多繞幾個彎，每一次站穩了再走下一步，比硬衝更有利。: You meet more setbacks: your path takes a few extra turns, and finding your footing each time before the next step works better than charging ahead.
sentences.你肯拼，但路上的彎也不少，節奏比速度更要緊。: You'll fight for things, but there are plenty of turns on the way, so pace matters more than speed.
sentences.你看得開，經過起落仍不失本色。: You take things in your stride and stay yourself through ups and downs.
sentences.你的長處是韌力強，後勁往往比開頭更好。: Your strength is resilience; you often finish stronger than you start.
sentences.要留意的是：你在最後一段多撐一口氣，事情就做得成。: Keep in mind that holding on a little longer in the final stretch is what gets things done.
sentences.天同在辰戌對著巨門，有反背的格局。: Tian Tong in the Chen or Xu position, facing Ju Men, forms a reversal pattern.
sentences.豁達的韌力強，經過憂患仍不失本色；另一種則常常功虧一簣，稍有進展就停下腳步。: The broad-minded form is resilient and stays itself through hardship; the other form often falls at the last hurdle, stopping as soon as there's a little progress.
sentences.你偏向豁達：你韌力強，經過起落仍然看得開，後勁往往比開頭更好。: You lean towards broad-mindedness: resilient, taking ups and downs in your stride, and often finishing stronger than you start.
sentences.你容易半途而止：你起步不慢，要留意在最後一段多撐一口氣。: You tend to stop halfway: you start well — hold on a little longer in the final stretch.
sentences.你看重的事撐得到底，不太在意的事容易放下。: You see through what matters to you, and easily let go of what doesn't.
sentences.你不喜歡跟著潮流走，順境逆境都有自己的一套。: You don't like following trends, and you have your own way in good times and bad.
sentences.你的長處是適應力強，逆境中懂得借力。: Your strength is adaptability; in hard times, you know how to draw on what's around you.
sentences.要留意的是：你逆勢而行之前，先算清代價。: Keep in mind that, before going against the tide, it pays to count the cost.
sentences.武曲破軍同宮，對著天相。: Wu Qu with Po Jun faces Tian Xiang.
sentences.善於適應的，環境順時能開創，不利時也能借力；反其道的，順境時不安於現狀，逆境時又: The adaptable form builds when conditions are good and draws on what's around it when they aren't; the contrary form is restless in good times and short-sighted in bad, and tends to bring setbacks on itself.
sentences.你偏向善於適應：順境時你敢開創，逆境時你懂得借勢。: You lean towards adaptability: in good times you dare to build, in bad times you ride the momentum around you.
sentences.你偏向反其道：你不喜歡跟著潮流走，要留意逆勢之前先算清代價。: You lean towards going against the grain: you don't like following trends — count the cost before you go against the tide.
sentences.你肯順勢，但遇到看不過眼的事，會堅持自己的方向。: You'll go with the flow, but when something doesn't sit right with you, you hold your own course.
sentences.你熱情、容易被看見，關鍵是實力跟不跟得上名聲。: You're warm and easily noticed, and what matters is whether your substance keeps up with your reputation.
sentences.你的長處是有光芒，場面撐得起來。: Your strength is a natural shine; you can hold a room.
sentences.要留意的是：你讓實力跟上名聲，別讓外表走得比內裡快。: Keep in mind that your substance needs to keep up with your reputation, so the surface doesn't outrun what's underneath.
sentences.太陽是光熱之星，對著天梁。: Tai Yang is the star of light and warmth, facing Tian Liang.
sentences.沉穩的太陽容易致富，有財力撐起地位；虛浮的往往表面風光，內裡空虛。: The steady form of Tai Yang tends to build wealth that supports its standing; the hollow form often looks splendid on the surface but is empty inside.
sentences.子宮的太陽落陷，光熱不足，要靠會合的星扶持。: Tai Yang in the Zi position is weak, short of light and warmth, and relies on the support of the stars around it.
sentences.午宮的太陽入廟，本質較好，卻也較易流於虛浮。: Tai Yang in the Wu position is strong, with a better nature, but more prone to hollowness.
sentences.你偏向沉穩：你腳踏實地，實力撐得起場面，積累比表現更重要。: You lean towards steadiness: feet on the ground, with substance to back up appearances; building up matters more to you than showing off.
sentences.你偏向虛浮：你擅長被看見，要留意讓實力跟上名聲。: You lean towards hollowness: you're good at being seen — make sure your substance keeps up with your reputation.
sentences.你懂得表現，也肯累積，只是有時場面走在實力前面。: You know how to present yourself and you're willing to build up, though sometimes appearances run ahead of substance.
sentences.你外圓內方，不露鋒芒，但做事有原則。: You're smooth outside and firm inside, never flashy but principled in what you do.
sentences.你的長處是穩當，悄悄地就把局面做大。: Your strength is steadiness; you quietly grow what you're working on.
sentences.要留意的是：你別因為怕變，錯過了該動的時機。: Keep in mind not to miss the moment to move just because you fear change.
sentences.天府是守成之星，在丑未兩旁必被太陽太陰所夾。: Tian Fu is the star of preserving what's built, and in the Chou or Wei position it is always flanked by Tai Yang and Tai Yin.
sentences.夾宮的太陽光熱足，天府較能於保守中求突破。: When the flanking Tai Yang has plenty of light and warmth, Tian Fu can find a breakthrough within its caution.
sentences.丑宮的天府，夾宮的太陽較弱，較難突破。: For Tian Fu in the Chou position, the flanking Tai Yang is weaker, so breakthroughs are harder.
sentences.未宮的天府，夾宮的太陽光熱足，一般勝過丑宮。: For Tian Fu in the Wei position, the flanking Tai Yang has plenty of light and warmth, which generally makes it stronger than in the Chou position.
sentences.你偏向謙和：你不露鋒芒，但做事有原則，悄悄地就把局面做大。: You lean towards modesty: never flashy but principled, quietly growing what you're working on.
sentences.你偏向保守：你小心謹慎，要留意別因為怕變，錯過了該動的時機。: You lean towards caution: careful and wary — don't miss the moment to move just because you fear change.
sentences.你守得穩，也肯在有把握時踏出一步。: You hold steady, and you're willing to step out when you're sure.
sentences.你有感受，也有判斷，兩股力量都在你身上。: You have feeling and judgement, and both forces live in you.
sentences.你的長處是敏銳，看得到別人看不到的細節。: Your strength is sharpness; you notice details others miss.
sentences.要留意的是：你做重大的決定，最好等情緒過去再定。: Keep in mind that big decisions are best made once the feeling has passed.
sentences.天機太陰同宮，會合天梁與天同：天梁主理智，天同主情緒。: Tian Ji with Tai Yin is joined by Tian Liang and Tian Tong: Tian Liang governs reason, Tian Tong emotion.
sentences.天機太陰本身吉化，只代表格局高，不決定你偏哪一邊。: Favourable transformations on Tian Ji and Tai Yin themselves mark a fine pattern, but don't decide which way you lean.
sentences.你偏向理智：你判斷冷靜、看得清條件，別人常找你拿主意。: You lean towards reason: calm judgement and a clear view of the conditions, so people often come to you for decisions.
sentences.你偏向情緒：你感受敏銳、反應真實，重大的決定等情緒過去再定。: You lean towards emotion: keenly felt and honest reactions — leave big decisions until the feeling has passed.
sentences.你理智與情緒調和：有感受，也有判斷，兩者多數時候互相照應。: Reason and emotion are in harmony in you: you have both feeling and judgement, and most of the time they look after each other.
sentences.你肯付出，但付出得不到回應時，你會乾脆放手。: You're willing to give, but when giving gets no response, you let go cleanly.
sentences.你的長處是念舊、有始有終。: Your strength is loyalty and seeing things through.
sentences.要留意的是：你心裡的期望，先說出口，別等失望了才放手。: Keep in mind that it's better to say what you expect up front than to let go only once you're disappointed.
