sentences.紫微在辰戌是最弱的位置，即使諸吉齊拱，人生也會有一兩處缺憾。: Zi Wei is at its weakest in the Chen or Xu position; even with all the favourable stars around it, life tends to hold one or two regrets.
sentences.紫相的決絕往往不是主動，而是付出之後得不到應有的回報，便斷然了斷。: The finality of Zi Wei with Tian Xiang usually isn't the first move; it comes after giving without due return, and then the break is clean.
sentences.紫相要得祿才重情。: Zi Wei with Tian Xiang needs Abundance to be warm-hearted.
sentences.你偏向重情：你念舊、肯付出，對身邊的人有始有終。: You lean towards warmth: loyal and giving, and you stay with the people around you to the end.
sentences.你偏向決絕：你付出之後得不到回應，會乾脆放手，要留意先把期望說出口。: You lean towards finality: when giving gets no response, you let go cleanly — say what you expect up front.
sentences.你肯付出，但有底線，過了線就不再回頭。: You're willing to give, but you have a limit, and once it's crossed you don't turn back.
sentences.你的人生起落比別人多，要學會在變化裡穩住自己。: Your life has more ups and downs than most, so it's worth learning to steady yourself amid change.
sentences.你的長處是經歷得多，每次都能重新站起來。: Your strength is experience; each time, you get back on your feet.
sentences.要留意的是：你在順境時，先為下一次變動做好準備。: Keep in mind that good times are the moment to prepare for the next change.
sentences.天梁在巳亥落陷，對著天同，所會的星多帶動盪，所以或多或少都帶浮蕩的色彩。: Tian Liang is weak in the Si and Hai positions, facing Tian Tong, and the stars around it bring turbulence, so there's always some restlessness about it.
sentences.天梁得祿，最能讓它穩定。: Abundance on Tian Liang does the most to steady it.
sentences.巳宮的天梁，一般比亥宮更浮蕩。: Tian Liang in the Si position is generally more restless than in the Hai position.
sentences.亥宮的天梁，一般比巳宮安定。: Tian Liang in the Hai position is generally more settled than in the Si position.
sentences.你偏向穩定：你的人生有起落，但每次都能重新站穩，而且站得更高。: You lean towards stability: your life has ups and downs, but each time you find your feet again, and stand higher.
sentences.你起落偏多：你走的路變化大，要留意在順境時先為下一次變動做好準備。: You have more ups and downs: your path changes a lot — use the good times to prepare for the next change.
sentences.你經歷得不少，也慢慢學會了在變化裡安頓自己。: You've been through a lot, and have slowly learned to settle yourself amid change.
sentences.你能扛事，對自己要求很高。: You can carry heavy loads, and you're demanding of yourself.
sentences.你的長處是有擔當，越往後越有分量。: Your strength is taking responsibility; you carry more weight as time goes on.
sentences.要留意的是：你別甚麼都一個人扛，學會把壓力分出去。: Keep in mind not to carry everything alone; learn to share the pressure.
sentences.七殺是將星，對宮武曲天府，相對而言是強格。: Qi Sha is the general's star, facing Wu Qu and Tian Fu, a relatively strong pattern.
sentences.七殺得祿，威權之性就調和；見煞刑，內心多焦慮。: With Abundance, Qi Sha's authority is tempered; with malefics and the Judge, the inner life fills with anxiety.
sentences.子宮的七殺不成雄宿乾元格，高低要看會合的星。: Qi Sha in the Zi position doesn't form the Heroic Star pattern, and how far it goes depends on the stars around it.
sentences.午宮的七殺見吉，古人稱為雄宿乾元格，少年艱辛而後興發。: Qi Sha in the Wu position with favourable stars forms what the old texts call the Heroic Star pattern: hardship in youth, then a rise.
sentences.你偏向威權：你能扛事、能服眾，經過早年的磨練，越往後越有分量。: You lean towards authority: you can carry weight and win people over, and after early trials you carry more as time goes on.
sentences.你焦慮偏多：你對自己要求高，要學會把壓力分出去。: You lean towards anxiety: you demand a lot of yourself — learn to share the pressure.
sentences.你有擔當，也有放不下的心事。: You take responsibility, and you also carry worries you can't put down.
sentences.你感受細膩，精神生活對你和物質一樣重要。: You feel things finely, and your inner life matters to you as much as material things.
sentences.你的長處是有品味，做事有自己的講究。: Your strength is good taste and your own standards in how things are done.
sentences.要留意的是：你的感受太細時，先把基礎打穩，再談理想。: Keep in mind that, when your feelings run very fine, it helps to secure the basics before pursuing ideals.
sentences.廉貞是感情之星，對宮貪狼。: Lian Zhen is the star of feeling, facing Tan Lang in the opposite palace.
sentences.敏感的帶藝術氣質、重精神生活；踏實的即使重精神，也以物質為基礎。: The sensitive form has an artistic temperament and values the inner life; the grounded form, even when it values the inner life, builds on a material base.
sentences.寅宮的廉貞不成雄宿乾元格，高低要看會合的星。: Lian Zhen in the Yin position doesn't form the Heroic Star pattern, and how far it goes depends on the stars around it.
sentences.申宮的廉貞無煞而見吉，古人稱為雄宿乾元格。: Lian Zhen in the Shen position, with favourable stars and no malefics, forms what the old texts call the Heroic Star pattern.
sentences.你偏向敏感：你感受細、有藝術氣質，精神生活對你和物質一樣重要。: You lean towards sensitivity: you feel things finely and have an artistic temperament, and your inner life matters to you as much as material things.
sentences.你偏向踏實：你先把基礎打穩，再談理想，做事有根。: You lean towards groundedness: you secure the basics before pursuing ideals, and what you do has roots.
sentences.你有細膩的一面，也懂得把感受落到實處。: You have a delicate side, and you know how to turn feeling into something practical.
sentences.你的路一波三折，但你有自己的堅持。: Your path has many twists, but you hold to what you believe.
sentences.你的長處是不輕易放棄，轉折之後常有收穫。: Your strength is not giving up easily; after each turn, there's often something gained.
sentences.要留意的是：你目標定得高，先把能力和人脈補上，再全力衝。: Keep in mind that, with goals set high, it helps to build up your skills and connections before going all out.
sentences.破軍落在辰戌天羅地網，一般不算順利。: Po Jun in the Chen or Xu position — the net of heaven and earth — is generally not an easy placement.
sentences.調和的有福澤，只是一波三折；偏執的容易志大才疏、人際不佳。: The balanced form is blessed but takes many twists; the obstinate form tends to aim beyond its abilities and struggle with people.
sentences.破軍在這裡一定要得祿。: Po Jun here really needs Abundance.
sentences.你偏向調和：你的路一波三折，但每一次轉折後都有收穫。: You lean towards balance: your path has many twists, but each turn brings something.
sentences.你偏向偏執：你目標定得高，先把能力和人脈補上，再全力衝。: You lean towards obstinacy: your goals are high — build up your skills and connections before going all out.
sentences.你有自己的堅持，也漸漸學會和環境商量。: You hold to your own views, and you're gradually learning to negotiate with your circumstances.
sentences.你舒服時容易鬆懈，受一點刺激反而發揮得更好。: When you're comfortable you tend to slacken, and a little stimulation actually brings out your best.
sentences.你的長處是有天份，壓力來時做得出成績。: Your strength is natural talent; under pressure, you deliver.
sentences.要留意的是：你給自己定一個具體目標，會更有衝勁。: Keep in mind that setting yourself a concrete goal gives you more drive.
sentences.天同是情緒之星，對著天梁。: Tian Tong is the star of emotion, facing Tian Liang.
sentences.舒服的日子容易讓它鬆懈；稍受一點刺激，反而會把天份發揮出來。: Easy days tend to make it slacken; a little stimulation brings its talent out.
sentences.這裡說的意志，多半是創業與做事的魄力。: The will meant here is mostly the boldness to start and get things done.
sentences.你意志偏堅強：你肯承擔、有魄力，壓力反而讓你做得更好。: Your will runs strong: you take responsibility and act boldly, and pressure makes you do better.
sentences.你魄力偏弱：你舒服時容易鬆下來，給自己定一個具體目標，會更有衝勁。: Your boldness runs light: you slacken when comfortable — set yourself a concrete goal and you'll have more drive.
sentences.你有目標時很有勁，沒有目標時容易隨遇而安。: With a goal you have plenty of drive; without one, you tend to take things as they come.
sentences.你懂得賺錢，也懂得守錢。: You know how to make money and how to keep it.
sentences.你的長處是理財，能把資源和人一起管起來。: Your strength is managing money, and managing resources and people together.
sentences.要留意的是：規模大了，你要找人分擔，別甚麼都自己管。: Keep in mind that, as things grow, you need others to share the load rather than managing everything yourself.
sentences.武曲天府都是財星：武曲主行動，善於生財；天府是府庫，善於儲財。: Wu Qu and Tian Fu are both wealth stars: Wu Qu acts and makes money, Tian Fu is the treasury and keeps it.
sentences.兩者同宮，看你能統籌全局，還是只偏於其中一端。: Together, the question is whether you can oversee the whole, or lean to one end.
sentences.你偏向統籌：你既能開源，也能守成，最適合把資源和人一起管起來。: You lean towards overseeing the whole: you can bring money in and keep it, and do best managing resources and people together.
sentences.你偏於一端：你在生財或守財其中一方特別強，另一方找對的人配合最好。: You lean to one end: you're especially strong at either making or keeping money, and do best pairing with the right person for the other.
sentences.你能開源也能守財，只是規模大了要有人分擔。: You can bring money in and keep it, but as things grow you need others to share the load.
sentences.你時而開朗、時而內斂，明暗兩面都是你。: You're sometimes open, sometimes reserved, and both the light and the shadow are you.
sentences.你的長處是能照亮身邊的人，也能體會別人的心事。: Your strength is lighting up the people around you, and understanding what's on their minds.
sentences.要留意的是：你心事多時，找一個可以放心傾訴的人。: Keep in mind that when you have a lot on your mind, it helps to find someone you can safely talk to.
sentences.太陰太陽同宮，關鍵在太陽的光熱夠不夠照開三合天梁的孤獨之氣。: With Tai Yin and Tai Yang together, the key is whether Tai Yang has enough light and warmth to lift the solitude of Tian Liang in the trine palace.
sentences.介乎兩者之間，就是忽明忽暗。: In between, it flickers between light and shadow.
sentences.丑宮的太陽落陷，較為沉鬱。: Tai Yang in the Chou position is weak, and the mood is heavier.
sentences.未宮的太陽得地，較為開朗。: Tai Yang in the Wei position is well placed, and the mood is brighter.
sentences.你偏向開朗：你的光照得開身邊的人，人際與際遇都跟著明亮。: You lean towards openness: your light reaches the people around you, and your relationships and fortunes brighten with it.
sentences.你偏向沉鬱：你心事多，不輕易說出口，要給自己找一個可以放心傾訴的人。: You lean towards heaviness: you carry a lot and don't say it easily — find someone you can safely talk to.
sentences.你明暗參半：你時而開朗、時而內斂，兩面都是你。: You're part light, part shadow: sometimes open, sometimes reserved, and both are you.
sentences.你感情和慾望都強：想要的東西多，也肯為它奔波。: Your feelings and desires are both strong: you want a lot, and you'll rush about for it.
sentences.你的長處是交際，人脈往往就是你的本錢。: Your strength is socialising; your network is often your capital.
sentences.要留意的是：你同時想要太多，容易甚麼都抓不牢。: Keep in mind that wanting too much at once makes it hard to keep hold of anything.
sentences.貪狼是欲望之星，對宮廉貞。: Tan Lang is the star of desire, facing Lian Zhen in the opposite palace.
sentences.欲望本身不是壞事，看它偏向感情還是物質。: Desire isn't bad in itself; what matters is whether it leans towards feeling or material things.
sentences.在寅宮，貪狼偏向感情，機會來得早，也容易來得快、去得快。: In the Yin position, Tan Lang leans towards feeling: opportunities come early, and tend to come and go quickly.
sentences.在申宮，貪狼偏向物質，發得遲，也守得久。: In the Shen position, Tan Lang leans towards the material: success comes later, and lasts longer.
sentences.你偏向物欲：目標實際、肯奮鬥，在看得見成果的事上最能發揮。: You lean towards material desire: practical goals and hard work, at your best where results are visible.
sentences.你偏向情感：重人情、善交際，人際關係就是你的本錢。: You lean towards feeling: you value relationships and socialise well, and your connections are your capital.
sentences.你物質和感情並重：懂得享受，也懂得經營人際。: You value the material and the emotional equally: you know how to enjoy life and how to look after relationships.
sentences.這組星不會化科，所以做實事比爭名聲更穩。: This pairing never turns to Recognition, so doing real work is steadier for you than chasing a name.
sentences.你反應快、想法多，說話和判斷都很敏銳。: You react quickly and have plenty of ideas, with sharp words and sharp judgement.
sentences.你的長處是腦筋靈活，口才也好。: Your strength is a nimble mind and a way with words.
sentences.要留意的是：你把心思定在一兩件事上做深，成績會更好。: Keep in mind that focusing on one or two things and going deep brings better results.
sentences.天機巨門同宮，弱點是容易浮滑、多疑，要得吉化吉星才能減輕。: Tian Ji with Ju Men has a weakness for glibness and suspicion, eased only by favourable transformations and stars.
sentences.古人說機巨同臨，位至三公，說的是穩重的機巨；說天機巨門為破蕩，說的是浮動的機巨。: When the old texts say this pairing rises to the highest office, they mean the steady form; when they call it reckless and dissipated, they mean the restless form.
sentences.卯宮的機巨，一般不如酉宮有利。: Tian Ji and Ju Men in the Mao position are generally less favourable than in the You position.
sentences.酉宮的機巨，一般較卯宮有利。: Tian Ji and Ju Men in the You position are generally more favourable than in the Mao position.
sentences.你偏向穩重：你想得周到、說得有分寸，別人信得過你的判斷。: You lean towards steadiness: you think things through and speak with measure, and people trust your judgement.
sentences.你偏向浮動：你反應快、想法多，把心思定在一兩件事上做深。: You lean towards restlessness: quick reactions and many ideas — focus on one or two things and go deep.
sentences.你大事穩得住，小事則容易三心兩意。: You stay steady on big things, but tend to waver on small ones.
sentences.你有領導力，習慣掌控局面。: You have leadership, and you're used to being in control.
sentences.你的長處是能服眾，做事有魄力。: Your strength is winning people over and acting boldly.
sentences.要留意的是：你用力過猛時，留一點空間給別人，路會更順。: Keep in mind that when you push too hard, leaving others some room makes the road smoother.
sentences.紫微七殺是純物質性的組合，星曜強烈，吉凶往往一線之差。: Zi Wei with Qi Sha is a purely material pairing of strong stars, where good and bad are often separated by a fine line.
sentences.權威的走正途，受人敬重；強勢的容易用力過猛，一生多挫折。: The authoritative form takes the straight path and earns respect; the domineering form tends to push too hard and meets many setbacks.
sentences.紫殺本身已有權力，不宜再加權。: Zi Wei with Qi Sha already holds power, and doesn't need more Authority.
sentences.你偏向權威：你有領導力，也有分寸，別人服你，不只是怕你。: You lean towards authority: you lead with a sense of measure, and people follow you out of respect, not only fear.
sentences.你偏向強勢：你習慣掌控局面，留一點空間給別人，路會更順。: You lean towards dominance: you're used to being in control — leave others some room, and the road gets smoother.
sentences.你能服眾，但壓力大時容易一手包辦。: You can win people over, but under pressure you tend to do everything yourself.
sentences.你有開創力，最適合在服務別人、開創局面的位置發揮。: You're enterprising, and do best in roles that serve others and open new ground.
sentences.你的長處是肯承擔，敢開新局。: Your strength is taking responsibility and daring to start something new.
sentences.要留意的是：你長遠的人際，比一時的得失更值錢。: Keep in mind that long-term relationships are worth more than short-term gains and losses.
sentences.廉貞破軍同宮，對著天相，星曜組合非常強烈。: Lian Zhen with Po Jun, facing Tian Xiang, is a very strong combination of stars.
sentences.廉破坐命，最宜以服務為性質、以開創為職責。: With this pairing in the Life Palace, you suit work that is service in nature and pioneering in role.
sentences.為公的理想高、有抱負；為己的容易暴起暴落。: The public-minded form has high ideals and ambition; the self-serving form tends to rise and fall sharply.
sentences.你偏向為公：你有理想、肯承擔，最能在服務別人、開創局面的位置發揮。: You lean towards the public good: idealistic and responsible, at your best in roles that serve others and open new ground.
sentences.你偏向為己：你懂得保護自己的利益，要留意長遠的人際比一時的得失更值錢。: You lean towards self-interest: you know how to protect your own interests — remember that long-term relationships are worth more than short-term gains.
sentences.你肯為大局出力，也不會忘了自己的位置。: You'll work for the bigger picture without forgetting your own position.
sentences.你表面看不出大動作，其實不知不覺已經建立了事業。: On the surface there's no big move, but quietly you've already built something.
sentences.你的長處是踏實、看得遠。: Your strength is being grounded and far-sighted.
sentences.要留意的是：你多想不等於多得，定下來往往收穫更多。: Keep in mind that thinking more doesn't mean gaining more; settling down often brings more.
sentences.天府在巳亥對著紫微七殺，會合的多是權力與欲望之星，所以保守性較小。: Tian Fu in the Si or Hai position faces Zi Wei and Qi Sha, and the stars around it are mostly stars of power and desire, so it's less conservative than usual.
sentences.祥和的不知不覺已建立事功；多思慮的騰挪變化多，所得卻未必多。: The peaceful form quietly builds a career; the overthinking form makes many moves and changes without necessarily gaining more.
sentences.你偏向祥和：你腳踏實地、看得遠，事業在不知不覺之間做大。: You lean towards peace: grounded and far-sighted, and your work grows quietly.
sentences.你偏向多思慮：你腦筋動得快、變化多，要留意多想不等於多得。: You lean towards overthinking: your mind moves fast and you change course often — remember that thinking more doesn't mean gaining more.
sentences.你踏實，也會為自己多打算一步。: You're grounded, and you also plan a step ahead for yourself.
sentences.你心地溫和，志向高低，決定了你走多遠。: You're gentle at heart, and how high you aim decides how far you go.
sentences.你的長處是溫和、好相處，經得起慢慢磨。: Your strength is a gentle, easy-going nature that holds up over the long haul.
sentences.要留意的是：你安於舒適時，給自己一個看得見的目標。: Keep in mind that, when you settle into comfort, it helps to give yourself a visible goal.
sentences.天同太陰同宮，都是溫和的星。: Tian Tong and Tai Yin together are both gentle stars.
sentences.古人把這組星分為志高與志卑：積極的經過奮鬥而成富貴，消極的經不起太多磨練。: The old texts divide this pairing into high and low aims: the active form strives and prospers, the passive form can't take too much hardship.
sentences.子宮的同月較消極，經不起太多磨練。: Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the Zi position are more passive and can't take too much hardship.
sentences.午宮的同月較積極，與擎羊同宮古人稱為馬頭帶劍，經過奮鬥而成富貴。: Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the Wu position are more active; with Qing Yang in the palace, the old texts call it a sword at the horse's head, striving through to prosperity.
sentences.你偏向積極：你志向高，經過奮鬥之後，越往後越有成績。: You lean towards action: your aims are high, and after the struggle your results grow over time.
sentences.你偏向消極：你容易安於舒適，要給自己一個看得見的目標，才會起勁。: You lean towards passivity: you settle into comfort easily — give yourself a visible goal to get going.
sentences.你有目標時很拼，沒有目標時容易隨遇而安。: With a goal you work hard; without one, you tend to take things as they come.
sentences.你人生觀積極，想要的東西多，也敢去爭。: You have a positive outlook, want a lot, and dare to compete for it.
sentences.你的長處是進取，敢想敢做。: Your strength is ambition: you dare to imagine and to act.
sentences.要留意的是：你想要的越多，越要記得手段和目標一樣重要。: Keep in mind that the more you want, the more the means matter as much as the goal.
sentences.武曲貪狼同宮，人生觀極積極，權欲之心也重。: Wu Qu with Tan Lang brings a very positive outlook and a strong appetite for power.
sentences.有節制的欲望不傷害別人，反而是鞭策自己的力量；野心則會為一己之利不計後果。: Desire with restraint harms no one and drives you on; ambition without it pursues self-interest regardless of the consequences.
sentences.武貪要得祿才好。: Wu Qu with Tan Lang does best with Abundance.
sentences.你偏向有度：你積極進取，但知道界線在哪裡，進得快，也守得住。: You lean towards restraint: ambitious but aware of the limits, advancing fast and holding what you gain.
sentences.你野心偏大：你想要的比別人多，要留意手段和目標一樣重要。: Your ambition runs large: you want more than most — remember that the means matter as much as the goal.
sentences.你敢想敢要，多數時候也懂得收手。: You dare to imagine and to want, and most of the time you know when to stop.
sentences.你常常要靠自己打拼，但走出去之後，往往比留在原地順利。: You often have to make your own way, but once you head out, things tend to go better than if you'd stayed put.
sentences.你的長處是獨立，換了環境也適應得快。: Your strength is independence; you adapt quickly to new surroundings.
sentences.要留意的是：凡事一個人扛，容易錯過願意幫你的人。: Keep in mind that carrying everything alone can mean missing people who would help you.
sentences.太陽巨門同宮，它的對宮和兩個三合宮都沒有主星，支援要向外借，所以容易覺得孤立；古: With Tai Yang and Ju Men together, the opposite palace and both trine palaces have no major stars, so support has to come from outside, and you can easily feel isolated; the old texts also say this pairing favours going far from home.
sentences.你偏向得助：身邊總有人願意拉你一把，走得遠也遇得到幫手。: You lean towards finding help: there's always someone willing to give you a hand, and you meet helpers even far from home.
sentences.你偏向孤立：多半要靠自己打天下，換一個環境，更容易遇到賞識你的人。: You lean towards isolation: you mostly make your own way, and in a new environment you're more likely to meet people who appreciate you.
sentences.你得助和孤立參半：你能獨立，也遇得到幫手，只是要自己先走出第一步。: You're half helped, half on your own: you can stand alone and you do meet helpers, but you need to take the first step yourself.
sentences.你講義氣、肯幫忙，照顧朋友是你的本色。: You're loyal and helpful, and looking after friends is part of who you are.
sentences.你的長處是可靠，朋友有事會先想到你。: Your strength is reliability; when friends are in trouble, they think of you first.
sentences.要留意的是：你幫忙之前，先問一句該不該。: Keep in mind that it's worth asking whether you should help before you do.
sentences.天相是輔佐之星，可善可惡：受天府影響而帶謹慎保守；受對宮廉破影響，則較感情化、原: Tian Xiang is the star of support, and can go either way: influenced by Tian Fu it's careful and conservative; influenced by Lian Zhen and Po Jun opposite, it's more emotional and less principled.
sentences.你偏向有原則：你照顧朋友，但有自己的底線，不會做老好人。: You lean towards principle: you look after friends but keep your own limits, and you won't be a pushover.
sentences.你偏向重情面：你講義氣、肯幫忙，幫之前先問一句該不該。: You lean towards sentiment: loyal and helpful — ask whether you should before you help.
sentences.你重情，也講道理，只是朋友開口時較難說不。: You value feeling and reason, but find it hard to say no when friends ask.
sentences.你反應快、看得準，也有自己的原則。: You react quickly, see accurately, and have your own principles.
sentences.你的長處是判斷快，問題往往一眼就看出來。: Your strength is quick judgement; you often spot a problem at a glance.
sentences.要留意的是：你看得出問題，說出口時要留點餘地。: Keep in mind that when you see a problem, it helps to leave some room when you say so.
sentences.天機主敏感和變動，天梁主原則和紀律，兩顆星同宮。: Tian Ji governs sensitivity and change, Tian Liang principle and discipline, and here they share a palace.
sentences.兩股力量平衡，判斷就又快又公道；失衡時，容易反應過度，說話尖銳。: When the two forces balance, your judgement is quick and fair; out of balance, you tend to overreact and speak sharply.
sentences.你偏向明斷：反應快，也守原則，判斷往往又準又公道。: You lean towards clear judgement: quick to react and principled, your judgements are usually accurate and fair.
sentences.你偏向尖銳：看得出問題，但話容易說得太重，記得對事不對人。: You lean towards sharpness: you see the problem, but your words can be too heavy — address the issue, not the person.
sentences.你多數時候判斷公道，只是情急時話會說得重一點。: Most of the time your judgement is fair, though in a rush your words come out a little heavy.
sentences.這樣看，是因為你的盤上兩邊都沒有特別的推力。: This is because nothing in your chart pushes particularly hard either way.
sentences.骨架是天生的，長成怎樣的人，看你怎樣用它；用在對的地方，同一副骨架就是長處。: The shape is what you were born with; who you become depends on how you use it, and used in the right place, the same shape is a strength.
sentences.推力不等於定局。: A push is not a verdict.
sentences.哪一股力量在你身上用得多，你自己最清楚。: You know best which of these forces you use more.
sentences.命書寫的是一張底圖。: This book is a base map.
sentences.往後的路怎樣走，仍然在你；需要的時候，再翻回來看看。: How you walk the road ahead is still up to you; come back to these pages whenever you need them.
sentences.你肯為生活品味和人際應酬花錢，也容易憑交際手段爭取進展。: You're willing to spend on good taste and socialising, and you tend to make progress through your social skills.
sentences.你說話有聲勢，別人容易順著你的主意走；未有把握的改變，先別急著說出口。: Your words carry force, and others tend to go along with your ideas; hold off announcing changes you aren't yet sure of.
sentences.你在自己那一行建立信譽，決斷也更穩當；名氣不宜張揚。: You build a reputation in your own field, and your decisions grow steadier; it's better not to make a show of your name.
sentences.你在地位和人際上容易有摩擦，例如和上司不和；宜低調，少露鋒芒。: You may meet friction over status and with people, such as disagreements with a boss; keep a low profile and don't show your edge too much.
sentences.你容易主動找到機會，適合策劃、設計或替人奔走的工作；只是財來得快，不易長留。: You tend to find opportunities yourself, and suit work in planning, design or running around on others' behalf; but money that comes quickly doesn't easily stay.
sentences.你在自己的行業裡容易建立威信和好口碑；遇到麻煩，也較快知道怎樣處理。: You tend to build authority and a good name in your field, and when trouble comes, you work out how to handle it quickly.
sentences.你的名聲和信用會提升，說話容易令人信服，但也容易招人妒忌。: Your reputation and credibility rise and your words convince people more easily, though this can also draw envy.
sentences.你容易有說不出口的感情困擾，和親近的人緣份較淡；才華也可能一時未被看見。: You may have emotional troubles you can't put into words, and feel less close to the people near you; your talents may also go unseen for a while.
sentences.你的財祿有增加的機會，而且在運限見到比在本命更好；留意別因安逸而少了進取。: Your income has a chance to grow, and seeing this in a period is better than seeing it in your birth chart; watch that comfort doesn't dull your ambition.
sentences.你的想法較穩定，也更有效率，意見容易被採納，但實權未必在你手上。: Your thinking is steadier and more effective, and your suggestions tend to be adopted, though real power may not be in your hands.
sentences.你的感情和人際容易有挫折，替人出力也可能反招怨言；量力而為，別勉強。: Your relationships may meet setbacks, and helping others may even earn you complaints; do what you can and don't force it.
sentences.你的財源比較順遂；太陰化祿在大限見到，比在本命更好。: Your sources of income run relatively smoothly; Tai Yin turning to Abundance is better in a ten-year stage than in the birth chart.
sentences.你比平時更有衝勁開創，但也容易追求享樂或走捷徑，要給自己定一個目標。: You have more drive than usual to start new things, but may also chase pleasure or take shortcuts, so set yourself a goal.
sentences.你學東西變得踏實，偏向理工或專門技術；適合做計劃，實行要靠別人配合。: Your learning becomes more grounded, leaning towards science, engineering or specialist skills; you suit planning, with others to carry things out.
sentences.你身邊的是非口舌較多，事情常不如理想；越求全越容易失望，放寬標準反而順。: There's more gossip and dispute around you, and things often fall short of what you'd like; the more you demand perfection, the more disappointed you get, and easing your standards actually helps.
sentences.你容易藉交際應酬打開局面、帶來收入，但也容易為玩樂和人情多花錢。: You tend to open doors and bring in income through socialising, but may also spend more on fun and on keeping up with people.
sentences.你手上較有財權，有一筆錢可以由你調度，但不一定等於富有。: You have more say over money, with funds you can direct yourself, though that doesn't necessarily mean being wealthy.
sentences.你容易受人注意、提升名聲；名氣來時，妒忌也會一起來。: You tend to draw attention and raise your profile; when recognition comes, envy comes with it.
sentences.你的計劃容易延誤或出錯，也容易多思多慮；遇到風波，以不變應萬變最好。: Your plans may be delayed or go wrong, and you may overthink; when trouble comes, holding steady is the best response.
sentences.你適合創業做事，事業做得越大，財祿越厚；也要記得留一份積蓄。: You suit starting a business or venture, and the bigger it grows, the better the income; remember to keep some savings too.
sentences.你的欲望和競爭心都變強，愈遇競爭愈起勁，身心也會跟著勞累。: Your desires and competitiveness grow stronger, and the more competition you meet, the more energised you get, though body and mind tire along with it.
sentences.你的判斷和觀察力提升，有利專業考試；遇到難題，往往能從根本解決。: Your judgement and powers of observation sharpen, which helps with professional exams; when problems come, you can often solve them at the root.
sentences.你說話和文書容易出錯，簽約、借貸要格外小心；感情上也容易有誤會。: Mistakes creep into what you say and write, so take extra care with contracts and loans; misunderstandings in love are also more likely.
sentences.你容易憑名聲和地位得到收入，名大於利；要留意應酬開支。: Your income tends to come through reputation and status, with more name than money; watch your spending on socialising.
sentences.你做事果斷有聲勢，適合財經和實務工作，但容易顧不上別人的感受。: You act decisively and with force, suiting finance and practical work, though you may overlook other people's feelings.
sentences.你的信用和信譽增加，容易得到別人信任和上級提拔。: Your credibility and reputation grow, and you tend to win people's trust and promotion from above.
sentences.你的情緒容易不安定，感情也可能有困擾；這段時期多辛勞，要給自己留出安定心神的空間: Your emotions may be unsettled and your relationships troubled; this is a hard-working period, so leave yourself room to steady your mind.
sentences.你的口才變成本錢，利於教學、法律、銷售、傳播；太想表現自己，反而容易惹是非。: Your way with words becomes an asset, favouring teaching, law, sales and media; wanting too much to show yourself off can draw disputes.
sentences.你的地位和領導力提升，收入跟著地位增加；不宜過份擴張聲勢。: Your standing and leadership rise, and income grows with your standing; don't overextend your influence.
sentences.你的口才和學雜學的能力增加，容易以言詞取悅別人。: Your way with words and your knack for picking up varied knowledge grow, and you can easily please people with what you say.
sentences.你的文書、考試和合約容易出錯，替人擔保或借貸要特別小心。: Mistakes can creep into your paperwork, exams and contracts, so take special care with guaranteeing others or lending.
sentences.你容易被捲入別人的麻煩，處理起來拖得較長；適合做收費公開的專業服務，不宜追求名氣: You may get drawn into other people's trouble, which takes a while to sort out; you suit professional services with open fees, rather than chasing a name.
sentences.你手上有實權，能獨當一面，但容易給人壓力，辛勞而少人緣。: You hold real power and can stand on your own, but you may put pressure on people, working hard with little goodwill in return.
sentences.你的財務容易周轉不靈或超出預算；處理問題手段別太硬，感情上尤其如此。: Your finances may run tight or over budget; don't handle problems too forcefully, especially in love.
sentences.你的變動比較穩當，無論怎樣變，結果多半比變之前好。: Your changes are steadier, and however things change, the result is usually better than before.
sentences.你說話有說服力，影響力和地位都會提升，適合靠口才的工作。: Your words persuade, your influence and standing rise, and you suit work that relies on speaking.
sentences.你的修養和才華容易被欣賞，名氣和信譽也會增加。: Your character and talents tend to be appreciated, and your name and reputation grow.
sentences.你容易有不如理想的失落感，勞碌奔忙而收穫不如預期；記得多照顧家庭。: You may feel things fall short, working hard and rushing about for less than you expected; remember to look after your family.
sentences.工作上容易遇到合適的機會，肯主動爭取，比較容易做出成績。: At work, suitable opportunities tend to come along, and if you reach for them, results come more easily.
sentences.工作上你會多一點話事權，責任也跟著加重；不是每件事都要自己扛。: At work you have more say, and more responsibility with it; not everything has to rest on you.
sentences.你在工作上的表現容易被看見，適合爭取認可、考證或建立口碑。: Your work tends to be noticed, so it's a good time to seek recognition, earn a qualification or build a reputation.
sentences.工作上的計劃容易卡住或要返工，重要的決定先留一點餘地。: Plans at work may stall or need redoing, so leave some margin on important decisions.
sentences.收入有增加的機會，進賬比較順；順的時候也記得留一份。: Income has a chance to grow and money comes in more smoothly; when it does, remember to put some aside.
sentences.錢怎樣用多由你作主，可以主動規劃，但別一次押得太重。: You have more say over how money is used and can plan actively, but don't stake too much at once.
sentences.你在錢上信用好，借貸、合作都容易得到別人信任。: Your credit is good, and others tend to trust you with loans and partnerships.
sentences.錢容易周轉緊或超出預算，大額支出和借貸先多想一步。: Money may run tight or over budget, so think twice about large expenses and borrowing.
sentences.感情上比較甜，容易遇到合拍的人，或和伴侶相處更融洽。: Love is sweeter: you may meet someone well matched, or get on better with your partner.
sentences.感情裡你比較主導，記得留空間給對方，別變成一個人作主。: You take more of the lead in love; remember to leave your partner room, rather than deciding everything alone.
sentences.感情上相處有禮，你們的關係容易得到身邊的人認同。: There's courtesy in your relationship, and the people around you tend to approve of it.
sentences.感情上容易有誤會，或有心事說不出口；有話早點講清楚。: Misunderstandings in love are more likely, or things go unsaid; say what you need to say early.
sentences.你的心情比較寬鬆，懂得享受生活，也較容易感到滿足。: Your mood is easier, you enjoy life, and you feel content more readily.
sentences.你心裡想做的事多，幹勁也足，但容易給自己太大壓力。: You have plenty you want to do and the energy for it, but may put too much pressure on yourself.
sentences.你容易找到讓自己靜下來的方法，讀書和修養都合適，靜下來時想得特別清楚。: You find ways to quieten yourself more easily; reading and self-cultivation suit this time, and when you're still, you think especially clearly.
sentences.你心裡容易有放不下的事，多思多慮；記得給自己留出休息的時間。: Things may weigh on your mind that you can't let go of, and you may overthink; remember to leave yourself time to rest.
sentences.這十年的四化，沒有碰到你本命的四化。: The transformations of these ten years don't touch the transformations in your birth chart.
sentences.本命四化是你的本質，大限四化是這段時期的環境；不沖起，作用就小，你本來的底子不會: Your birth-chart transformations are your nature; those of a ten-year stage are the environment of that period. If they don't set each other off, the effect is small, and your underlying nature doesn't change.
sentences.這一年的四化，沒有碰到你大限或本命的四化：不沖起，作用就小，今年的起落多半只在表: This year's transformations don't touch those of your ten-year stage or your birth chart: if they don't set each other off, the effect is small, and this year's ups and downs mostly stay on the surface.
sentences.十二步是一條路的形狀，走得快慢、走向哪裡，仍然在你；關鍵的幾步，值得提早準備。: The twelve steps are the shape of a road; how fast you walk it and where you head are still up to you, and the key steps are worth preparing for early.
sentences.環境只是背景；這十年要做成甚麼、做到哪一步，始終由你自己決定。: Circumstances are only the backdrop; what you make of these ten years, and how far you take it, is always your own decision.
sentences.把力氣放在順的地方，對要留神的事慢一步，就是這一年最實在的做法。: Putting your energy where things run smoothly, and going a step slower on what needs care, is the most practical way through this year.
sentences.你還年少，下面講的是這十年身邊的環境，很多要到長大後才用得上。: You're still young, so what follows describes the circumstances around you in these ten years; much of it only becomes useful once you're grown.
sentences.你還年少，下面講的是這一年身邊的環境。: You're still young, so what follows describes the circumstances around you this year.
sentences.這十年是你命盤裡的關鍵大限之一，這段時期的得失，對你一生影響特別大。: These ten years are one of the key stages in your chart, and what you gain and lose in this period has an especially large effect on your life.
sentences.這一年是你命盤裡的關鍵年份之一，今年的得失，影響會比一般年份深。: This year is one of the key years in your chart, and what you gain and lose this year runs deeper than in an ordinary year.
sentences.這也是你命盤裡的關鍵年份。: It is also a key year in your chart.
sentences.這幾年，對你來說是不是有過轉折？: Were these years turning points for you?
sentences.你利於考試、進修和寫作，作品容易有發表的機會。: This is a good time for exams, further study and writing, and your work may well find a way into print.

clauses.與平輩的不滿不說出口，會放在心裡記著: grievances with peers go unspoken and are kept in mind
clauses.外表沉，內裡熱；情緒藏得住，積得也久: calm outside and hot inside; feelings stay hidden and build up for a long time
clauses.不吵，但也不說；壓在下面的東西比表面多；不說的事，找個平靜的時候慢慢講: no arguing, but no talking either; there's more under the surface than on it; find a calm moment to talk through what you haven't said
clauses.對後輩的期待不明說，落差出現時反應會偏大: unspoken expectations of those you bring up, with a strong reaction when they fall short
clauses.做事沉得住氣，壓力往內收；爆發時幅度大: steady under pressure, holding it in; when it bursts, it bursts big
clauses.對長輩的不同意見長期不說，累積得比想像多: disagreements with elders left unsaid for so long they pile up more than you'd think
clauses.對居所的不滿不說，長期忍受直到忍不住: unhappiness with a home goes unsaid and is endured until it can't be any longer
clauses.耗損是悶著的那種，外面看不出來: the toll is a smothered kind that can't be seen from outside
clauses.心事不外露，安靜並不代表已經放下: worries don't show, and quiet doesn't mean you've let go
clauses.資源上的計較不外露，心裡的帳算得很清: careful about money without showing it, keeping a very clear tally inside
clauses.在外不張揚，適應靠自己消化而不是找人: low-key out in the world, adapting by working things through alone rather than turning to others
clauses.關係散得慢，就算已經淡了也不會正式結束: relationships fade slowly, and even when they've cooled they never formally end
clauses.平輩之間的芥蒂不容易散，過去的事會一直帶著: grudges with peers don't easily clear, and the past gets carried along
clauses.事情在心裡轉得久，進退之間反覆: things turn over in your mind for a long time, going back and forth
clauses.相處上少有爆發，卻容易長期積壓；小事當天講，別留到翻舊賬: few outbursts, but things build up over time; deal with small things the same day rather than raking them up later
clauses.對後輩放心不下，交代過的事會再交代一次: trouble letting go with those you bring up, giving the same instructions twice
clauses.做事拖得長，細節反覆；穩妥的一面同時存在: work drags on with details revisited, though it's thorough as well
clauses.對長輩的意見不當面反對，回去之後想很久: no objecting to elders face to face, but thinking about it for a long time afterwards
clauses.搬動與處置都拖，決定了也要很久才執行: slow to move or sort things out, and slow to act even once decided
clauses.耗損是持續的那種，沒有明顯起點: the toll is a constant one with no clear starting point
clauses.想不通的事會一直開著，睡前特別響: unresolved questions stay open and are loudest at bedtime
clauses.資源進出都慢，該收的收得遲，該斷的斷得晚: money moves slowly both ways: what's owed comes in late, and what should be cut gets cut late
clauses.換環境之後適應期偏長，舊的牽掛帶得走: a long adjustment after a move, with old ties carried along
